words.en: A major city and capital of Nova Scotia, Canada, known for its historic waterfront, maritime heritage, and strategic naval importance.

words.ex: The children are learning motions in dance class.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在舞蹈课上学习动作。
words.en: Motions refer to the act or process of moving or the way in which something moves. It can also mean a formal proposal made in a meeting or court.

words.tr: v. 追捕；进行；继续( pursue的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The police pursued the thief through the streets.
words.ex_cn: 警察在街上追捕小偷。
words.en: Chased or followed persistently.

words.ex: It rained heavily last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚雨下得很大。
words.en: To a great degree; in large amounts.

words.ex: Steve Jobs is the founder of Apple.
words.ex_cn: 史蒂夫·乔布斯是苹果公司的创办者。
words.en: A founder is someone who establishes an organization, company, or institution. As a verb, it means to fail or collapse, especially in terms of a plan or a ship sinking.

words.ex: His outlook on life is very positive.
words.ex_cn: 他对生活的观点非常积极。
words.en: Your outlook is your general attitude towards life.

words.ex: Francis likes to draw pictures every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 弗朗西斯每天下午都喜欢画画。
words.en: Francis is a male given name of Latin origin, meaning 'Frenchman' or 'free man'.

words.ex: The farmer owns five hectares of land.
words.ex_cn: 这位农民拥有五公顷土地。
words.en: A hectare is a unit of measurement of area, equal to 10,000 square metres or approximately 2.471 acres.

words.ex: He ate three fourths of the pizza.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了四分之三的披萨。
words.en: The ordinal number corresponding to the number four; one of four equal parts of something.

words.tr: n. 开槽 v. 赢得; 增加; 获得( gain的现在分词 ); （钟、表）走快
words.ex: He is gaining experience by working hard.
words.ex_cn: 他通过努力工作赢得经验。
words.en: To obtain or secure something desired or beneficial.

words.tr: adj. 有视力的； v. 看到；观测；“sight”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The sighted children can see the board clearly.
words.ex_cn: 有视力的孩子们能清楚地看到黑板。
words.en: Having the ability to see; not blind.

words.ex: The children played with pebbles by the river.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在河边玩小石子。
words.en: Pebbles are small, smooth stones found especially on beaches or in rivers.

words.tr:
n. 碾磨
adj. 乱兜圈子的；成群乱转的
v. 碾碎；磨碎；“mill”的现在分词
words.ex: The milling of wheat into flour is a common process.
words.ex_cn: 将小麦磨成面粉是一个常见的过程。
words.en: The process of grinding or crushing something, especially grain, in a mill; or the process of cutting or shaping metal with a rotating tool.

words.ex: He insists on going alone.
words.ex_cn: 他坚持要一个人去。
words.en: If you insist on something, you demand it and refuse to accept any alternative.

words.ex: He lives in a quiet borough of New York.
words.ex_cn: 他住在纽约的一个安静的行政区。
words.en: A borough is a town, or a district within a large city, that has its own local government.

words.ex: He buys poultry at the local market.
words.ex_cn: 他在当地市场买家禽。
words.en: Poultry refers to domesticated birds kept by humans for their eggs, meat, or feathers.

words.tr: n. 再发；重陷；故态复萌；
words.ex: He had a relapse after stopping his medicine.
words.ex_cn: 他停药后病情复发了。
words.en: If someone relapses, they return to a less advanced state, or to a previous way of behaving that they wanted to change.

words.ex: The music sounded nice.
words.ex_cn: 这音乐听起来很好。
words.en: To make a sound; to give an impression when heard.

words.ex: He wrote a draft of the letter before sending it.
words.ex_cn: 他在发送之前写了这封信的草稿。
words.en: A draft is a preliminary version of a piece of writing, or a current of air in a room or other confined space. It can also refer to the act of selecting someone for a particular purpose or task, especially in sports or the military.

words.tr: adj. 狂怒的；暴怒的；激烈的
words.ex: He was furious when he lost his keys.
words.ex_cn: 他丢了钥匙时非常生气。
words.en: If someone is furious, they are extremely angry.

words.ex: He cannot breathe when he runs fast.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得快时无法呼吸。
words.en: To breathe means to take air into your lungs and then expel it, a process necessary for life.

words.tr: v. 回答；报复（reply 的过去式和过去分词）；
words.ex: He replied that he was tired.
words.ex_cn: 他回答说他累了。
words.en: To reply means to say or write something as an answer to a question or remark.

words.tr: adj. 灭绝的；熄灭的；绝种的；
words.ex: The dodo is an extinct bird.
words.ex_cn: 渡渡鸟是一种灭绝的鸟。
words.en: If a species of animals or plants is extinct, it no longer has any living members, either in the world or in a particular place.

words.tr: adj. 权责已发生的 v. 增加( accrue的过去式和过去分词 ); （通过自然增长）产生;
words.ex: The interest has accrued over three months.
words.ex_cn: 利息在三个月内累积了。
words.en: If money or interest accrues, it gradually increases in amount over a period of time.

words.ex: The drawer has two wooden handles.
words.ex_cn: 这个抽屉有两个木制把手。
words.en: Handles refers to the part of an object designed to be held or operated by hand, or the act of dealing with or controlling something.

words.ex: I presume he will arrive tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我假设他明天会到。
words.en: If you presume that something is the case, you think that it is the case, although you are not certain.

words.tr: adv. 成碎片地；弄碎地；分离地
words.ex: The kingdom was torn asunder by civil war.
words.ex_cn: 这个王国因内战而被撕裂。
words.en: Into parts or pieces; apart.

words.ex: He is a juristic expert in contract law.
words.ex_cn: 他是合同法方面的法律专家。
words.en: Relating to law or jurisprudence.

words.tr:
v. 释放；
n. 释放；
words.ex: The factory releases smoke into the air.
words.ex_cn: 工厂向空气中释放烟雾。
words.en: To release something means to let it go or make it available, especially after it has been held or controlled. A release can also refer to the act of making something available or the state of being made available.

words.ex: We have meetings every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 我们每周一都有会议。
words.en: A meeting is an event in which a group of people come together to discuss things or make decisions.

words.tr:
n. 击败；失败；挫折
v. 击败；战胜；使受挫；“defeat”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: He was defeated in the chess match.
words.ex_cn: 他在国际象棋比赛中被击败。
words.en: Having been beaten in a battle or other contest.

words.ex: He signed his name with his initials.
words.ex_cn: 他用他的缩写签了名。
words.en: The first letters of a person's names, typically used as a form of identification or signature.

words.ex: A sense of calm pervades the room.
words.ex_cn: 一种平静的气息弥漫在整个房间。
words.en: To spread through and be perceived in every part of something.

words.tr: v. 发现； vt. [无]对…检波 v. 发现，发觉，查明( detect的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The sensor detected a small movement.
words.ex_cn: 传感器发现了一个轻微的移动。
words.en: If something is detected, it is noticed or discovered, often as a result of an investigation or because of special equipment.

words.ex: They have an intimate friendship.
words.ex_cn: 他们有着亲密的友谊。
words.en: having a close, friendly, or personal relationship with someone; private and personal

words.ex: The store sells seasonal fruits like strawberries in spring.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店在春天出售草莓等季节性水果。
words.en: Seasonal means relating to or happening during a particular season.

words.tr:
n. 天主教徒；
adj. 天主教的；
words.ex: He is a catholic who goes to church every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名每周日都去教堂的天主教徒。
words.en: If you describe a collection of things or people as catholic, you are emphasizing that it is varied and includes many different types of things or people.

words.ex: The paint was applied unevenly on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 油漆在墙上涂得不均匀。
words.en: In a way that is not level, smooth, or regular.

words.ex: The clock struck midnight.
words.ex_cn: 钟敲响了午夜。
words.en: Midnight is twelve o'clock in the middle of the night.

words.tr:
adv. 向后地；
adj. 向后的；
words.ex: He walked backward to see the sign.
words.ex_cn: 他向后走以便看清楚那个标志。
words.en: If you move or look backward, you move or look in the direction that your back is facing.

words.ex: The wind blew bitterly through the trees.
words.ex_cn: 风刺骨地吹过树林。
words.en: In a way that is filled with or marked by strong negative emotions such as anger, sorrow, or disappointment.

words.ex: The lens enlarges the small letters.
words.ex_cn: 这个镜头把小字母放大了。
words.en: To make or become larger or more extensive.

words.ex: He was repelled by the bad smell.
words.ex_cn: 他被那股臭味吓退了。
words.en: To repel means to drive or force back or away, or to cause disgust or aversion in someone.

words.ex: The artist spends most of his time in the workroom.
words.ex_cn: 这位艺术家大部分时间都在工作室里度过。
words.en: A room where work is done, especially artistic or craft work.

words.tr: n. 学习；学问； v. 学习；“learn”的现在分词；
words.ex: Learning takes time and practice.
words.ex_cn: 学习需要时间和练习。
words.en: The acquisition of knowledge or skills through study, experience, or being taught.

words.tr: n. 航天飞机；穿梭班车；梭子
words.ex: The shuttles take passengers to the airport.
words.ex_cn: 这些班车将乘客送往机场。
words.en: A shuttle is a vehicle or aircraft that travels regularly between two places, or a device used in weaving to carry the weft thread back and forth across the warp threads.

words.ex: He put the letter in an envelope.
words.ex_cn: 他把信装进了一个信封。
words.en: An envelope is a flat, usually rectangular or square, paper container for a letter, which you seal before you send it by post.

words.tr: v. 修复; 归还( restore的第三人称单数 ); 交还; 使恢复
words.ex: The medicine restores his energy.
words.ex_cn: 这种药恢复了他的精力。
words.en: To bring back to a former, original, or normal condition; to return something lost or stolen to its proper owner.

words.ex: The legation sent a message to the capital.
words.ex_cn: 使团向首都发送了一条消息。
words.en: The office or residence of a diplomatic representative, such as an ambassador, in a foreign country.

words.ex: He is a reliable friend who always helps.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个可靠的朋友，总是帮忙。
words.en: Able to be trusted to do or provide what is needed or right.

words.ex: He refluxes acid after eating spicy food.
words.ex_cn: 他吃完辛辣食物后会反流胃酸。
words.en: Refluxes refer to the backward flow of a liquid, especially in a chemical process or in the context of bodily fluids like stomach acid.

words.ex: He made several requests for help.
words.ex_cn: 他提出了几次求助请求。
words.en: A request is the act of politely or formally asking for something.

words.ex: It is feasible to finish the project in one week.
words.ex_cn: 一周内完成这个项目是可行的。
words.en: If something is feasible, it can be done, made, or achieved.

words.tr: adj. 烦恼的； v. “trouble”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He looked troubled after the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 会议后，他看起来很烦恼。
words.en: Experiencing or characterized by problems or difficulties.

words.tr: n. 骗子；江湖骗子；诈骗犯
words.ex: The swindler tricked old people with fake promises.
words.ex_cn: 这个骗子用虚假的承诺欺骗了老人。
words.en: A swindler is someone who swindles, that is, someone who cheats or tricks someone else out of money or property.

words.tr: v. 逗留；（使）停止工作；停止( stop的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He was stopping at the café for a coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他当时在咖啡馆逗留喝杯咖啡。
words.en: The act of stopping something or the state of being stopped.

words.ex: He was swindled out of his money by a fake lottery.
words.ex_cn: 他被一个假彩票骗走了钱。
words.en: To swindle means to cheat or defraud someone, typically by persuading them to part with money or property through deceit or trickery.

words.ex: It is uncommon to see snow in this city.
words.ex_cn: 在这个城市看到雪是不常见的。
words.en: If you describe something as uncommon, you mean that it does not happen often or is not often seen.

words.ex: The loud noise every night is a nuisance.
words.ex_cn: 每晚的噪音真是个讨厌的事。
words.en: A nuisance is a person, thing, or situation that is annoying or causes trouble.

words.tr: adj. 紧张的；不自然的； v. “strain”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: His voice sounded strained during the phone call.
words.ex_cn: 他在电话里的声音听起来很紧张。
words.en: If a situation or relationship is strained, it is not relaxed or friendly, often because there is a problem or disagreement.

words.tr:
adj. 首要的；大红色的
n. 红衣主教；枢机主教；基数
words.ex: This is a cardinal rule in our school.
words.ex_cn: 这是我们学校的一项首要规则。
words.en: A cardinal rule or quality is the most important one.

words.ex: They bartered apples for eggs.
words.ex_cn: 他们用苹果换鸡蛋。
words.en: To exchange goods or services for other goods or services without using money.

words.ex: The diverted traffic went around the city.
words.ex_cn: 转移的交通绕过了城市。
words.en: If something is diverted, it is changed in direction or used for a different purpose.

words.tr: v. 偷；剽窃；“steal”的现在分词
words.ex: The act of stealing is illegal and unethical.
words.ex_cn: 偷窃行为是非法且不道德的。
words.en: The act of taking something that belongs to someone else without their permission.

words.ex: He read an abridged version of the novel.
words.ex_cn: 他读了这本小说的简写版。
words.en: An abridged book or document has been made shorter by removing some parts of it.

words.tr:
adj. 犯罪的；
n. 罪犯；
words.ex: He made a criminal mistake by stealing money.
words.ex_cn: 他偷钱犯了一个犯罪的错误。
words.en: A criminal is a person who has committed a crime.

words.ex: The project entailed a lot of research.
words.ex_cn: v. 这个项目需要进行大量的研究。
words.en: To involve something as a necessary part or consequence.

words.ex: The book was reissued last year.
words.ex_cn: 这本书去年重新出版了。
words.en: To issue again, especially a publication or financial instrument.

words.tr:
n. 承诺；希望；
v. 有希望；承诺；
words.ex: He made many promises but kept none.
words.ex_cn: 他做了许多承诺，但一个都没兑现。
words.en: A promise is a statement which you make to a person in which you say that you will definitely do something or give them something.

words.ex: The children are drawing in the ateliers.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在工作室里画画。
words.en: An atelier is a workshop or studio, especially one used by an artist or designer.

words.ex: He is exerting pressure on his team to win.
words.ex_cn: 他正在对他的团队施加压力以赢得比赛。
words.en: to use power or influence to affect someone or something

words.ex: The boss appoints her as the new manager.
words.ex_cn: 老板任命她为新经理。
words.en: To appoint someone to a job or position means to give them that job or position.

words.tr: adj. 条顿人的；日耳曼人的；德国的
words.ex: The Teutonic knights were known for their bravery.
words.ex_cn: 条顿骑士以其勇敢著称。
words.en: Relating to the Teutons or their languages; Germanic.

words.ex: He was severely injured in the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故中严重受伤。
words.en: If something is done severely, it is done in a very great or intense degree.

words.tr: n. 检疫证明书；实践；惯例
words.ex: He practices piano every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天练习钢琴。
words.en: A certificate issued to a ship indicating that it is free from contagious diseases and is allowed to enter a port.

words.ex: People in the communes share food and work together.
words.ex_cn: 公社里的人们共享食物并一起劳动。
words.en: A commune is a group of people living together and sharing possessions and responsibilities.

words.ex: The water in the bottle dwindles as he drinks.
words.ex_cn: 他喝水时，瓶中的水逐渐减少。
words.en: If something dwindles, it becomes smaller, weaker, or less in number.

words.tr: n. 平等主义者；使平等的人或物
words.ex: He was known as a great leveller, treating everyone equally regardless of their status.
words.ex_cn: 他被称为伟大的平等主义者，无论地位如何，都平等对待每个人。
words.en: A leveller is someone or something that makes things equal or reduces differences between people or things.

words.tr: adj. 短暂的； v. “fleet”的现在分词；
words.ex: The smile was fleeting.
words.ex_cn: 那个微笑是短暂的。
words.en: If you describe something as fleeting, you mean that it lasts only for a very short time.

words.ex: The workers get high salaries.
words.ex_cn: 工人们获得高薪。
words.en: A salary is the money that someone is paid each month by their employer, especially when they are in a profession such as teaching, law, or medicine.

words.ex: The room is slightly warmer than before.
words.ex_cn: 房间比以前稍微暖和一点。
words.en: To a small degree; not considerably.

words.tr: v．; 1. 使丰富，使充实：增加某物的价值、质量或吸引力。; 2. 使富裕：使某人财富增加。
words.ex: Reading books enriches your mind.
words.ex_cn: 读书丰富了你的思想。
words.en: Adds value or quality to something, making it more substantial or significant; e.g., experience enriches knowledge.

words.ex: He threatened to call the police.
words.ex_cn: 他威胁要叫警察。
words.en: If someone threatens to do something unpleasant to you, or if they threaten you, they say or imply that they will do something unpleasant to you, especially if you do not do what they want.

words.tr: n. 禁欲；独身；独身生活
words.ex: He chose celibacy to focus on his religion.
words.ex_cn: 他选择独身以专注于他的宗教。
words.en: The state of abstaining from marriage and sexual relations.

words.tr: v. 使筋疲力尽；耗尽；详尽论述
words.ex: The long hike completely exhausts me.
words.ex_cn: 这次长途徒步让我筋疲力尽。
words.en: To exhaust means to drain someone of their physical or mental resources, to use up completely, or to discuss a subject thoroughly.

words.ex: The company is tripling its investment in renewable energy.
words.ex_cn: 该公司正在将其在可再生能源上的投资增加到三倍。
words.en: To make or become three times as much or as many.

words.tr: v. 聚集；集合；“gather”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The children gathered around the fire.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们聚集在火堆周围。
words.en: To gather means to bring together or collect from various places or sources.

words.ex: She washed the utensils after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 她晚饭后洗了餐具。
words.en: Utensils are tools that you use in your home, especially in the kitchen, for cooking or eating.

words.ex: The pilot controls the plane with care.
words.ex_cn: 飞行员小心地控制飞机。
words.en: To control something means to have power over it and to be able to make it do what you want.

words.tr: n. 疗法；纠正办法；“remedy”的复数；
words.ex: Natural remedies can help with colds.
words.ex_cn: 自然疗法可以帮助治疗感冒。
words.en: Remedies are methods or treatments intended to correct or improve a situation or condition.

words.tr: adj. 未破的；不间断的；未驯服的（马）
words.ex: The unbroken chain of events led to the accident.
words.ex_cn: 这一连串未被打断的事件导致了事故。
words.en: If something is unbroken, it is continuous or complete and has not been interrupted or damaged.

words.tr: v. 接受；包含；拥抱( embrace的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He embraced the new idea quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快接受了这个新想法。
words.en: To hold someone closely in one's arms, especially as a sign of affection; to accept or support a belief, theory, or change willingly and enthusiastically.

words.ex: The pillars are the main supports of the bridge.
words.ex_cn: 这些柱子是桥的主要支柱。
words.en: If you support someone or their ideas or aims, you agree with them, and perhaps help them because you want them to succeed.

words.ex: The new policy improves worker mobility.
words.ex_cn: 新政策提高了工人的流动性。
words.en: The ability to move or be moved freely and easily.

words.tr: adj. 受尊敬的； v. “esteem”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is an esteemed teacher in the village.
words.ex_cn: 他是村里受尊敬的老师。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as esteemed, you mean that they are highly respected and admired.

words.ex: The company's solvency was in question after the financial scandal.
words.ex_cn: 财务丑闻后，该公司的偿付能力受到了质疑。
words.en: The ability of an individual or entity to meet its financial obligations as they come due.

words.ex: He rubbed his shoulder after lifting the box.
words.ex_cn: 他搬完箱子后揉了揉肩膀。
words.en: The part of the body at each side of the neck where the upper limb or forelimb is attached; to accept or take on (a responsibility or task).

words.tr: v. 排出; 赶走; 驱逐( expel的过去式和过去分词 ); 把…除名
words.ex: The student was expelled from school for cheating.
words.ex_cn: 这名学生因作弊被学校开除。
words.en: If someone is expelled from a school or organization, they are officially told to leave because they have behaved badly.

words.tr: adj. 倾向于…的； v. “incline”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is inclined to help others.
words.ex_cn: 他倾向于帮助别人。
words.en: Having a tendency or preference towards something; likely to do or be something.

words.ex: The universe is very big.
words.ex_cn: 宇宙非常大。
words.en: The universe is the whole of space and everything in it, including stars, planets, and galaxies.

words.tr: v. 强制实施；强制执行
words.ex: The teacher enforces the rules in class.
words.ex_cn: 老师在课堂上执行规则。
words.en: To enforce means to compel observance of or compliance with a law, rule, or obligation.

words.tr:
v. 责备；指责
n. 责备；指责
words.ex: She reproached him for being late.
words.ex_cn: 她责备他迟到了。
words.en: To express disapproval or disappointment towards someone because of their actions or behavior.

words.ex: He felt hopeless after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到毫无希望。
words.en: If you feel hopeless, you feel very unhappy because there seems to be no possibility of a better situation or success.

words.tr: v. 降级；“degrade”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He was degraded for breaking the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他因违反规定而被降级。
words.en: If something is degraded, it has become worse in quality or condition.

words.tr: v. 认定；“presume”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: They presumed him guilty without proof.
words.ex_cn: 他们未经证实就认定他有罪。
words.en: If you presume that something is the case, you think that it is the case, although you are not certain.

words.ex: He believes in leninism as a guide for revolution.
words.ex_cn: 他相信列宁主义是革命的指导原则。
words.en: Leninism is the political theory for the organization of a revolutionary vanguard party and the achievement of a dictatorship of the proletariat as political prelude to the establishment of socialism.

words.tr: n. 创办人；造物者（founder 的复数）
words.ex: The founders of the company were recognized for their innovative ideas.
words.ex_cn: 公司的创办人因其创新理念而受到认可。
words.en: The founders are the people who start something, such as an organization or a business.

words.tr: v. 扫；“sweep”的现在分词； adj. 全面的；
words.ex: He sweeping the floor every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上扫地。
words.en: If you describe something as sweeping, you mean it is very extensive or has a very wide effect.

words.tr: n. 种植；栽种； v. 种植；“plant”的现在分词；
words.ex: Planting trees helps clean the air.
words.ex_cn: 种植树木有助于净化空气。
words.en: The act or process of putting seeds or plants into the ground to grow.

words.ex: The two countries formed an alliance to fight the enemy.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家结成联盟以对抗敌人。
words.en: An alliance is a group of countries or political parties that are formally united and working together because they have similar aims.

words.tr:
n. 大西洋；
adj. 大西洋的；
words.ex: The ship crossed the Atlantic in ten days.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船用了十天时间穿越大西洋。
words.en: The Atlantic is the ocean that lies between the Americas to the west and Europe and Africa to the east.

words.ex: The princess lived in a big castle.
words.ex_cn: 公主住在一座大城堡里。
words.en: A princess is a female member of a royal family, especially a daughter or granddaughter of a king and queen, or the wife of a prince.

words.tr: n. 三十多岁；三十年代
words.ex: She is in her thirties and has already achieved a lot in her career.
words.ex_cn: 她三十多岁，已经在事业上取得了很大的成就。
words.en: The thirties refers to the period of time when someone is between 30 and 39 years old, or the decade from 1930 to 1939.

words.ex: The restaurant serves a famous delicacy called seafood soup.
words.ex_cn: 这家餐厅供应一道著名的佳肴，叫海鲜汤。
words.en: Delicacy refers to the quality of being delicate, fine, or subtle in appearance, structure, or manner. It can also denote a choice or rare food item.

words.ex: The school needs more resources for students.
words.ex_cn: 学校需要为学生提供更多的资源。
words.en: A resource is a source or supply from which benefit is produced. Typically resources are materials, energy, services, staff, knowledge, or other assets that are transformed to produce benefit and in the process may be consumed or made unavailable.

words.ex: The bank was accused of usurious practices.
words.ex_cn: 该银行被指控从事高利贷行为。
words.en: Usurious refers to the practice of lending money at unreasonably high rates of interest.

words.tr: v. （使）变窄； adj. [医]狭窄的 v. （使）变窄( narrow的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The road narrowed near the bridge.
words.ex_cn: 这条路在桥附近变窄了。
words.en: If something narrows, it becomes less wide or less broad.

words.ex: She wears everyday clothes to work.
words.ex_cn: 她穿日常的衣服去上班。
words.en: Something that is everyday is ordinary and common, not special or unusual.

words.ex: He bought a new textbook for math class.
words.ex_cn: 他为数学课买了一本新教科书。
words.en: A textbook is a book containing a comprehensive compilation of content in a branch of study with the intention of explaining it. Textbooks are produced to meet the needs of educators, usually at educational institutions.

words.ex: The invasion of privacy is a serious problem.
words.ex_cn: 侵犯隐私是一个严重的问题。
words.en: An invasion is an instance of invading a country or region with an armed force.

words.tr:
adj. 迟钝的；弱智的；智力发育迟缓的
v. 延迟；弄慢；使耽误；“retard”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: He was called retarded by some kids at school.
words.ex_cn: 他被学校的一些孩子叫做迟钝的。
words.en: Less advanced in mental, physical, or social development than is usual for one's age.

words.ex: He collects stamps from different countries.
words.ex_cn: 他收集来自不同国家的邮票。
words.en: If you collect things, you gather them together over a period of time, usually because you are interested in them.

words.ex: He is interested in politics.
words.ex_cn: 他对政治感兴趣。
words.en: Politics are the actions or activities concerned with achieving and using power in a country or society. The verb that follows politics may be either singular or plural.

words.ex: He was twisting the cap off the bottle.
words.ex_cn: 他正在拧开瓶盖。
words.en: Twisting refers to the action of turning or bending something out of its original shape, or the process of winding or rotating.

words.ex: The train stops at five stations.
words.ex_cn: 火车在五个车站停靠。
words.en: A station is a place where trains, buses, or other vehicles regularly stop so that passengers can get on or off, or goods can be loaded or unloaded. It can also refer to a building or buildings at such a place, or to a company that broadcasts radio or television programmes.

words.ex: He refused to disclose the secret.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝透露这个秘密。
words.en: To disclose information means to make it known to the public.

words.ex: My brothers play soccer every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我的兄弟们每个周末都踢足球。
words.en: A brother is a man or boy in relation to other sons and daughters of his parents.

words.ex: The survival of the animals depends on the weather.
words.ex_cn: 这些动物的生存取决于天气。
words.en: The state or fact of continuing to live or exist, typically in spite of an accident, ordeal, or difficult circumstances.

words.ex: The test confirms that he is healthy.
words.ex_cn: 这个测试证实了他身体健康。
words.en: To confirm something means to establish its truth or validity by providing evidence or testimony.

words.tr: v. 记录；录制；“record”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 已记录的；已录制的；
words.ex: He recorded the meeting on his phone.
words.ex_cn: 他用手机记录了会议。
words.en: To make a permanent copy of sounds or images, especially using electronic equipment.

words.ex: The solidity of the bridge reassured the travelers.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥的可靠性让旅客们感到安心。
words.en: The state or quality of being solid; firmness and stability.

words.ex: He made a proposal to improve the school lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他提出了一个改善学校午餐的提案。
words.en: A proposal is a plan or suggestion, especially a formal one that is put forward for people to think about and decide upon.

words.ex: The teacher will classify the students by age.
words.ex_cn: 老师将按年龄对学生进行分类。
words.en: To classify things means to divide them into groups or types so that things with similar characteristics are in the same group.

words.tr: v. 伪装; 假装( pretend的第三人称单数 ); （尤指儿童）（在游戏中）装扮; 自诩
words.ex: She pretends to be reading a book to avoid conversation.
words.ex_cn: 她假装在看书，以避免交谈。
words.en: If someone pretends to be something that they are not, they behave in a way that is intended to make people believe that they are that thing, usually in order to deceive someone.

words.tr: n. 载体；运送者；运输公司
words.ex: The airline is one of the largest carriers in the world.
words.ex_cn: 这家航空公司是世界上最大的运输公司之一。
words.en: A carrier is a person or thing that carries, holds, or conveys something.

words.ex: He opened his umbrella when it started to rain.
words.ex_cn: 天下雨时，他打开了伞。
words.en: An umbrella is a device consisting of a circular canopy of fabric on a folding metal frame, used as protection against rain or sunlight.

words.ex: She utilises her time wisely to complete all her tasks.
words.ex_cn: 她明智地利用时间来完成所有任务。
words.en: To utilise something means to use it for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He made a careless mistake on the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试中犯了一个粗心的错误。
words.en: If you are careless, you do not pay enough attention to what you are doing, and so you make mistakes, or cause harm or damage.

words.ex: The mechanic fixed my car quickly.
words.ex_cn: 机修工很快修好了我的车。
words.en: A mechanic is a person whose job is to repair and maintain machines and engines, especially those of vehicles.

words.ex: Goodness, I didn't expect to see you here!
words.ex_cn: 天哪，我没料到会在这里见到你！
words.en: Goodness is the quality of being kind, helpful, and honest.

words.tr: v. 阻止；起源于；n. 词干提取
words.ex: The new law is stemming the flow of illegal goods.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法律正在阻止非法商品的流入。
words.en: The process of reducing words to their base or root form, or the act of stopping or restricting something.

words.tr: v. 攻击；进攻；抨击；非难；损害；攻击，进攻，抨击( attack的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The dog attacked the mailman.
words.ex_cn: 狗攻击了邮递员。
words.en: To attack someone or something means to try to hurt or damage them using physical violence.

words.tr: n. 财富；运气；命运；“fortune”的复数
words.ex: He lost all his fortunes in the stock market.
words.ex_cn: 他在股市中失去了全部财产。
words.en: Fortune refers to a large amount of money or assets, or the chance of something happening, especially something that affects your life.

words.ex: He swindles people out of their money with fake investment schemes.
words.ex_cn: 他通过虚假的投资计划骗取人们的钱。
words.en: To swindle means to cheat or defraud someone, typically by persuading them to part with money or property through deception.

words.ex: He tried to decipher the secret code.
words.ex_cn: 他试图破译那个秘密代码。
words.en: To decipher something means to convert it from a code into normal language or to understand something that is difficult to understand or that is not obvious.

words.ex: He is checking the answers before submitting.
words.ex_cn: 他在提交前检查答案。
words.en: The act of examining something to determine its accuracy, quality, or condition, or a type of bank account that allows you to write checks against the money you have deposited.

words.tr: n. 穿衣； v. “dress”的现在分词；
words.ex: Every morning, she makes a quick dressing before leaving home.
words.ex_cn: 每天早上，她出门前都会快速穿衣。
words.en: A dressing is a sauce, especially one consisting of oil and vinegar mixed together with herbs or other flavorings, which you put on salad or other foods.

words.ex: Latterly, she has been focusing more on her health.
words.ex_cn: adv. 最近，她更加关注自己的健康。
words.en: In recent times; recently.

words.ex: The old man is the guardian of his grandchildren.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人是他的孙子孙女的保护人。
words.en: A guardian is someone who has the legal authority and responsibility to take care of someone else, especially a child whose parents have died.

words.ex: The prophets in the Bible often delivered messages from God.
words.ex_cn: 圣经中的先知经常传达来自上帝的信息。
words.en: A prophet is a person who is believed to be chosen by God to speak on his behalf and to lead people in the right way.

words.tr: n. 勾缝; 弄尖，指示; 磨尖
words.ex: The mason carefully applied the pointing to the brickwork.
words.ex_cn: 泥瓦匠仔细地在砖缝中勾缝。
words.en: The act of directing someone's attention to something by extending a finger or other object towards it.

words.ex: Rivers carry sediment to the sea.
words.ex_cn: 河流把沉积物带到大海。
words.en: Material that settles to the bottom of a liquid; matter that has been deposited by some natural process.

words.ex: She squeezes the lemon to get the juice.
words.ex_cn: 她挤压柠檬以获取果汁。
words.en: To press something firmly, especially from all sides in order to change its shape, reduce its size, or remove liquid from it.

words.ex: He has the usufruct of the property but does not own it.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有该财产的用益权，但并不拥有它。
words.en: The legal right to use and derive profit or benefit from property that belongs to another person, as long as the property is not damaged or altered.

words.ex: The shepherd walks with his sheep every morning.
words.ex_cn: 牧羊人每天早上都带着他的羊走路。
words.en: A shepherd is a person whose job is to look after sheep. As a verb, it means to guide or direct someone or something in a particular direction.

words.tr:
adj. 居住的；常驻的；
n. 常住居民；
words.ex: The resident population grew last year.
words.ex_cn: 居住人口去年增加了。
words.en: A resident is someone who lives in a particular place or a person who has their home in a place.

words.tr: adj. 边缘的；页边的；微不足道的；不重要的
words.ex: The village is on the marginal area of the city.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄位于城市的边缘地区。
words.en: If you describe something as marginal, you mean that it is small or not very important.

words.tr: adj. 忠实的；虔诚的；可靠的；
words.ex: He is a faithful friend who always helps me.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个总是帮助我的忠实朋友。
words.en: Someone who is faithful remains loyal to a person, belief, or cause, and continues to support them.

words.ex: The radio transmits music to listeners.
words.ex_cn: 收音机将音乐传递给听众。
words.en: To send or pass something from one person, place, or thing to another.

words.ex: This information is relevant to our project.
words.ex_cn: 这些信息与我们的项目相关。
words.en: Something that is relevant to a situation or person is important or significant in that situation or to that person.

words.tr: v. 膨胀；肿胀；“swell”的现在分词；
words.ex: The wound is swelling after the injury.
words.ex_cn: 受伤后伤口在肿胀。
words.en: An abnormal enlargement of a part of the body, typically as a result of an accumulation of fluid.

words.tr: v. 忍住；克制；“withhold”的过去式及过去分词；
words.ex: He withheld his tears during the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他在看电影时忍住了眼泪。
words.en: Kept back or not given or allowed.

words.tr: v. 补救；纠正( repair的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He repaired the mistake by apologizing.
words.ex_cn: 他通过道歉来补救这个错误。
words.en: To fix something that is broken or damaged.

words.ex: He showed goodwill by helping his neighbor for free.
words.ex_cn: 他通过免费帮助邻居表现出善意。
words.en: A friendly or cooperative attitude or feeling towards others, especially in a business context.

words.ex: He preached about the importance of kindness.
words.ex_cn: 他宣扬了善良的重要性。
words.en: To preach means to deliver a sermon or religious address to an assembled group of people, typically in a church. It can also mean to earnestly advocate a belief or course of action.

words.ex: He learned basic math concepts in primary school.
words.ex_cn: 他在小学学习了基本的数学概念。
words.en: A concept is an idea or abstract principle.

words.tr: v. 分配；“allocate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The teacher allocated books to each student.
words.ex_cn: 老师给每个学生分配了书籍。
words.en: If something is allocated to a particular person or for a particular purpose, it is given to that person or used for that purpose.

words.tr: v. 驳回；解雇( dismiss的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The judge dismissed the case.
words.ex_cn: 法官驳回了此案。
words.en: Rejected or disregarded as not worthy of consideration.

words.tr: n. 牧羊人；羊倌；牧羊人，羊倌( shepherd的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The shepherds walk with their sheep in the hills.
words.ex_cn: 牧羊人带着他们的羊在山上行走。
words.en: Shepherds are people who take care of sheep. They guide and protect the sheep, often leading them to places where they can graze. In a broader sense, the term can also refer to someone who guides or directs others, such as a spiritual leader or mentor.

words.ex: The corporate office is in New York.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司的总部在纽约。
words.en: Corporate relates to large companies or to a particular large company.

words.tr: v. 使充实，使丰富；使富裕，使富有；使（土壤）肥沃（enrich 的现在分词）
words.ex: Reading books can be an enriching experience.
words.ex_cn: 阅读书籍可以是一种充实的体验。
words.en: To make something richer or more meaningful.

words.tr: v. 强制实施；强制执行
words.ex: The police are enforcing the new traffic laws.
words.ex_cn: 警察正在强制执行新的交通法规。
words.en: To enforce means to make sure that people obey a particular law or rule.

words.ex: The craftsman made a wooden chair by hand.
words.ex_cn: 这位工匠手工制作了一把木椅。
words.en: A craftsman is a skilled worker who makes things by hand.

words.ex: The unemployment rate is an economic indicator.
words.ex_cn: 失业率是一个经济指标。
words.en: An indicator is a measurement or value which gives you an idea of what something is like.

words.tr: adj. 无数的；多的；数不清的；
words.ex: There are countless stars in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 夜空中有无数颗星星。
words.en: Too numerous to count.

words.ex: The two parts of the machine are separable for easier transport.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器的两部分可以分离，以便于运输。
words.en: Capable of being separated or divided.

words.ex: He read the footnotes at the bottom of the page.
words.ex_cn: 他读了页面底部的脚注。
words.en: Footnotes are notes at the bottom of a page that provide additional information or references for the reader.

words.ex: He is utilising old bottles to make planters.
words.ex_cn: 他正利用旧瓶子来做花盆。
words.en: To use something effectively for a particular purpose.

words.tr: v．揭示，透露，公开：使（信息、事实等）为人所知，尤指原本是秘密的或未知的。
words.ex: The report discloses the extent of the company's financial problems.
words.ex_cn: 报告揭示了公司财务问题的严重程度。
words.en: If you disclose new or secret information, you tell people about it.

words.tr: adj. 在职的；负有义务的；
words.ex: The incumbent mayor won the election again.
words.ex_cn: 现任市长再次赢得了选举。
words.en: An incumbent is someone who currently holds a particular office or position, especially in politics. It can also refer to something that is necessary as a duty or responsibility.

words.ex: He was responsible for procuring the necessary materials for the project.
words.ex_cn: 他负责为项目获取必要的材料。
words.en: To obtain something, especially with care or effort.

words.ex: He felt weariness after working all day.
words.ex_cn: 他工作了一整天后感到疲惫。
words.en: A feeling of being extremely tired, either physically or mentally.

words.tr: n. 收集；采集；聚会；聚集； v. 聚集；集合；“gather”的现在分词；
words.ex: The gathering of old books took him years.
words.ex_cn: 收集旧书花了他多年时间。
words.en: A gathering is a group of people meeting together for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The reservoir provides water for the nearby town.
words.ex_cn: 这个水库为附近的城镇提供水源。
words.en: A reservoir is a large quantity of a substance that is stored and can be used when needed.

words.tr: adv. 与此；与之；随即；立即
words.ex: He signed the contract, therewith agreeing to the terms.
words.ex_cn: 他签署了合同，从而同意了条款。
words.en: Therewith is used to indicate that something happens immediately after something else or as a result of it.

words.ex: There is no certainty that it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天是否会下雨还没有确定。
words.en: Something that is certain is sure to happen or is definitely true.

words.ex: She consented to the proposal without hesitation.
words.ex_cn: 她毫不犹豫地同意了那个提议。
words.en: To give permission for something to happen or to agree to do something.

words.tr: prep. 除…外 conj. 除非，除…之外 v. 略去( except的现在分词 ); 不计;
words.ex: Everyone went to the park excepting Tom.
words.ex_cn: 除了汤姆，大家都去了公园。
words.en: Excluding or other than; used to introduce an exception.

words.tr:
adj. 吓呆的；惊呆的；目瞪口呆的
v. （使）石化；（使）僵化；吓呆；“petrify”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: She stood petrified at the sight of the snake.
words.ex_cn: 她看到蛇时吓得呆住了。
words.en: If you are petrified, you are extremely frightened, perhaps so frightened that you cannot think or move.

words.tr: n. 铁路，铁道( railroad的名词复数 ); 铁路系统 v. 铁路，铁道( railroad
words.ex: The children saw many railroads near the town.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在小镇附近看到了许多铁路。
words.en: A railroad is a permanent road having a line of rails fixed to ties and laid on a roadbed and providing a track for cars or equipment drawn by locomotives or propelled by self-contained motors.

words.ex: He prudently saved his money for the future.
words.ex_cn: 他谨慎地为将来存钱。
words.en: In a way that shows care and thought for the future.

words.ex: The sugar dissolved in the water.
words.ex_cn: 糖溶解在水里。
words.en: Having been broken down or dispersed in a liquid; having been officially ended or dismissed.

words.tr: v. 承认；允许进入；“admit”的现在分词
words.ex: He is admitting his mistake to the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他正在向老师承认自己的错误。
words.en: If you admit that something bad, unpleasant, or embarrassing is true, you agree, often unwillingly, that it is true.

words.ex: The frenchman speaks French and loves wine.
words.ex_cn: 这位法国人会说法语，而且喜欢葡萄酒。
words.en: A Frenchman is a man who comes from France.

words.ex: The price of bread went up because of inflation.
words.ex_cn: 由于通货膨胀，面包的价格上涨了。
words.en: Inflation is a general increase in prices and fall in the purchasing value of money.

words.ex: The sentence has ambiguity because it can mean two things.
words.ex_cn: 这句话有歧义，因为它可以有两种意思。
words.en: If you say that there is ambiguity in something, you mean that it is unclear or confusing, or it can be understood in more than one way.

words.tr: adj. 有资格的；合格的； v. 取得资格；“qualify”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is a qualified teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有资格的老师。
words.en: Having the necessary qualifications for a particular job or task.

words.tr: v. 居住于；栖息；“inhabit”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The island is inhabited by a small community.
words.ex_cn: 这个岛屿上住着一个小社区。
words.en: If a place or region is inhabited by a group of people or a species of animal, those people or animals live there.

words.ex: The farmer is ploughing the field in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 农民在早上耕作田地。
words.en: Ploughing is the process of turning over the earth with a plough, especially before seeds are planted.

words.ex: The child showed obedience to his parents.
words.ex_cn: 孩子对父母表现出顺从。
words.en: Obedience is the act of following orders or instructions from someone in authority.

words.ex: The teacher intervened when the students argued.
words.ex_cn: 当学生们争吵时，老师进行了干涉。
words.en: If you intervene in a situation, you become involved in it and try to change it.

words.ex: The government abolishes outdated laws to improve the legal system.
words.ex_cn: 政府废除过时的法律以改善法律体系。
words.en: To officially end a law, system, practice, etc.

words.tr: n. 钢铁厂；铁器制造厂
words.ex: The old ironworks has been converted into a museum.
words.ex_cn: n. 这座老钢铁厂已被改造成博物馆。
words.en: An ironworks is a factory where iron is smelted or iron goods are made.

words.ex: The main criterion for winning is fairness.
words.ex_cn: 获胜的主要标准是公平。
words.en: A criterion is a principle or standard by which something may be judged or decided.

words.tr: adj. 十年的，每十年一次的
words.ex: The government conducts a decennial census to track population changes.
words.ex_cn: 政府每十年进行一次人口普查以追踪人口变化。
words.en: adj. Relating to a period of ten years or occurring every ten years.

words.ex: His quickness helped him win the race.
words.ex_cn: 他的敏捷帮助他赢得了比赛。
words.en: The quality of moving fast or doing something in a short time.

words.tr: n. 村舍居住者；农舍居住者
words.ex: The cottagers enjoyed the peaceful life in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 村舍居住者享受着乡村的宁静生活。
words.en: People who live in cottages, typically in rural areas.

words.ex: The milliners on the high street are known for their elegant designs.
words.ex_cn: n. 这条商业街上的女帽店以其优雅的设计而闻名。
words.en: A milliner is a person who designs, makes, or sells women's hats.

words.tr: n. 毛里求斯（非洲东部岛国）
words.ex: He lives in Mauritius with his family.
words.ex_cn: 他和家人住在毛里求斯。
words.en: An island country in the Indian Ocean, known for its beaches, lagoons, and reefs.

words.ex: Sugar dissolves in water.
words.ex_cn: 糖在水中溶解。
words.en: To dissolve means to mix a solid substance with a liquid so that it becomes part of the liquid, or to officially end a group or organization.

words.ex: The debate could go on infinitum without a clear resolution.
words.ex_cn: 这场辩论可能会无止境地进行下去，没有明确的解决方案。
words.en: To an infinite extent; endlessly.

words.tr: adj. 赞成的；有利的；嘉许的；
words.ex: The teacher gave a favorable comment on my essay.
words.ex_cn: 老师对我的作文给予了赞成的评价。
words.en: If something makes a favorable impression on you or is favorable to you, you like it or approve of it.

words.ex: The radio station transmits news every hour.
words.ex_cn: v. 广播电台每小时传送新闻。
words.en: To send or pass from one person, place, or thing to another.

words.tr: adj. 赚大钱的；获利多的；
words.ex: He took a lucrative job at a tech company.
words.ex_cn: 他去了一家科技公司做一份赚大钱的工作。
words.en: A lucrative activity or job is one that you can earn a lot of money from.

words.ex: The small village lies on the periphery of the city.
words.ex_cn: 这个小村庄位于城市的外围。
words.en: The outer limits or edge of an area or object.

words.ex: The proximity of the school to the park makes it nice for kids.
words.ex_cn: 学校靠近公园，对孩子们来说很好。
words.en: Proximity refers to the state of being near in space or time.

words.tr: n. 记录员；登记员；教务主任
words.ex: The registrar gave me my schedule.
words.ex_cn: 注册处给我发了课表。
words.en: A registrar is an official keeper of records, especially in an educational institution, who is responsible for student records and registration.

words.ex: I left my keys somewhere in the house.
words.ex_cn: 我把钥匙落在房子的某个地方了。
words.en: In or to some place.

words.tr: adj. 失去知觉的；无意义的；无目的的；不明智的
words.ex: After the accident, he was senseless on the ground.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他倒在地下，失去了知觉。
words.en: If you describe an action as senseless, you think it is wrong because it has no purpose and produces no benefit.

words.ex: He faced expulsion for breaking the school rules.
words.ex_cn: 他因违反校规而被开除。
words.en: Expulsion is the act of forcing someone to leave a place, especially a school or a country, as a punishment or because they are not wanted there.

words.tr: v. 宣布( declare的现在分词 ); 断言; 申报（收益）; 板球（在击球员还未全部出局时）
words.ex: The government is declaring a state of emergency.
words.ex_cn: 政府正在宣布进入紧急状态。
words.en: Stating something clearly and formally, often in a legal or official context.

words.ex: The stylistic choice of words made the poem more beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 词语的文体选择使这首诗更加优美。
words.en: Relating to the style or manner of something, especially in literature or art.

words.ex: The conqueror took control of the small village.
words.ex_cn: 征服者控制了这个小村庄。
words.en: A conqueror is someone who conquers a country or group of people.

words.ex: They are restoring the old house.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在修复这座老房子。
words.en: To bring back or re-establish (a previous right, practice, custom, or situation); to return (someone or something) to a former condition, place, or position.

words.tr: v. 在重量上超过( outweigh的第三人称单数 ); 在重要性或价值方面超过
words.ex: Her kindness outweighs her mistakes.
words.ex_cn: 她的善良胜过她的错误。
words.en: outweighs: Is more significant or important than something else.

words.tr: adj. 强烈的; 强壮的; 强的( strong的最高级 ); 坚强的
words.ex: He is the strongest man I have ever seen.
words.ex_cn: 他是我见过的最强壮的人。
words.en: Having the greatest power, intensity, or durability; the most robust or effective.

words.ex: His intellect helps him solve difficult problems.
words.ex_cn: 他的智力帮助他解决难题。
words.en: The ability to understand and think in a logical way about things.

words.tr:
n. 划分；隔离物；分割
v. 分开；隔开
words.ex: The partition of the room made it more private.
words.ex_cn: 房间的隔断让它更私密了。
words.en: A partition is a wall, screen, or divider that separates one part of a room, vehicle, or other space from another.

words.tr: n. 刑罚；惩罚；惩罚( penalty的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The judge gave heavy penalties for stealing.
words.ex_cn: 法官对盗窃行为施加了严厉的刑罚。
words.en: Punishments or sanctions imposed for breaking rules or laws.

words.ex: She eats healthful food every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天吃健康的食物。
words.en: Conducive to good health; health-giving.

words.ex: Many religions teach kindness and peace.
words.ex_cn: 许多宗教教导善良与和平。
words.en: A religion is a particular system of belief in a god or gods and the activities that are connected with this system.

words.tr: adj. 造成严重后果的； v. “cripple”的现在分词；
words.ex: The earthquake caused crippling damage to the city.
words.ex_cn: 地震给这座城市造成了严重的破坏。
words.en: Causing severe damage or impairment, often leading to a state of being unable to function effectively.

words.tr: v. 将…分成若干部分；打包
words.ex: She parcelled the gifts for each child.
words.ex_cn: v. 她为每个孩子打包了礼物。
words.en: To divide something into parts and distribute it.

words.tr:
v. 遭遇；遇到；邂逅；
n. 遭遇；
words.ex: He encountered a bear while hiking in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 他在森林里徒步时遭遇了一只熊。
words.en: If you encounter problems or difficulties, you experience them.

words.tr:
adj. 精心制作的；详尽的；
v. 精心制作；详尽阐述；
words.ex: She wore an elaborate dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件精心制作的裙子去参加派对。
words.en: To elaborate means to add more details to something that has already been said or written, making it more complex or detailed. As an adjective, it describes something that is very complex and detailed.

words.tr: n. 移民；移居外国的人
words.ex: Many emigrants left their home country in search of a better life.
words.ex_cn: 许多移民离开他们的祖国，寻求更好的生活。
words.en: Emigrants are people who leave their own country to live in another country.

words.ex: The disease can cause temporary paralyses in the limbs.
words.ex_cn: 这种疾病可能导致四肢暂时性瘫痪。
words.en: Paralyses refers to the loss of the ability to move (and sometimes to feel anything) in part or most of the body, typically as a result of illness, poison, or injury.

words.ex: The police arrested several swindlers who were involved in the online scam.
words.ex_cn: 警方逮捕了几名参与网络诈骗的骗子。
words.en: Swindlers are people who deceive others in order to gain money or other benefits dishonestly.

words.tr: n. 业务；练习；实践；惯常做法；“practice”的复数；
words.ex: The company improves its business practices every year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司每年都会改进其业务。
words.en: The act of doing something regularly or repeatedly to improve skill or to follow a custom or law.

words.ex: Each family was given an allotment of land to farm.
words.ex_cn: 每个家庭都被分配了一块土地来耕种。
words.en: An allotment is a share or portion of something that has been divided or distributed.

words.tr: adj. 执拗的；固执的；顽固的；
words.ex: He is obstinate and won't change his mind.
words.ex_cn: 他很执拗，不肯改变主意。
words.en: If you describe someone as obstinate, you are being critical of them because they are very determined to do what they want, and refuse to change their mind or be persuaded to do something else.

words.ex: The book was reprinted due to high demand.
words.ex_cn: 由于需求量大，这本书被重印了。
words.en: To print again; to produce a new edition of a previously printed work.

words.tr: n. 贵族身份；贵族地位；贵族的领地
words.ex: The lordships of the medieval era held vast estates.
words.ex_cn: 中世纪的贵族拥有广阔的领地。
words.en: Lordships refer to the status or rank of a lord, or the territories and estates controlled by a lord.

words.ex: He plays violin in a local orchestra.
words.ex_cn: 他在一个本地管弦乐队中拉小提琴。
words.en: An orchestra is a large group of musicians who play a variety of different instruments together. Orchestras usually play classical music.

words.ex: He was known as the moneybags of the town because of his vast wealth.
words.ex_cn: 他因为巨大的财富被称为镇上的富翁。
words.en: A very rich person.

words.ex: The scientist examined the specimens under a microscope.
words.ex_cn: 科学家在显微镜下检查了这些标本。
words.en: A specimen is a single example of something, such as a plant, animal, or mineral, that is used as a typical example of its kind.

words.ex: The movie showed an unnatural movement of the trees.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影展示了树木不合自然规律的运动。
words.en: If you describe something as unnatural, you mean that it is not normal or not what you usually expect, especially in a way that is unpleasant or worrying.

words.ex: The goods were consigned to the warehouse for storage.
words.ex_cn: 货物被委托给仓库进行存储。
words.en: To consign something means to send it to someone for them to sell or look after.

words.ex: She often indulges in fantasies about traveling the world.
words.ex_cn: 她经常沉浸在环游世界的幻想中。
words.en: Fantasies are pleasant or exciting thoughts about something that you would like to happen or that you imagine happening.

words.ex: He has written several treatises on ancient philosophy.
words.ex_cn: 他写了几篇关于古代哲学的论文。
words.en: A treatise is a formal and systematic written discourse on some subject, generally longer and more detailed than an essay.

words.tr:
adj. 就职的；开幕的；创立的
n. 就职演说
words.ex: He gave his inaugural speech last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚发表了就职演讲。
words.en: An inaugural event or speech is the first in a series planned to celebrate or introduce something.

words.tr: v. 察觉；“perceive”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He perceived a change in her voice.
words.ex_cn: 他察觉到她的声音有了变化。
words.en: If you perceive something, you see, notice, or realize it, especially when it is not obvious.

words.tr: adv. 逻辑上；合乎逻辑地；
words.ex: He solved the problem logically.
words.ex_cn: 他逻辑上解决了这个问题。
words.en: In a way that is reasonable and based on good judgment.

words.ex: The dog has parasites in its stomach.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗的胃里有寄生虫。
words.en: An organism that lives in or on another organism (its host) and benefits by deriving nutrients at the host's expense.

words.tr: n. 停工；罢工；停止；堵塞
words.ex: The factory experienced frequent stoppages due to machinery breakdowns.
words.ex_cn: 由于机器故障，工厂经常停工。
words.en: Stoppages refer to the act of stopping or the state of being stopped, often used in the context of work halts due to strikes or machinery failures.

words.ex: The plebeians were not allowed to hold public office in ancient Rome.
words.ex_cn: 在古罗马，平民不允许担任公职。
words.en: In ancient Rome, the plebeians were the general body of free Roman citizens who were not patricians, as determined by birth.

words.ex: The students were variously dressed for the party.
words.ex_cn: 学生们穿着各种不同的衣服去参加派对。
words.en: In different ways or at different times.

words.ex: The country expanded its territory after the war.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家在战争后扩大了它的领土。
words.en: An area of land that is controlled by a particular country, ruler, or military force.

words.tr: v. 销声匿迹；突然消失；“vanish”的现在分词
words.ex: The vanishing act of the magician amazed the audience.
words.ex_cn: 魔术师的消失术让观众惊叹不已。
words.en: If someone or something vanishes, they disappear suddenly or in a way that cannot be explained.

words.ex: He radically changed his mind about the plan.
words.ex_cn: 他彻底改变了对这个计划的想法。
words.en: In a way that is very different from the usual or traditional way.

words.ex: The pendulum oscillate slowly.
words.ex_cn: 钟摆缓慢地摆动。
words.en: If an object oscillates, it moves repeatedly from one position to another and back again, or if a figure or value oscillates, it keeps moving up and down.

words.tr: v. 两件或更多的事情同时发生；想法、意见等相同；两件或更多的事情同时发生( coincide的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The meeting coincided with the rainstorm.
words.ex_cn: 会议与暴雨同时发生。
words.en: If one event coincides with another, they happen at the same time. If ideas or opinions coincide, they are the same or very similar.

words.tr:
adj. 思想解放的
v. 解放；释放；“liberate”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: The prisoners were liberated last week.
words.ex_cn: 这些囚犯上周被释放了。
words.en: If someone is liberated, they have been freed from a system, situation, or set of ideas that limits them in some way.

words.tr: n. 露天看台；露天座位
words.ex: The fans filled the bleachers to watch the game.
words.ex_cn: 球迷们填满了露天看台观看比赛。
words.en: The bleachers are the raised, tiered rows of benches found at sports fields and other venues, where spectators sit to watch the event.

words.ex: He exhibited his paintings at the gallery.
words.ex_cn: 他在画廊展示了他画作。
words.en: To show something publicly, especially in an art gallery or museum, or to show a particular quality or ability.

words.ex: The teacher announces the test date tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 老师宣布明天考试。
words.en: To make a public or formal statement about a fact, occurrence, or intention.

words.tr: n. 口袋布；v. 把…放入口袋
words.ex: She was pocketing the change after paying for her groceries.
words.ex_cn: 她在支付完杂货后把零钱放进口袋。
words.en: The act of putting something into a pocket or the material used to make pockets.

words.tr: adj. 教区的；地方范围的；思想狭隘的
words.ex: The priest served in a small parochial church.
words.ex_cn: 牧师在一座小型教区教堂服务。
words.en: If you describe someone as parochial, you are criticizing them because you think they are too concerned with their own affairs and should be thinking about more important things.

words.ex: She entrusted her savings to a reliable financial advisor.
words.ex_cn: 她把她的积蓄委托给了一位可靠的财务顾问。
words.en: If you entrust something important to someone, you give them the responsibility of looking after it or dealing with it.

words.ex: The young manager is the successor to the CEO.
words.ex_cn: 这位年轻经理是首席执行官的接班人。
words.en: A successor is a person who takes a job or position previously held by someone else.

words.ex: The bright light stimulated her eyes.
words.ex_cn: 强烈的光线刺激了她的眼睛。
words.en: To stimulate something means to encourage it to begin or develop further.

words.ex: His sentiment about the new policy is positive.
words.ex_cn: 他对新政策的看法是积极的。
words.en: A sentiment is a thought, opinion, or idea based on a feeling about a situation, or a way of thinking about something.

words.ex: He is eminently qualified for the job.
words.ex_cn: 他不寻常地适合这份工作。
words.en: To an eminent degree; very.

words.ex: The car was deviating from its lane.
words.ex_cn: 汽车偏离了车道。
words.en: To deviate means to depart from an established course or norm.

words.ex: He accepted liability for the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他承担了事故的责任。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is a liability, you mean that they cause a lot of problems or embarrassment.

words.tr:
adj. 巴西的；
n. 巴西人；
words.ex: She loves Brazilian music.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢巴西音乐。
words.en: Brazilian means belonging or relating to Brazil, or to its people or culture.

words.ex: She has two daughters.
words.ex_cn: 她有两个女儿。
words.en: Daughters are female children in relation to their parents.

words.tr: n. （色彩、颜色、次序、音调等的）渐变；分等级；（各种状态、性质等的）分阶段渐变；元音交替
words.ex: The gradation of colors in the sunset is beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 日落时颜色的渐变很美。
words.en: A gradation is a series or a process in which things change into other things gradually and usually by very small stages.

words.ex: Good digestion helps your body absorb nutrients.
words.ex_cn: 良好的消化有助于身体吸收营养。
words.en: The process by which food is broken down in the stomach and intestines so that the body can absorb it and use it for energy and nutrients.

words.ex: She is focused on attaining her career goals.
words.ex_cn: 她专注于实现她的职业目标。
words.en: To attain means to achieve something, especially after a lot of effort.

words.ex: He speculates that it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他推测明天会下雨。
words.en: If you speculate about something, you make guesses about its nature or identity, or about what might happen.

words.ex: Alexander the Great was one of the most successful military commanders in history.
words.ex_cn: 亚历山大大帝是历史上最成功的军事指挥官之一。
words.en: A male given name of Greek origin meaning 'defender of the people'.

words.ex: He was overtaken by the faster car near the finish line.
words.ex_cn: 他在终点线附近被那辆更快的车赶超了。
words.en: To catch up with and pass while traveling in the same direction.

words.tr: adv. 令人伤心地；令人遗憾地
words.ex: She unhappily discovered that she had left her keys at home.
words.ex_cn: 她遗憾地发现她把钥匙忘在家里了。
words.en: In a manner that is not happy; sadly or unfortunately.

words.ex: He showed restraint when he stayed calm during the argument.
words.ex_cn: 他在争论中保持冷静，表现出了克制。
words.en: Restraint is a measure or condition that keeps someone or something under control or within limits.

words.ex: He will assuredly finish his homework tonight.
words.ex_cn: 他今晚一定会完成作业。
words.en: Without any doubt; certainly.

words.ex: The teacher inspected the students' homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师检查了学生的作业。
words.en: To inspect means to look at something carefully in order to assess its condition or to discover any shortcomings.

words.ex: The long walk was fatiguing.
words.ex_cn: 长时间的步行让人感到疲惫。
words.en: Causing tiredness or exhaustion.

words.ex: The rebellion against the king failed.
words.ex_cn: 反对国王的叛乱失败了。
words.en: A rebellion is an organized attempt to overthrow a government or authority by a group of people.

words.ex: The child's emulation of his father made everyone laugh.
words.ex_cn: 孩子模仿父亲的样子让所有人都笑了。
words.en: Emulation is the effort or desire to equal or surpass another in some achievement or quality, often through imitation.

words.ex: The teacher has an assistant to help with grading.
words.ex_cn: 老师有一个助理帮忙批改作业。
words.en: An assistant is a person who helps in particular work or who is under the authority of another person.

words.ex: The frequency of the radio station is 101.5 MHz.
words.ex_cn: 这个电台的频率是101.5兆赫。
words.en: The rate at which something happens or is repeated over a particular period of time.

words.tr: v. 承认；认出；“recognize”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 公认的；
words.ex: The school recognized his talent in music.
words.ex_cn: 学校承认了他在音乐方面的才能。
words.en: If someone or something is recognized, it is generally accepted that they have a particular status or position, or that they are of a particular quality.

words.ex: He felt discontent with his job.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的工作感到不满。
words.en: Discontent is a feeling of being unhappy because you are not satisfied with your situation or with what you have.

words.tr: n. 献祭; 祭品; 牺牲( sacrifice的名词复数 ); 舍身 v. 牺牲，献出( sacr
words.ex: The ancient Greeks used animals as sacrifices to their gods.
words.ex_cn: 古希腊人用动物作为献给神的祭品。
words.en: If you sacrifice something that is valuable or important, you give it up, usually to obtain something else for yourself or for other people.

words.ex: He is methodical in organizing his work.
words.ex_cn: 他在安排工作时很有条理。
words.en: If you describe someone as methodical, you mean that they do things carefully, thoroughly, and in order.

words.ex: He learned telegraphy to send messages across long distances.
words.ex_cn: 他学习电信技术以发送长距离信息。
words.en: Telegraphy is the long-distance transmission of textual or symbolic messages without the physical exchange of an object bearing the message.

words.tr: n. 医生，内科医生；医生，内科医生( physician的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The physicians worked hard to help the patients.
words.ex_cn: 医生们努力帮助病人。
words.en: Medical doctors who diagnose and treat illnesses and injuries.

words.ex: She recognises him from the photo.
words.ex_cn: 她从照片中认出了他。
words.en: To identify someone or something from previous encounters or knowledge; to acknowledge the existence, validity, or legality of something.

words.tr: v. 指派; 指出( designate的第三人称单数 ); 命名; 标明
words.ex: The sign designates the exit.
words.ex_cn: 这个标志指示出口。
words.en: To officially choose or assign someone to a specific role or position.

words.tr: adj. 传染性的；有感染力的；
words.ex: The flu is contagious and spreads easily.
words.ex_cn: 流感具有传染性，容易传播。
words.en: A contagious disease can be caught by touching someone who has the disease or by touching an infected object or by breathing in infected air.

words.tr: n. <英>尽力，竭力( endeavour的名词复数 ) v. 努力，尽力，竭力( endeavo
words.ex: His endeavours to learn English are impressive.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习英语的行为令人钦佩。
words.en: Attempts or strives to achieve something, especially with effort and determination.

words.ex: The artist used subtle gradations of color to create a sense of depth.
words.ex_cn: 艺术家使用了微妙的色彩渐变来营造深度感。
words.en: Gradations refer to a series of small, subtle, or barely noticeable differences or stages in a process or change.

words.ex: He loves to talk about his adventures in the jungle.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢谈论他在丛林中的冒险经历。
words.en: Adventures refer to exciting or very unusual experiences, or the participation in exciting undertakings or enterprises.

words.tr: n. 出师的学徒工；熟练工
words.ex: He is a journeyman plumber who fixes pipes.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名熟练的水管工，负责修理管道。
words.en: A journeyman is a worker who has completed an apprenticeship and is fully trained in a particular trade or craft, but is not yet a master.

words.tr: adj. 极无礼的；粗暴的；骇人的；
words.ex: His outrageous behavior made everyone angry.
words.ex_cn: 他极无礼的行为让所有人都生气了。
words.en: If you describe something as outrageous, you are emphasizing that it is unacceptable because it is extremely bad, immoral, or shocking.

words.ex: Children enjoy amusements at the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在公园里享受娱乐设施。
words.en: Amusements refer to activities that are enjoyable or entertaining, providing pleasure or relaxation.

words.tr: v. 恢复( recover的现在分词 ); 重新获得; 找回; <正>恢复（适当的状态或位置）
words.ex: She is still recovering from the surgery.
words.ex_cn: 她仍在从手术中恢复。
words.en: The process of returning to a normal state of health, mind, or strength after an illness, injury, or period of difficulty.

words.tr: adj. 惊人的；巨大的；奇异的；巨大的；
words.ex: He showed a prodigious memory for names.
words.ex_cn: 他对名字有着惊人的记忆力。
words.en: If you describe something as prodigious, you are emphasizing that it is very large or impressive.

words.tr: n. 狂喜；欢欣；得意；兴高采烈
words.ex: The crowd's exultation was palpable as the winning goal was scored.
words.ex_cn: 当进球得分时，人群的欢欣之情显而易见。
words.en: A feeling of triumphant elation or jubilation; rejoicing.

words.ex: The fence shows the boundaries of the yard.
words.ex_cn: 这道篱笆显示了院子的边界。
words.en: A boundary is a real or imagined line that marks the edge or limit of something.

words.tr: v.推荐; 建议; 使有优势; 被推崇的
words.ex: The doctor recommends a balanced diet for a healthy lifestyle.
words.ex_cn: 医生建议均衡饮食以保持健康的生活方式。
words.en: If someone recommends a person or thing, they suggest that someone should employ that person or use that thing because they think they are good.

words.ex: He reads newspapers every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上读报纸。
words.en: Newspapers are publications printed on paper and issued regularly, containing news, articles, advertisements, and other information.

words.ex: The workers expressed their grievances about the unfair treatment.
words.ex_cn: 工人们表达了他们对不公平待遇的不满。
words.en: Grievances are complaints or feelings of resentment about something that is considered to be unfair or unjust.

words.ex: I appreciate the beauty of nature.
words.ex_cn: 我欣赏大自然的美。
words.en: If you appreciate something, you recognize its value and feel grateful for it.

words.tr: adv. 公认地；普遍承认地；诚然；
words.ex: Admittedly, he is not the best player, but he works hard.
words.ex_cn: 公认地，他不是最好的球员，但他很努力。
words.en: Used to express that you accept something is true or that you agree with it, even though you may not like it.

words.ex: The extraneous noise made it hard to concentrate.
words.ex_cn: 那些无关的噪音让人难以集中注意力。
words.en: Something that is extraneous is not relevant or essential to the subject you are dealing with.

words.ex: He is presumably at home now.
words.ex_cn: 推测起来，他现在在家。
words.en: If you say that something is presumably the case, you mean that you think it is very likely to be the case, although you are not certain.

words.ex: Children develop different capacities as they grow.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在成长过程中发展出不同的能力。
words.en: The ability or power to do, experience, or understand something.

words.ex: The teacher gave an assessment of the students' work.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生的作品进行了评估。
words.en: An assessment is a judgment about something, especially about how good or bad it is, or an amount that is calculated for something, especially for tax purposes.

words.ex: Reading a book gives me relaxation.
words.ex_cn: 读书让我放松。
words.en: Relaxation is the state or process of becoming less tense, anxious, or stressed.

words.ex: He was the discoverer of a new species of frog.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个新蛙种的发现者。
words.en: A discoverer is someone who finds something that was not known before.

words.tr: n. 静止；不活泼；休止状态
words.ex: His inactivity made him feel weak.
words.ex_cn: 他的不活动让他感到虚弱。
words.en: The state of not being active or not doing anything.

words.ex: The road was obstructed by fallen trees.
words.ex_cn: 这条路被倒下的树木阻塞了。
words.en: To block or hinder the progress of something or someone.

words.tr: n. 一群人；组合；集合；聚集
words.ex: An assemblage of people gathered in the square.
words.ex_cn: 一群人聚集在广场上。
words.en: An assemblage is a collection of things or people that have been gathered together.

words.ex: He habitually wakes up at 6 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 他习惯每天早上六点起床。
words.en: If someone does something habitually, they do it regularly or as a habit.

words.tr: adv. 残忍地；冷酷地；无情地
words.ex: He ruthlessly fired the employee.
words.ex_cn: 他无情地解雇了那位员工。
words.en: If someone is ruthless, they are determined to get what they want and do not care if they hurt other people.

words.ex: The city builds reservoirs to store rainwater.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市建造蓄水库来储存雨水。
words.en: A reservoir is a large natural or artificial lake used as a source of water supply.

words.ex: He uses fertilizer to help his plants grow.
words.ex_cn: 他用肥料帮助植物生长。
words.en: A substance that is added to soil to improve the growth of plants.

words.ex: The translator helped him understand the French book.
words.ex_cn: 这位翻译员帮他理解了这本法语书。
words.en: A translator is a person whose job is translating writing or speech from one language to another.

words.tr: adj. 热情的；充满热情的；
words.ex: She is passionate about teaching children.
words.ex_cn: 她对教孩子充满热情。
words.en: Having, showing, or caused by strong feelings or beliefs.

words.tr: adj. 不加辨别的；不加批判的
words.ex: He accepted the news uncritical.
words.ex_cn: 他毫不质疑地接受了这个消息。
words.en: If you describe someone as uncritical, you mean that they do not judge whether someone or something is good or bad, right or wrong, before supporting or believing them.

words.ex: The engagement between the teacher and students improved learning.
words.ex_cn: 老师与学生之间的密切关系提高了学习效果。
words.en: An engagement is a formal agreement to get married, or a period of time when two people are planning to get married.

words.tr: n. 电报；电报机 v. 打电报；用电报发送
words.ex: They telegraphs the message to the next town.
words.ex_cn: 他们把消息电报到下一个城镇。
words.en: A telegraph is a system for transmitting messages from a distance along a wire, especially one creating signals by making and breaking an electrical connection. It can also refer to the act of sending a message by telegraph.

words.tr: v. 使中立；中和；使无效
words.ex: The government tried to neutralise the protest by talking to the leaders.
words.ex_cn: 政府试图通过与领导人谈话来使抗议中立化。
words.en: To neutralise something means to make it ineffective or harmless by applying an opposite force or effect.

words.ex: He is conversant with basic math.
words.ex_cn: 他熟悉基础数学。
words.en: If you are conversant with something, you are familiar with it and able to deal with it.

words.ex: The internet has greatly improved global connexions.
words.ex_cn: 互联网极大地改善了全球的联系。
words.en: Connexions refers to the relationships or links between people, things, or ideas, often implying a network or system of connections.

words.ex: The bright colors are attracting birds.
words.ex_cn: 鲜艳的颜色正在吸引鸟类。
words.en: If something attracts people or animals, it has features that cause them to come to it.

words.ex: The teacher emphasises the importance of homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师强调了家庭作业的重要性。
words.en: To give special importance or prominence to something in speaking or writing.

words.ex: The government introduced new currencies to stabilize the economy.
words.ex_cn: 政府引入了新货币以稳定经济。
words.en: Currencies are the money that is used in a particular country or region.

words.ex: The desert has little vegetation.
words.ex_cn: 这个沙漠植被很少。
words.en: Vegetation refers to plants in general, or the plants that are found in a particular area. It can also refer to a life that is dull or inactive, often due to illness or lack of exercise.

words.ex: The report enumerated the various reasons for the project's failure.
words.ex_cn: v. 报告列举了项目失败的各种原因。
words.en: To enumerate means to mention things one by one, especially in a list or to count them.

words.tr: adj. 可比较的；比得上的；类似的；
words.ex: The prices of these two phones are comparable.
words.ex_cn: 这两部手机的价格是可比较的。
words.en: Something that is comparable to something else is similar in size, amount, or quality.

words.ex: The goldsmiths in the old town are known for their exquisite craftsmanship.
words.ex_cn: n. 老城区的金匠以其精湛的工艺而闻名。
words.en: A goldsmith is a person who makes or sells articles made of gold.

words.ex: The provincial government opened a new school.
words.ex_cn: 省政府开设了一所新学校。
words.en: Relating to a province or provinces; having the manners, viewpoints, etc., considered characteristic of unsophisticated inhabitants of a province; narrow-minded.

words.ex: The law will emancipate slaves.
words.ex_cn: 法律将解放奴隶。
words.en: To emancipate someone means to set them free from something that restricts their freedom to do what they want.

words.tr: adj. 令人厌恶的；令人作呕的； v. “disgust”的现在分词；
words.ex: The smell of the rotten food was disgusting.
words.ex_cn: 腐烂食物的气味令人厌恶。
words.en: If you say that something is disgusting, you mean that you find it completely unacceptable or unpleasant.

words.ex: The patricians of ancient Rome held significant power and influence.
words.ex_cn: 古罗马的贵族拥有巨大的权力和影响力。
words.en: In ancient Rome, the patricians were the noble families who held the highest social status and political power.

words.ex: His refutation of the claim was clear and simple.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个说法的反驳清晰而简单。
words.en: A refutation is an argument or piece of evidence that contradicts or disproves a statement, theory, or argument.

words.ex: The exploiters took advantage of the workers' lack of knowledge.
words.ex_cn: 剥削者利用了工人们的知识匮乏。
words.en: Exploiters are people who take unfair advantage of others, often for their own benefit.

words.ex: The boy got punishment for breaking the window.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩因为打碎了窗户而受到了处罚。
words.en: Punishment is the act of punishing someone or the state of being punished.

words.ex: The cheese is a derivative of milk.
words.ex_cn: 这种奶酪是牛奶的派生物。
words.en: A derivative is something which has been developed or obtained from something else.

words.ex: He thinks abstractly about problems.
words.ex_cn: 他抽象地思考问题。
words.en: In a way that is not concrete or practical but rather theoretical or conceptual.

words.ex: The attendants clapped when the speaker finished.
words.ex_cn: 出席者们在演讲者结束时鼓掌。
words.en: People who are present at an event, meeting, or function, or who accompany and assist someone.

words.ex: The new policy engendered a lot of debate among the citizens.
words.ex_cn: 新政策在市民中引起了很多讨论。
words.en: To cause a feeling, situation, or condition to exist.

words.ex: She is discarding old clothes to make space in her wardrobe.
words.ex_cn: 她正在丢弃旧衣服，以便在衣柜里腾出空间。
words.en: To discard means to get rid of something that is no longer useful or desirable.

words.ex: My neighbours often help me with groceries.
words.ex_cn: 我的邻居经常帮我买杂货。
words.en: People living next to or near each other, or things situated close to each other.

words.ex: You should clean your room yourselves.
words.ex_cn: 你们应该自己打扫房间。
words.en: Used as the object of a verb or preposition when this is the same as the subject of the clause and the subject is you.

words.ex: I looked up the word in a dictionary.
words.ex_cn: 我在词典里查了这个词。
words.en: A dictionary is a book in which the words of a language are listed alphabetically, together with their meanings, pronunciations, and other information.

words.ex: The company destroyed the evidence, which is spoliation.
words.ex_cn: 公司销毁了证据，这就是破坏证据。
words.en: The act of plundering or despoiling; the act of stripping or taking away by force or violence.

words.tr: adj. 死后的；死后出版的；遗腹的
words.ex: He received a posthumous award for his bravery.
words.ex_cn: 他因勇敢而被追授了奖项。
words.en: Posthumous means occurring, awarded, or appearing after the death of the originator.

words.ex: Wear a helmet to counteract the risk of head injury.
words.ex_cn: 戴头盔以对抗头部受伤的风险。
words.en: If you counteract something, you reduce its effect by doing something that produces an opposite effect.

words.ex: The millennium began in the year 2000.
words.ex_cn: 一千年始于2000年。
words.en: A millennium is a period of one thousand years.

words.ex: The prevalence of flu increased in winter.
words.ex_cn: 流感在冬季更加流行。
words.en: The fact or condition of being prevalent; commonness.

words.ex: She spent the afternoon correcting her students' homework.
words.ex_cn: 她花了一下午时间批改学生的作业。
words.en: To make or set right; amend; rectify.

words.tr:
n. 漫画；讽刺画；滑稽模仿
v. 画成漫画讽刺
words.ex: He drew a caricature of the teacher with big eyes.
words.ex_cn: 他画了一幅老师大眼睛的漫画。
words.en: A caricature is a drawing or description of someone that exaggerates their appearance or behavior in a humorous or critical way.

words.tr:
v. 补偿；赔偿；报酬
n. 报偿；回礼；赔偿
words.ex: The company recompense the worker for the lost time.
words.ex_cn: 公司补偿了工人损失的时间。
words.en: If you are given something, usually money, in recompense, you are given it as a reward or because you have suffered.

words.tr: adj. 自满的；自鸣得意的
words.ex: He is complacent about his good grades.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的好成绩感到自满。
words.en: A complacent person is very pleased with themselves or feels that they do not need to do anything about a situation, even though the situation may be uncertain or dangerous.

words.tr: n. 沉降，沉积，沉淀 v. 存放( deposit的现在分词 ); （尤指小心地或准确地）放置;
words.ex: The process of depositing minerals in the riverbed.
words.ex_cn: 在河床上沉积矿物质的过程。
words.en: The act of placing or leaving something somewhere for safekeeping or as a pledge.

words.ex: This village is the birthplace of the famous poet.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄是这位著名诗人的发源地。
words.en: The place where someone was born.

words.tr: adj. 有特权的； v. “privilege”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is a privileged student who gets free books.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个有特权的学生，能免费获得书籍。
words.en: Having special rights, advantages, or immunities.

words.ex: He is an apprentice in a car repair shop.
words.ex_cn: 他是汽车修理店的一名学徒。
words.en: An apprentice is a young person who works for someone in order to learn their skill.

words.tr: n. 谈判； v. “bargain”的现在分词；
words.ex: Bargaining with the seller helped her get a lower price.
words.ex_cn: 与卖家谈判帮助她得到了更低的价格。
words.en: The activity of discussing prices or conditions in order to reach an agreement that is better than the one originally offered.

words.tr: n. 加利福尼亚（美国州名）
words.ex: He lives in California.
words.ex_cn: 他住在加利福尼亚。
words.en: A state in the western United States on the Pacific Ocean; known for its diverse geography and culture.

words.ex: The traffic came to a standstill during the rush hour.
words.ex_cn: 高峰期交通陷入了停滞。
words.en: A situation in which all activity or movement has stopped.

words.ex: The husbandman works hard in the fields every day.
words.ex_cn: 这位农民每天都在田里辛勤劳作。
words.en: A husbandman is a person who cultivates the land; a farmer.

words.tr:
v. 补充；与…相辅相成；
n. 补足物；补语；余角；
words.ex: The red scarf complements her blue coat.
words.ex_cn: 这条红围巾补充了她的蓝外套。
words.en: To complement something means to make it complete or perfect by adding something to it.

words.ex: He practices gymnastics every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上练习体操。
words.en: Gymnastics is a sport that involves exercises and movements that require physical strength, flexibility, balance, and control.

words.ex: The company showed compliance with safety rules.
words.ex_cn: 该公司遵守了安全规定。
words.en: The act of complying with a wish, request, or demand; obedience.

words.tr: adj. 简化的； v. “simplify”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The teacher gave a simplified version of the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了一个简化的数学问题版本。
words.en: Made less complex or complicated; made easier to understand or do.

words.ex: His attainment of the goal took many years.
words.ex_cn: 他达到这个目标花了多年时间。
words.en: The act of achieving something, especially through effort; a skill or accomplishment that has been achieved.

words.ex: He sold his old car profitably.
words.ex_cn: 他以有利的方式卖掉了他的旧车。
words.en: In a way that results in or is likely to result in a profit or benefit.

words.tr: v. 使惊讶；“astonish”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He was astonished by the sudden news.
words.ex_cn: 他被这个突然的消息惊呆了。
words.en: If you are astonished by something, you are very surprised about it.

words.tr:
n. 葡萄牙人；葡萄牙语；
adj. 葡萄牙的；葡萄牙人的；葡萄牙语的；
words.ex: He is a Portuguese from Lisbon.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位来自里斯本的葡萄牙人。
words.en: Portuguese refers to something that is related to Portugal, its people, or its language. It can also denote the people of Portugal or the Portuguese language itself.

words.ex: He subtracted 5 from 10 and got 5.
words.ex_cn: v. 他从10中减去5，得到了5。
words.en: If you subtract one number from another, you take the first number away from the second.

words.tr: n. 复制品；副本；v. 复制；重复
words.ex: He made duplicates of the important documents.
words.ex_cn: 他制作了重要文件的副本。
words.en: Duplicates refer to copies or repetitions of something, or the act of making such copies.

words.tr: v. 完成；使完善( complete的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He is completing his homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他正在晚饭前完成作业。
words.en: To finish making or doing something.

words.ex: He sent a remittance to his family last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周给家人汇了一笔款。
words.en: A remittance is a sum of money that you send to someone.
