words.ex: The company is augmenting its workforce to meet the increasing demand.
words.ex_cn: 公司正在增加员工以应对日益增长的需求。
words.en: To augment something means to make it larger, stronger, or more effective by adding something to it.

words.tr: v. 阴阳怪气; 使（某人）困惑不解，使迷惑( mystify的现在分词 )
words.ex: The magic trick was mystifying.
words.ex_cn: 这个魔术令人费解。
words.en: Causing confusion or wonder; perplexing.

words.tr: adj. 卑屈的；恭顺的；次要的；从属的
words.ex: He is subservient to his boss.
words.ex_cn: 他对他的老板唯命是从。
words.en: If you are subservient, you do whatever someone wants you to do.

words.ex: The city has a problem with prostitutes soliciting in the downtown area.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市存在妓女在市中心招揽生意的问题。
words.en: A prostitute is a person, typically a woman, who engages in sexual activity for payment.

words.tr: v. 俯瞰；忽视；“overlook”的现在分词；
words.ex: The hotel room is overlooking the sea.
words.ex_cn: 这间酒店房间俯瞰着大海。
words.en: If a building, window, or place overlooks something, it has a view of it, usually from above.

words.tr: v. 压制; 抑制（感情等）( suppress的现在分词 ); 禁止发表; 阻止…的生长（或发展）
words.ex: He is suppressing his anger.
words.ex_cn: 他正在压抑自己的愤怒。
words.en: To suppress something means to put an end to it forcibly, to prevent it from being expressed or continuing.

words.ex: The prisoners suffered from sleep deprivation.
words.ex_cn: 囚犯们因睡眠剥夺而受苦。
words.en: Deprivation is the lack or denial of something considered to be a necessity.

words.ex: The colors intermingle in the painting.
words.ex_cn: 画中的颜色混合在一起。
words.en: If things intermingle, they mix together or are mixed together.

words.tr:
adj. 概括性的；笼统的；普遍的
v. 概括；笼统地讲；推广；“generalise”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: The doctor generalised the symptoms to diagnose the disease.
words.ex_cn: 医生通过概括症状来诊断疾病。
words.en: Generalised means involving or relating to a broad range of things or people, rather than being specific or detailed.

words.tr:
n. 纪录片；
adj. 文书的；
words.ex: We watched a documentary about pandas last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚看了一部关于熊猫的纪录片。
words.en: A documentary is a film or television or radio programme that gives factual information about a particular subject.

words.ex: The book is a compilation of his best essays.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是他最佳文章的汇编物。
words.en: A compilation is a collection of different items, such as songs, pieces of writing, or data, that have been gathered together in one place or for one purpose.

words.ex: His addiction led to the enslavement of his mind.
words.ex_cn: 他的上瘾导致了心灵的束缚。
words.en: The act of making someone a slave; the state of being a slave.

words.ex: It was disgraceful to lie to your teacher.
words.ex_cn: 对老师撒谎是可耻的。
words.en: If you say that something is disgraceful, you are emphasizing that it is very bad or wrong, and that you find it completely unacceptable.

words.tr: n. 含意；可能的影响（或后果）；暗示；
words.ex: The implication of his words was that he was sorry.
words.ex_cn: 他话中的含意是他很抱歉。
words.en: An implication is a possible future effect or result of an action or decision, often one that is not immediately obvious.

words.tr: v. 促进；助长；“facilitate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The teacher facilitated group discussions.
words.ex_cn: 老师促进了小组讨论。
words.en: To make an action or process easier or more likely to happen.

words.ex: The children made a derangement of the books on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们把书架上的书弄乱了。
words.en: A state of mental disturbance or confusion; the act of deranging or the state of being deranged.

words.ex: The fertilities of the soil in this region are well-known.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区土壤的肥沃是众所周知的。
words.en: The capacity of soil to produce abundant plant growth or the ability of an organism to produce offspring.

words.tr: adv. 有缺点地；不完美地；未完成地
words.ex: He painted the wall imperfectly.
words.ex_cn: 他把墙刷得不完美。
words.en: In a way that is not perfect or has faults.

words.ex: The ancient habitations were discovered by archaeologists.
words.ex_cn: 考古学家发现了古代的居住地。
words.en: Places where people live; dwellings.

words.tr: n. 威斯敏斯特（伦敦的一个区，英国议会所在地）
words.ex: The Houses of Parliament are located in Westminster.
words.ex_cn: 英国议会大厦位于威斯敏斯特。
words.en: Westminster is a district in central London, known for being the location of the Houses of Parliament and other significant government buildings.

words.ex: She tested the theory empirically by observing real cases.
words.ex_cn: 她通过观察真实案例以经验为依据地检验了这一理论。
words.en: Based on, concerned with, or verifiable by observation or experience rather than theory or pure logic.

words.tr: adj. 可容许的；可承认的
words.ex: It is permissible to use a calculator in this test.
words.ex_cn: 在这次考试中使用计算器是允许的。
words.en: If something is permissible, it is considered to be acceptable because it does not break any laws or rules.

words.ex: The needlewomen worked diligently to finish the wedding dress on time.
words.ex_cn: 女裁缝们勤奋工作，按时完成了婚纱。
words.en: A needlewoman is a woman who sews, especially one who does it professionally.

words.tr: adj. 本质上的；实质性的；
words.ex: The change was substantive, not just cosmetic.
words.ex_cn: 这个改变是本质上的，而不仅仅是表面上的。
words.en: Something that is substantive is significant, meaningful, or important in a way that is not just superficial or formal.

words.ex: She spent the afternoon enumerating the tasks that needed to be completed.
words.ex_cn: 她花了一下午的时间列举需要完成的任务。
words.en: To enumerate means to mention things one by one, especially in a list.

words.ex: The duplication of the document cost five dollars.
words.ex_cn: 这份文件的复制花了五美元。
words.en: the act or process of making an exact copy of something

words.ex: He loves mathematics because it is logical.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢数学，因为它有逻辑性。
words.en: Mathematics is the study of numbers, shapes, and patterns using reason and usually a special system of symbols and rules for organizing them.

words.ex: The company made concessions to avoid a strike.
words.ex_cn: 公司做出了让步以避免罢工。
words.en: If you make a concession to someone, you agree to let them do or have something, especially in order to end an argument or conflict.

words.ex: The team unanimously agreed to cancel the trip.
words.ex_cn: 团队全体一致同意取消这次旅行。
words.en: If a group of people are unanimous, they all agree about one particular matter or vote the same way, and if a decision or judgment is unanimous, it is formed or supported by everyone in a group.

words.tr: adj. 依…而定的；附带条件的；
words.ex: The prize is conditional on winning the game.
words.ex_cn: 这个奖品取决于是否赢得比赛。
words.en: A conditional action or agreement depends on something else happening or being done.

words.ex: The probability of rain tomorrow is high.
words.ex_cn: 明天下雨的概率很高。
words.en: A probability is a measure of how likely it is that some event will occur.

words.ex: The origination of this tradition is unknown.
words.ex_cn: 这个传统的起源未知。
words.en: The act or process of coming into existence or being created.

words.ex: The toy is purchasable online.
words.ex_cn: 这个玩具可以在线购买。
words.en: Capable of being bought or purchased.

words.ex: He finally acknowledged his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他终于承认了自己的错误。
words.en: If you acknowledge a fact or a situation, you accept or admit that it is true or that it exists.

words.tr:
adj. 反动的；保守的
n. 反动派；保守人士
words.ex: The reactionary government banned free speech.
words.ex_cn: 这个反动政府禁止了言论自由。
words.en: A reactionary person or group tries to prevent changes in the political or social system of their country.

words.ex: The subtraction of 5 from 10 gives 5.
words.ex_cn: 10减去5等于5。
words.en: Subtraction is the process of taking one number or amount away from another.

words.ex: The map shows many territories under one country.
words.ex_cn: 这张地图显示了属于一个国家的许多地区。
words.en: Territories refer to areas of land that are controlled by a particular country or ruler, or areas that are considered as belonging to a particular person or group.

words.ex: The diary entries were fragmentary and hard to understand.
words.ex_cn: 这些日记条目是不完整的，难以理解。
words.en: Consisting of small parts that are disconnected or incomplete.

words.tr: adj. 调皮的；恶作剧的；有害的
words.ex: The mischievous boy laughed and hid his sister's shoes.
words.ex_cn: 那个顽皮的男孩笑着藏起了他姐姐的鞋子。
words.en: If you describe someone or their behaviour as mischievous, you mean that they enjoy playing tricks on people or doing things to annoy or embarrass them.

words.ex: He is politically active in his community.
words.ex_cn: 他在社区中积极参与政治事务。
words.en: In a way that relates to the government or public affairs of a country.

words.ex: The chart illustrates how plants grow.
words.ex_cn: 这个图表阐明了植物是如何生长的。
words.en: If you say that something illustrates a situation that you are drawing attention to, you mean that it shows that the situation exists.

words.tr: n. 自由保有权人；永久产权所有人
words.ex: The freeholders of the estate gathered to discuss the new regulations.
words.ex_cn: n. 庄园的自由保有权人聚集在一起讨论新规定。
words.en: A freeholder is a person who owns the freehold of a property, meaning they have permanent and absolute ownership of it.

words.ex: The rain and the thunder happened in conjunction.
words.ex_cn: 雨和雷声同时发生。
words.en: A conjunction is a word that is used to connect clauses or sentences or to coordinate words in the same clause.

words.tr: adj. 传播疾病的；有害的，毒害的；邪恶的
words.ex: The pestiferous smell made everyone leave the room.
words.ex_cn: 那股令人讨厌的气味让所有人都离开了房间。
words.en: Carrying or tending to spread pestilence; morally or socially harmful; annoying.

words.ex: She took up dressmaking as a hobby.
words.ex_cn: n. 她开始把女装裁制当作一种爱好。
words.en: Dressmaking is the activity or job of making women's clothes.

words.tr: n. 反映( reflection的名词复数 ); （关于某课题的）思考; （声、光、热等的）反射;
words.ex: The reflections in the water created a beautiful scene.
words.ex_cn: 水中的倒影形成了一幅美丽的景象。
words.en: The act of reflecting or the state of being reflected; something, especially an image, that is reflected; serious thought or consideration.

words.tr: n. 约会; 约定; 订婚( engagement的名词复数 ); 婚约
words.ex: She has multiple engagements this week.
words.ex_cn: 她这周有多个约会。
words.en: Formal agreements or arrangements, especially to marry or to do business.

words.tr: v. 考虑；深思；凝视；思考…的可能性
words.ex: He contemplates quitting his job.
words.ex_cn: 他正在考虑辞去工作。
words.en: If you contemplate an action, you think about whether to do it or not.

words.ex: The small village was annihilated by the tornado.
words.ex_cn: v. 这个小村庄被龙卷风彻底摧毁了。
words.en: To annihilate something means to destroy it completely.

words.ex: He has ideological beliefs about freedom.
words.ex_cn: 他有关于自由的思想信念。
words.en: Relating to or concerned with ideas, especially of a political or economic nature.

words.ex: The noise was intolerable.
words.ex_cn: 这噪音无法忍受。
words.en: If you describe something as intolerable, you mean that it is so bad or extreme that no one can bear it or tolerate it.

words.ex: The issue was considered secondarily important.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题被认为是其次重要的。
words.en: In a secondary manner or degree; not primarily.

words.tr: v. 淹没；覆盖；压倒；控制；“overwhelm”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The small boat was overwhelmed by the big waves.
words.ex_cn: 小船被巨浪淹没。
words.en: If you are overwhelmed by a feeling or event, it affects you very strongly, and you do not know how to deal with it.

words.ex: His willingness to help made everyone happy.
words.ex_cn: 他乐于帮忙，让每个人都感到开心。
words.en: The quality or state of being prepared to do something; readiness.

words.tr: v. 使娱乐；款待，招待；款待，招待( entertain的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The children were entertained by the clown.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们被小丑逗乐了。
words.en: If you entertain people, you provide them with amusement or enjoyment.

words.ex: He is identifying the wrong answers on the test.
words.ex_cn: 他正在识别试卷上的错误答案。
words.en: To recognize or establish the identity of someone or something.

words.ex: The British established settlements in North America.
words.ex_cn: 英国人在北美建立了殖民地。
words.en: Settlements refer to the act of settling or the state of being settled. It can mean the resolution of a dispute, the establishment of people in a new country or area, or the agreement reached in a legal case.

words.tr: v. 包括; 包含; 包围; 围绕( encompass的第三人称单数 )
words.ex: The book encompasses many simple ideas.
words.ex_cn: 这本书包含了众多简单的想法。
words.en: To include or contain a wide range of elements within a whole.

words.tr: n. 铁路运输；铁路建设
words.ex: Railroading has been a major mode of transportation for over a century.
words.ex_cn: 铁路运输已经是一个多世纪以来的主要交通方式。
words.en: The act or process of constructing or operating a railroad.

words.ex: The country values its sovereignty.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家重视它的主权。
words.en: Sovereignty is the power that a country has to govern itself or another country or state.

words.tr:
n. 隔行；交织
v. （使）交织；（使）交错；“interlace”的现在分词
words.ex: The technique of interlacing is commonly used in video compression.
words.ex_cn: 隔行扫描技术常用于视频压缩。
words.en: The act of weaving together or intertwining.

words.ex: The corporation sells smartphones worldwide.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司向全球销售智能手机。
words.en: A corporation is a large company or group of companies that is controlled together as a single organization.

words.ex: The pendulum shows a smooth oscillation.
words.ex_cn: 钟摆表现出平稳的振荡。
words.en: Oscillation is the process of moving back and forth or up and down in a regular rhythm.

words.tr:
adj. 两星期一次的；隔周发行的
adv. 两周一次地
n. 双周刊
words.ex: He gets paid fortnightly.
words.ex_cn: 他每两周领一次工资。
words.en: Fortnightly means happening or appearing once every two weeks.

words.ex: It is paradoxical that he sleeps all day but stays awake at night.
words.ex_cn: 他白天睡觉却晚上醒着，这很矛盾。
words.en: If something is paradoxical, it involves two facts or qualities which seem to contradict each other.

words.ex: The secretaries type letters and answer phones.
words.ex_cn: 秘书们打字并接电话。
words.en: A secretary is a person whose job is to do office work, such as typing letters, answering phone calls, and arranging meetings.

words.tr: n. 原稿；手稿；底稿；手写本；手稿( manuscript的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The library keeps old manuscripts in a special room.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆把旧原稿保存在一个特别的房间里。
words.en: A manuscript is a handwritten or typed document, especially a writer's first version of a book before it is published.

words.ex: His expectation was to pass the test.
words.ex_cn: 他的期待是通过考试。
words.en: An expectation is a belief about what might happen in the future, especially about something that you think is likely or that you hope will happen.

words.ex: She anticipates a positive response from the committee.
words.ex_cn: 她预期委员会会给出积极的回应。
words.en: If you anticipate an event, you realize in advance that it may happen and you are prepared for it.

words.tr: adj. 共产主义的；共产主义者的
words.ex: The communistic ideology promotes a classless society.
words.ex_cn: 共产主义意识形态提倡一个无阶级的社会。
words.en: Relating to or characteristic of communism or communists.

words.tr: n. 商人；企业家；生意人；“businessman”的复数；
words.ex: The businessmen met to discuss their new project.
words.ex_cn: 商人们聚在一起讨论他们的新项目。
words.en: Businessmen are individuals engaged in commerce, especially those who operate or manage a business.

words.ex: The new policy effectuates significant changes in the company.
words.ex_cn: 新政策使公司发生了重大变化。
words.en: To effectuate means to bring about or cause something to happen, especially as a result of one's actions.

words.tr: n. 庞然大物；怪物；巨兽；
words.ex: The old factory was a monstrosity of rust and steel.
words.ex_cn: 那座旧工厂是一座锈迹斑斑的钢铁庞然大物。
words.en: Something that is very large and extremely ugly, or that is shocking or wrong because it is not natural.

words.tr: v. 把…归因于；认为…属于
words.ex: She is attributing her success to hard work and determination.
words.ex_cn: v. 她把她的成功归因于努力和决心。
words.en: To regard something as being caused by or belonging to someone or something.

words.ex: The two companies were amalgamated into one larger corporation.
words.ex_cn: 这两家公司合并成了一家更大的公司。
words.en: To amalgamate means to combine or unite to form one organization or structure. It is often used in the context of businesses or metals.

words.ex: The problem was solved ingeniously.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题被巧妙地解决了。
words.en: In a manner showing cleverness or originality in solving problems or in inventing.

words.tr: adj. 发生于其间的；介于中间的； v. “intervene”的现在分词；
words.ex: The intervening event caused a delay.
words.ex_cn: 其间发生的事件导致了延误。
words.en: If an intervening period of time is mentioned, it refers to the period between two events or points in time.

words.tr: adj. 不会弄错的；确定无疑的；清楚明白的
words.ex: His smile is unmistakable.
words.ex_cn: 他的微笑是 unmistakable 的。
words.en: If you describe something as unmistakable, you mean that it is so obvious that it cannot be mistaken for anything else.

words.tr: n. 不规则；无规律；不合常规；不整齐
words.ex: The teacher noticed an irregularity in the test scores.
words.ex_cn: 老师注意到考试成绩中有一个异常。
words.en: The state or quality of being irregular; something that is irregular.

words.ex: He participated in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他参加了学校的戏剧演出。
words.en: To take part in or become involved in an activity.

words.tr: adj. 多种的；各式各样的
words.ex: She has multifarious hobbies, like painting, singing, and gardening.
words.ex_cn: 她有很多不同的爱好，比如绘画、唱歌和园艺。
words.en: If you describe things as multifarious, you mean that they are many and of various types.

words.ex: The task was accomplished incompletely due to time constraints.
words.ex_cn: 由于时间限制，任务没有完全完成。
words.en: In a manner that is not complete or fully done.

words.tr: n. 决定物，决定因素( determinant的名词复数 )
words.ex: He calculates determinants for matrices in math class.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学课上计算矩阵的行列式。
words.en: Factors or elements that decisively influence the nature or outcome of something.

words.tr: adj. 可疑的；有问题的；不可靠的；
words.ex: The deal seemed questionable.
words.ex_cn: 这笔交易看起来可疑。
words.en: If you say that something is questionable, you mean that it is not obviously true or real, and therefore possibly not valid or reliable.

words.tr: n. 普遍性；一般性；通用
words.ex: The universality of human rights is a concept that transcends national boundaries.
words.ex_cn: 人权的普遍性是一个超越国界的概念。
words.en: The quality or state of being universal; the fact of existing or being found everywhere.

words.tr: v. 传达，表达( communicate的过去式和过去分词 ); 通讯; 交际; 相连
words.ex: He communicated his idea clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他清楚地表达了想法。
words.en: Conveyed or shared information, ideas, or feelings to others through speech, writing, or other means.

words.ex: The cable is disconnected from the computer.
words.ex_cn: 这条线缆从电脑上断开了。
words.en: If something is disconnected, it is not joined to anything else or is not in contact with anything else.

words.ex: This product is commercially successful.
words.ex_cn: 这个产品在商业上很成功。
words.en: In a way that is related to the buying and selling of goods and services.

words.tr: v. 消失；不见；“disappear”的现在分词；
words.ex: The sun is disappearing behind the hills.
words.ex_cn: 太阳正从山后消失。
words.en: If someone or something disappears, they go somewhere where they cannot be seen or found.

words.tr: n. 企业家；创业者；承包人；
words.ex: He is an entrepreneur who started a small coffee shop.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位创办了小型咖啡店的企业家。
words.en: An entrepreneur is a person who organizes and operates a business or businesses, taking on greater than normal financial risks in order to do so.

words.tr: adj. 有报酬的；有利益的；
words.ex: He took a remunerative job to support his family.
words.ex_cn: 他找了一份有报酬的工作来养家。
words.en: providing payment; profitable

words.tr: v. 参加，参与( participate的第三人称单数 )
words.ex: He participates in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他参加学校的戏剧演出。
words.en: To take part in an activity or event.

words.ex: The reappearance of the sun made everyone happy.
words.ex_cn: 太阳重新出现，让每个人都高兴了。
words.en: The act of appearing again or the fact of being seen again after not being seen for some time.

words.ex: The storm is intensifying as it moves closer.
words.ex_cn: 风暴在靠近时正在加剧。
words.en: To make something stronger or more extreme.

words.ex: He deliberately broke the rule.
words.ex_cn: 他有意地违反了规则。
words.en: If you do something deliberately, you do it intentionally or after thinking about it carefully.

words.ex: She had a presentiment that something bad was going to happen.
words.ex_cn: 她有一种不祥的预感，觉得会有坏事发生。
words.en: A presentiment is a feeling that something is about to happen, especially something unpleasant.

words.tr: n. 骨化；成骨；（思想的）僵化
words.ex: The bone shows signs of ossification.
words.ex_cn: 这根骨头显示出骨化的迹象。
words.en: Ossification is the process by which bone is formed, or the process by which something becomes fixed and unable to change.

words.ex: Her skills are transferable to other jobs.
words.ex_cn: 她的技能可以转移到其他工作上。
words.en: If something is transferable, it can be moved or passed from one person, place, or situation to another.

words.ex: The meeting felt interminable.
words.ex_cn: 这场会议感觉没完没了。
words.en: If you describe something as interminable, you are emphasizing that it continues for a very long time and indicating that you find it boring or annoying.

words.tr: n. 陈词滥调；老生常谈
words.ex: His speech was full of commonplaces that didn't inspire anyone.
words.ex_cn: 他的演讲充满了陈词滥调，没有激励任何人。
words.en: Commonplaces are statements or ideas that are not new or interesting because they have been used or expressed many times before.

words.ex: It is a hypothetical situation.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个假设的情况。
words.en: A hypothetical situation, idea, or explanation is based on possible ideas or situations rather than actual ones.

words.tr: n. 大数目；多种多样；繁多
words.ex: There is a multiplicity of stars in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 夜空中有大量星星。
words.en: A multiplicity of things or people means a large number or great variety of them.

words.ex: He works in shipbuilding near the sea.
words.ex_cn: 他在海边从事造船工作。
words.en: The industry or activity of building ships.

words.tr: v. 证实，支持（某种说法、信仰、理论等）( corroborate的过去式 )
words.ex: His story was corroborated by two witnesses.
words.ex_cn: 他的说法得到了两名证人的证实。
words.en: Supported or confirmed with additional evidence.

words.ex: The organization helps poor children.
words.ex_cn: 这个组织帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: An organization is a group of people who work together in a structured way for a shared purpose.

words.ex: The durabilities of these materials are tested under extreme conditions.
words.ex_cn: 这些材料的耐久性在极端条件下进行了测试。
words.en: The plural form of 'durability', referring to the ability of something to last a long time without significant deterioration.

words.ex: His dreams finally materialized after years of hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他的梦想经过多年的努力终于实现了。
words.en: To materialize means to come into existence or to become real, often after being thought about or planned for a long time.

words.ex: The explosion caused the annihilation of the building.
words.ex_cn: 爆炸导致了大楼的毁灭。
words.en: The complete destruction or obliteration of something.

words.ex: Contrariwise, if it was so, it might be; and if it were so, it would be; but as it isn't, it ain't. That's logic.
words.ex_cn: 反之，如果是这样，它可能存在；如果是这样，它就会存在；但因为它不是，所以它不存在。这就是逻辑。
words.en: In a contrary manner; on the other hand.

words.ex: His answer corresponded to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他的回答与问题相符。
words.en: If one thing corresponds to another, there is a close similarity, connection, or equivalence between them.

words.tr: n. 出版物（publication 的复数）
words.ex: He reads many scientific publications.
words.ex_cn: 他阅读许多科学出版物。
words.en: Publications refer to the act of making something known to the public, especially by printing it in a book, magazine, or newspaper, or the thing that is published.

words.tr: adj. 追加的；补足的；补角的
words.ex: He took a supplemental class to improve his math skills.
words.ex_cn: 他参加了一门补充课程来提高他的数学技能。
words.en: Something that is supplemental is provided in addition to something else, often to make it more complete or to improve it.

words.ex: Her talent is unparalleled.
words.ex_cn: 她的才华是无比的。
words.en: Having no parallel or equal; unmatched.

words.tr: n. 圆满成功；完成；成就；达到极点
words.ex: The consummation of their project brought great joy.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目的圆满成功带来了巨大的喜悦。
words.en: The act of making something complete or perfect.

words.tr: v. 给予；管理( administer的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The nurse administered the medicine to the patient.
words.ex_cn: 护士给病人服用了药物。
words.en: To manage or oversee the operation or performance of something; to give or apply (a remedy, etc.).

words.tr: n. 完整性; 完全; 完全性
words.ex: The completeness of the report impressed the board.
words.ex_cn: 报告的完整性给董事会留下了深刻的印象。
words.en: The state or condition of having all necessary or normal parts, components, or steps; the state of being whole and having no parts missing.

words.ex: They help each other reciprocally.
words.ex_cn: 他们互相帮助。
words.en: In a way that involves mutual action or exchange.

words.ex: I have two magazine subscriptions.
words.ex_cn: 我有两本杂志的订阅。
words.en: A subscription is an arrangement to receive something, typically a publication, regularly by paying in advance.

words.tr: adj. 无法解释的；不能理解的；无责任的
words.ex: The manager made unaccountable decisions.
words.ex_cn: 这位经理做出了无法解释的决定。
words.en: If someone or something is unaccountable, there is no way of explaining why they behave in a particular way, and it is often strange or surprising.

words.tr: v. 占优势；占主导地位
words.ex: In the debate, her argument preponderates over the others.
words.ex_cn: 在辩论中，她的论点比其他人的更有优势。
words.en: To be greater in number, influence, or importance; to predominate.

words.tr: v. 研究；调查；调查( investigate的现在分词 )；
words.ex: The police are investigating the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警察正在调查这起事故。
words.en: Examining or inquiring into something systematically.

words.tr: adv. 无意地；不知不觉地
words.ex: He unconsciously tapped his foot while waiting.
words.ex_cn: 他等的时候无意识地敲着脚。
words.en: If you do something unconsciously, you do it without being aware of it.

words.ex: The correspondent reported the news from the city.
words.ex_cn: 记者从城市报道了新闻。
words.en: A correspondent is someone who reports news from a particular place or on a particular subject for a newspaper, magazine, or television or radio station.

words.ex: The incorporation of new ideas improved the plan.
words.ex_cn: 新想法的结合改进了这个计划。
words.en: Incorporation is the process or result of forming a legal corporation, or the inclusion of something as part of a whole.

words.ex: He is participating in a school competition.
words.ex_cn: 他正在参加一个学校比赛。
words.en: Taking part in an activity or event.

words.ex: There are many possibilities for your future.
words.ex_cn: 你的未来有很多可能性。
words.en: The range of things that can happen or be done.

words.ex: He intentionally left his homework at home.
words.ex_cn: 他故意把作业忘在家里。
words.en: If something is done intentionally, it is done deliberately and not by accident.

words.ex: The company offered financial compensations to the affected employees.
words.ex_cn: 公司向受影响的员工提供了经济补偿。
words.en: Compensations are payments or other benefits given to someone to make up for a loss, injury, or inconvenience.

words.tr: adj. 令人不快的；令人反感的；讨厌的
words.ex: The movie contains objectionable content.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影包含令人反感的内容。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as objectionable, you consider them to be extremely offensive and unacceptable.

words.ex: The scientist is approximating the value of the constant.
words.ex_cn: 科学家正在接近常数的值。
words.en: To come close to; to be almost the same as.

words.tr: n. 伪造；歪曲；[审计] 篡改；证明是假
words.ex: The falsification of financial records is a serious crime.
words.ex_cn: 伪造财务记录是严重的犯罪行为。
words.en: Falsification is the act of making false records or claims, especially in order to deceive someone.

words.ex: The bank offers notes in various denominations.
words.ex_cn: 这家银行提供各种面额的纸币。
words.en: Denominations refer to the different values or categories into which something is divided, such as the different values of money or the different religious groups.

words.ex: He completed his apprenticeship as a carpenter.
words.ex_cn: 他完成了木工学徒期。
words.en: An apprenticeship is a period of time in which someone learns a trade or profession by working under the supervision of a skilled worker.

words.tr: adv. 科学地；合乎科学地；按科学的方法；
words.ex: The experiment was conducted scientifically.
words.ex_cn: 这个实验是科学地进行的。
words.en: In a way that relates to or is used in science.

words.ex: He made a generalisation from the data.
words.ex_cn: 他从数据中得出了一般性结论。
words.en: A generalisation is a statement that seems to be true in most situations or for most people, but that may not be completely true in all cases.

words.ex: The teacher gave a classification of animals into mammals and birds.
words.ex_cn: 老师将动物分为哺乳动物和鸟类。
words.en: The action or process of classifying something according to shared qualities or characteristics.

words.ex: He is a philanthropist who gives money to poor children.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位向贫困儿童捐款的慈善家。
words.en: A philanthropist is someone who helps others, especially by giving money to people who need it.

words.ex: The lack of parking spaces causes many inconveniences for visitors.
words.ex_cn: 停车位的缺乏给游客带来了很多不便。
words.en: Inconveniences refer to situations or conditions that cause trouble, difficulty, or discomfort, often making it harder to do something.

words.tr: n. 公国；侯国；诸侯领地
words.ex: The principalities of Europe were often at war with each other.
words.ex_cn: 欧洲的公国之间经常发生战争。
words.en: Principalities refer to territories ruled by a prince or a monarch, often smaller than a kingdom.

words.tr: v. 区分，区别，辨别( differentiate的第三人称单数 ); 区别对待; 表明…间的差别
words.ex: The teacher differentiates the students by their skill levels.
words.ex_cn: 老师根据学生的技能水平进行区分。
words.en: If you differentiate between things or if you differentiate one thing from another, you recognize or show the difference between them.

words.tr: n. 多余的人或物；临时演员
words.ex: The director hired several supernumeraries to fill the crowd scenes.
words.ex_cn: 导演雇了几个临时演员来填充群众场景。
words.en: Supernumeraries are people or things that are in excess of the usual, necessary, or prescribed number, often used in the context of temporary or extra personnel, such as in theatrical productions.

words.ex: There were several inconsistencies in his story.
words.ex_cn: 他的故事中有几处不一致的地方。
words.en: The state or quality of being inconsistent; lack of consistency or uniformity.

words.ex: The weights on the scale counterbalanced each other perfectly.
words.ex_cn: v. 使平衡
words.en: To counterbalance something means to have an equal and opposite effect to it, so that it does not have too much influence or importance.

words.ex: The two events were contemporaneous and could be connected.
words.ex_cn: 这两件事是同时发生的，可能有关联。
words.en: Existing or occurring in the same period of time.

words.ex: The interconnections between the different parts of the ecosystem are complex.
words.ex_cn: 生态系统不同部分之间的相互连接是复杂的。
words.en: Interconnections refer to the links or relationships between different parts or elements, especially in complex systems.

words.ex: She boiled an egg for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 她为早餐煮了一个蛋。
words.en: An egg is an oval object that is produced by a female bird and which contains a baby bird. Other animals such as reptiles and fish also lay eggs.

words.tr:
n. 赞成票；投赞成票者
adv. 是；赞成；常常；永远
words.ex: The motion was carried by an aye vote.
words.ex_cn: 该动议以赞成票通过。
words.en: An expression of assent or agreement; always or forever.

words.ex: The can is made of tin.
words.ex_cn: 这个罐子是锡做的。
words.en: Tin is a soft, silvery-white metal that is often used to coat other metals to prevent them from rusting. It is also used in the production of tin cans and other containers.

words.tr: n. 一圈；（人坐着时）大腿部；
words.ex: He ran three laps around the track.
words.ex_cn: 他在跑道上跑了三圈。
words.en: The upper part of the legs of a seated person; a single turn or round in a race or other competition.

words.tr:
v. 禁止；
n. 禁止；
words.ex: The school bans phones in class.
words.ex_cn: 学校禁止在课堂上使用手机。
words.en: If there is a ban on something, it is not allowed. If something is banned, it is not allowed to be done, shown, or used.

words.ex: He put a mat on the floor to keep it clean.
words.ex_cn: 他在地上放了一块垫子以保持清洁。
words.en: A mat is a piece of thick fabric or other material that is placed on a floor or other surface to protect it or to provide a soft surface to stand or sit on.

words.ex: The farmer milks the cow every morning.
words.ex_cn: 农夫每天早上给母牛挤奶。
words.en: A cow is a large female animal that is kept on farms for its milk.

words.ex: The sky is blue today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天空是蓝色的。
words.en: The sky is the space around the Earth which you can see when you stand outside and look upwards.

words.ex: The bee is flying near the flowers.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂正在花附近飞舞。
words.en: A bee is a flying insect known for its role in pollination and for producing honey and beeswax.

words.ex: The miners dug deep to find iron ore.
words.ex_cn: 矿工们深入地下寻找铁矿石。
words.en: Ore is rock or earth from which metal can be obtained.

words.ex: The road was covered with black tar.
words.ex_cn: 这条路铺满了黑色的焦油。
words.en: A black viscous liquid used for paving roads and waterproofing.

words.ex: She poured tea from the pot.
words.ex_cn: 她从壶里倒出了茶。
words.en: A pot is a deep round container used for cooking.

words.tr:
n. 手臂；
v. 武装；
words.ex: He raised his arm to wave hello.
words.ex_cn: 他举起手臂打招呼。
words.en: An arm is one of the two long parts of your body that are attached to your shoulders and that have your hands at the end.

words.tr: n. 一个特殊日子的前夕或前夜
words.ex: The eve of Christmas is very special.
words.ex_cn: 圣诞节前夜非常特别。
words.en: The period of time immediately before an event or occasion, especially the day before a holiday or festival.

words.ex: The duke lives in a big castle.
words.ex_cn: 公爵住在一座大城堡里。
words.en: A duke is a male ruler of a small independent state, or a man of very high rank in the British nobility.

words.tr: n. 救济金；施舍物（复数名词）
words.ex: He gave alms to the poor man.
words.ex_cn: 他施舍给那个穷人。
words.en: Alms are money, food, or other donations given to the poor or needy as an act of charity.

words.ex: The edge of the table is sharp.
words.ex_cn: 桌子的边缘很锋利。
words.en: The edge of something is the place or line where it stops, or the part of it that is furthest from the middle.

words.tr: n. 尼罗河（非洲东北部的一条大河）
words.ex: The Nile flows through Egypt.
words.ex_cn: 尼罗河流经埃及。
words.en: The Nile is a major north-flowing river in northeastern Africa, generally regarded as the longest river in the world.

words.ex: He bind the books with string.
words.ex_cn: 他用绳子把书捆起来。
words.en: To tie something or someone tightly or to fasten something.

words.ex: They laid new tile in the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 他们在厨房铺了新的瓷砖。
words.en: A tile is a flat piece of baked clay, carpet, cork, or other material, used especially for covering roofs and floors.

words.ex: Climbing the mountain without oxygen was a great feat.
words.ex_cn: 在不吸氧的情况下爬山是一项伟大的壮举。
words.en: A feat is an act or achievement that shows great courage, skill, or strength.

words.ex: He is a famous poet who writes simple poems.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位写简单诗歌的著名诗人。
words.en: A poet is a person who writes poems.

words.tr:
n. 服装；制服；装束
v. 穿衣
words.ex: He wore old garb to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着旧衣服去参加派对。
words.en: Garb refers to clothing, especially of a distinctive or special kind.

words.tr: adj. 弯曲的； v. 弯曲；使弯曲；“bend”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The bent pipe leaked water.
words.ex_cn: 弯曲的管道漏水了。
words.en: Bent is used to describe something that is not straight but has a curve or angle in it. It can also refer to someone's natural talent or inclination towards a particular activity or subject.

words.ex: He eats beef for dinner every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日吃牛肉当晚餐。
words.en: Beef is the meat from a cow, bull, or ox. When people beef about something, they complain about it.

words.ex: He cooked soup with a leek.
words.ex_cn: 他用一根韭葱煮了汤。
words.en: A leek is a vegetable that is related to the onion, with flat leaves and a white base. It is used in cooking for its mild flavor.

words.ex: He is thin.
words.ex_cn: 他很瘦。
words.en: Having a small distance between opposite sides; not thick.

words.ex: The smoke came out of the vent.
words.ex_cn: 烟从排气口飘了出来。
words.en: A vent is a hole or opening that allows air, gas, or liquid to pass out of or into a confined space.

words.tr:
v. 力劝；
n. 强烈欲望；
words.ex: My teacher urged me to study harder.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师力劝我更加努力学习。
words.en: If you urge someone to do something, you try hard to persuade them to do it.

words.tr: v. 下沉；“sink”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The boat sank slowly in the sea.
words.ex_cn: 船在海里慢慢下沉了。
words.en: If something has sunk, it has gone down below the surface of a liquid or soft substance.

words.ex: The car's fender showed a dint from the collision.
words.ex_cn: 汽车的挡泥板因碰撞而出现了一个凹痕。
words.en: If you achieve something by dint of a particular quality or action, you achieve it by means of that quality or action.

words.tr: n. 一件物品或商品；项目；一则；
words.ex: This item is on sale for $5.
words.ex_cn: 这件商品正在促销，售价5美元。
words.en: An item is one of a collection or list of objects.

words.tr:
n. 冲；匆忙；
v. 冲；赶忙做；
words.ex: There was a rush to buy tickets for the concert.
words.ex_cn: 人们争相购买演唱会的票。
words.en: If you rush somewhere, you go there quickly. A rush is a situation in which you need to go somewhere or do something very quickly.

words.tr: n. 伊利（美国港市）；伊利湖（北美五大湖之一）；伊利人
words.ex: The city of Erie is located on the shores of Lake Erie.
words.ex_cn: 伊利市位于伊利湖畔。
words.en: Strange and frightening, often because of being connected with something supernatural.

words.ex: She uses natural dyes to color her clothes.
words.ex_cn: 她用天然染料给衣服上色。
words.en: A dye is a substance used to change the color of something, especially fabrics or hair.

words.tr: abbr. 艾滋病；获得性免疫缺乏综合症；“Acquired Immune Deficiency Syndrome”的缩写；
words.ex: He got tested for aids last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周做了艾滋病检测。
words.en: AIDS is a disease caused by a virus that weakens a person's immune system, making them vulnerable to other infections and diseases.

words.tr: n. 敌人；仇敌；敌人，仇敌( foe的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The two teams were fierce foes in the championship.
words.ex_cn: 这两个队在冠军赛中是死对头。
words.en: An enemy or opponent.

words.ex: He told a tale about a brave knight.
words.ex_cn: 他讲了一个关于勇敢骑士的故事。
words.en: A tale is a story, especially one that is full of exciting or magical events.

words.ex: He left a heap of clothes on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他把一堆衣服扔在地上。
words.en: A heap of things is a pile of them, especially a pile arranged in a rather untidy way.

words.tr:
n. 熊；
v. 承受；忍受；带有；生（孩子）；
words.ex: A bear walked near the campsite.
words.ex_cn: 一只熊在露营地附近走动。
words.en: If you bear something, you accept it and are able to deal with it, even though it is unpleasant or painful. A bear is a large, strong wild animal with thick fur and sharp claws.

words.ex: The lion killed a deer in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 狮子在森林里杀死了一只鹿。
words.en: To kill someone or something means to cause their death.

words.tr:
n. （木）髓；（柑橘等）外皮下的海绵层；精髓；核心
v. 除去木髓
words.ex: The pith of the essay is its call for social change.
words.ex_cn: 这篇文章的核心是其呼吁社会变革。
words.en: The essential or most vital part of some idea or experience.

words.ex: The doctor detected rales in the patient's lungs during the examination.
words.ex_cn: 医生在检查时在患者的肺部听到了罗音。
words.en: A rale is an abnormal rattling sound heard when examining unhealthy lungs with a stethoscope.

words.ex: The ice melts in the sun.
words.ex_cn: 冰在阳光下融化。
words.en: If a solid substance melts or if you melt it, it changes to a liquid, usually because it has been heated.

words.tr:
n. 鞭子；鞭打；睫毛
v. 鞭打；摆动；抨击
words.ex: The farmer used a lash to guide the horse.
words.ex_cn: 农夫用鞭子赶马。
words.en: To lash means to hit someone or something with a whip or something similar. It can also mean to criticize someone or something severely. As a noun, it refers to the act of hitting with a whip, the whip itself, or the hairs that grow from the edge of an eyelid.

words.ex: The students gathered in the hall for the assembly.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在大厅里集合。
words.en: A hall is a large room or building which is used for public events such as concerts, exhibitions, and meetings.

words.tr:
n. 轭；枷锁；束缚
v. 上轭；使强行结合
words.ex: The farmer put a yoke on the oxen.
words.ex_cn: 农夫给牛套上了轭。
words.en: A yoke is a wooden bar that is fastened over the necks of two animals, especially cattle, and connected to the vehicle or load that they are pulling. It can also refer to something that binds people together or something that people find oppressive.

words.ex: The dog dug deep pits in the yard.
words.ex_cn: 狗在院子里挖了深坑。
words.en: A large hole in the ground, especially one from which minerals are extracted.

words.tr:
n. 刻度盘；
v. 拨；
words.ex: He looked at the clock's dial to check the time.
words.ex_cn: 他看着钟的刻度盘来查看时间。
words.en: A dial is the face of a clock or watch, or a similar control on a piece of equipment, which shows you the time or other information. As a verb, to dial means to call a telephone number by pressing the buttons on a telephone.

words.ex: The festival is a trad that has been celebrated for centuries.
words.ex_cn: 这个节日是一个已经庆祝了几个世纪的传统。
words.en: A trad is a custom or belief that has existed for a long time among a particular group of people.

words.ex: He tore his shirt while climbing the fence.
words.ex_cn: 他爬篱笆时把衬衫撕破了。
words.en: Tore is the past tense of tear, which means to pull something apart or to pieces.

words.ex: The book is 10 inches long.
words.ex_cn: 这本书长10英寸。
words.en: An inch is a unit of length equal to one twelfth of a foot.

words.ex: They slept in a tent during the camping trip.
words.ex_cn: 他们在露营时睡在帐篷里。
words.en: A tent is a portable shelter made of fabric or other material stretched over a supporting framework of poles and usually stabilized or secured to the ground with cords and stakes.

words.ex: Please stir the soup before serving.
words.ex_cn: 请在上菜前搅拌一下汤。
words.en: To mix a substance or move it around using a spoon or other object; to cause to move or act; to arouse or excite.

words.tr:
n. 旅行；旅程；
v. 绊倒；
words.ex: We went on a trip to the mountains last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们去山里旅行了。
words.en: A trip is a journey in which you go somewhere, usually for a short time, and come back again.

words.ex: The child hurt his limb while playing.
words.ex_cn: 孩子玩耍时伤到了肢体。
words.en: A limb is one of the jointed appendages of an animal used for locomotion or grasping: arm; leg; wing; flipper.

words.tr: v. 〈古〉“have”的第三人称单数，相当于has
words.ex: He hath a book in his hand.
words.ex_cn: 他手里有一本书。
words.en: Hath is an archaic form of the verb 'have', used in the third person singular present tense.

words.tr:
adj. 精瘦的；精简的；不景气的；
v. 倾斜；倚靠；
words.ex: The dog is lean and fast.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗精瘦而敏捷。
words.en: If you lean in a particular direction, you bend your body in that direction. If you lean on or against someone or something, you rest against them so that they partly support your weight. If you describe someone as lean, you mean that they are thin but look strong and healthy. If you describe a period of time as lean, you mean that it is a time when people have very little of something, especially money.

words.ex: The farmer raises fowl for eggs and meat.
words.ex_cn: 农民饲养家禽来获取鸡蛋和肉。
words.en: A fowl is a bird, especially one that can be eaten as food, such as a chicken, duck, or turkey.

words.ex: He won the lottery by pure luck.
words.ex_cn: 他纯粹是靠运气中了彩票。
words.en: Luck is the force that causes things, especially good things, to happen to you by chance and not as a result of your own efforts or abilities.

words.tr: v. (古) do的第三人称单数现在式
words.ex: He doth protest too much.
words.ex_cn: 他抗议得太多了。
words.en: Doth is an archaic form of the third person singular present tense of 'do'.

words.ex: The lighthouse is on the cape.
words.ex_cn: 灯塔位于海角上。
words.en: A cape is a sleeveless outer garment that fastens at the neck and hangs over the shoulders and back, or a piece of land jutting into the sea or some other large body of water.

words.ex: The children play by the lake.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在湖边玩耍。
words.en: A large area of water surrounded by land.

words.ex: He is eating soup for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他正在吃汤当午餐。
words.en: Soup is a liquid food made by boiling meat, fish, or vegetables in water or stock.

words.ex: The site of the old church is now a park.
words.ex_cn: 旧教堂的位置现在是一个公园。
words.en: A site is a piece of ground that is used for a particular purpose or where a particular thing happens.

words.ex: He omitted the last word in the sentence.
words.ex_cn: 他省略了句子中的最后一个词。
words.en: If you omit something, you do not include it in an activity or piece of work, deliberately or accidentally.

words.ex: He works at a Dell factory.
words.ex_cn: 他在戴尔工厂工作。
words.en: A dell is a small valley, usually among trees.

words.tr:
n. 核；核心；重点；
adj. 核心的；
words.ex: The core of the apple is not edible.
words.ex_cn: 苹果的核心不能吃。
words.en: The central or most important part of something.

words.ex: He vends fresh fruit on the street corner.
words.ex_cn: 他在街角叫卖新鲜水果。
words.en: To sell or offer for sale to the public.

words.tr:
n. 毛孔；小孔
v. 细看；钻研；凝视
words.ex: Sweat comes out through the pores of the skin.
words.ex_cn: 汗水通过皮肤上的毛孔排出。
words.en: A pore is a tiny opening in a surface that allows liquids or gases to pass through. As a verb, to pore means to read or study something very carefully.

words.ex: The stone skimmed over the water.
words.ex_cn: 石头掠过水面。
words.en: To remove a substance from the surface of a liquid, or to read or consider something quickly in order to understand the main points, without studying it in detail.

words.ex: She bought three eggs at the market.
words.ex_cn: 她在市场上买了三个蛋。
words.en: Eggs are oval objects that are produced by a female bird and which contain a baby bird. Chickens' eggs are often eaten as food.

words.ex: This book is ours.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是我们的人或物。
words.en: You use ours to refer to something that belongs or relates both to yourself and to one or more other people.

words.ex: They deem this plan too risky.
words.ex_cn: 他们认为这个计划太冒险了。
words.en: If you deem something to be the case, you consider that it is the case.

words.tr:
n. 营地；
v. 宿营；露营；
words.ex: The children set up a camp near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在湖边搭了一个营地。
words.en: A camp is a place where people live temporarily in tents or other temporary structures.

words.ex: He made a plea for help.
words.ex_cn: 他恳求帮助。
words.en: A plea is a request or an appeal made in an urgent or emotional manner, or a statement made by someone in a court of law in which they say whether they are guilty of a crime or not.

words.ex: He used a thin wire to fix the broken hook.
words.ex_cn: 他用一根细金属丝固定了坏掉的钩子。
words.en: A wire is a long thin piece of metal that is used to fasten things or to carry electric current.

words.ex: He dumped the trash into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 他把垃圾倒进了垃圾桶。
words.en: To dump something means to get rid of it quickly and without care, often because it is no longer wanted or needed. It can also refer to the place where waste is left.

words.tr:
adj. 灰色的；
n. 灰色；
words.ex: The sky is grey today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天空是灰色的。
words.en: Of a color intermediate between black and white, as of ashes or lead.

words.ex: Clean water is a boon to the village.
words.ex_cn: 干净的水对这个村庄是有益的。
words.en: A boon is something that is very helpful and improves the quality of life.

words.ex: The void on the page made the text look empty.
words.ex_cn: 页面上的空白让文字看起来空荡荡的。
words.en: If you describe a situation or a feeling as a void, you mean that it seems empty because there is nothing interesting or worthwhile about it.

words.tr: adj. 糟糕透顶的；恶劣的；卑鄙的
words.ex: He said a vile thing to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他对朋友说了句卑鄙的话。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is vile, you mean that they are extremely unpleasant.

words.tr: v. 参阅; n. （Vide）（瑞、克）维德（人名）
words.ex: Please vide the relevant section of the manual for more details.
words.ex_cn: 请参阅手册的相关部分以获取更多详情。
words.en: To see or look at something.

words.ex: The book has lain on the table for days.
words.ex_cn: 这本书已经放在桌子上好几天了。
words.en: Past participle of lie, meaning to be in or assume a horizontal or resting position on a supporting surface.

words.ex: The dogs bark loudly at night.
words.ex_cn: 狗在晚上大声吠叫。
words.en: A dog is a very common four-legged animal that is often kept by people as a pet or to guard or hunt.

words.ex: The bridge has a stone arch.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥有一个石拱。
words.en: An arch is a structure that is curved at the top and is usually made of stone or brick. Arches are often used to support the weight of a bridge or the roof of a building.

words.ex: The path leads to the village.
words.ex_cn: 这条路通向村庄。
words.en: A path is a way or track designed for walking or traveling along, especially through the countryside.

words.ex: The pillow is soft and comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 这个枕头很软，很舒服。
words.en: Something that is soft is pleasant to touch, and not rough or hard.

words.ex: The child drew dots on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在纸上画了小圆点。
words.en: Small round marks or spots.

words.ex: He walks one mile to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天步行一英里去学校。
words.en: A unit of linear measure equal to 1,760 yards (approximately 1.609 kilometers).

words.ex: The soldiers defended the fort during the battle.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们在战斗中保卫了堡垒。
words.en: A fort is a strong building or a place with a wall or fence around it where soldiers can stay and be safe from the enemy.

words.ex: The apple is ripe and ready to eat.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果熟了，可以吃了。
words.en: When fruit or crops are ripe, they are ready to be eaten or harvested because they have developed to the right stage.

words.ex: The shop sells handmade ware like pots and cups.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售陶罐和杯子等手工艺品。
words.en: Objects or goods made of a particular material or for a particular use.

words.ex: Children rely on their parents for food and shelter.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们依靠父母提供食物和住所。
words.en: If you rely on someone or something, you need them and depend on them in order to live or work properly.

words.ex: A white swan swam quietly on the lake.
words.ex_cn: 一只白天鹅静静地在湖上游泳。
words.en: A swan is a large, white bird with a long neck that lives on rivers and lakes.

words.ex: Bees are flying around the flowers.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂在花周围飞舞。
words.en: Bees are flying insects closely related to wasps and ants, known for their role in pollination and, in the case of the best-known bee species, the western honey bee, for producing honey and beeswax.

words.ex: The gale knocked down several trees.
words.ex_cn: 大风刮倒了几棵树。
words.en: A gale is a very strong wind.

words.ex: He spoke quietly lest he wake the baby.
words.ex_cn: 他低声说话，以免吵醒婴儿。
words.en: If you do something lest something unpleasant should happen, you do it to try to prevent the unpleasant thing from happening.

words.tr: v. 投掷；投射；选派；铸造
words.ex: She casts her vote in the election.
words.ex_cn: 她在选举中投了票。
words.en: To throw something forcefully in a specific direction; to assign a role to an actor; to shape a material by pouring it into a mold.

words.ex: The forest is dense with trees.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林树木茂密。
words.en: Something that is dense contains a lot of things or people in a small area.

words.tr: v. 喜欢；“like”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: She liked the blue dress.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢那条蓝色的裙子。
words.en: past tense and past participle of like; to find agreeable, enjoyable, or satisfactory

words.tr:
n. 轨道；
v. 绕...轨道而行；
words.ex: The moon moves around the Earth in an orbit.
words.ex_cn: 月亮围绕地球在轨道上运行。
words.en: An orbit is the curved path, usually elliptical, described by a planet, satellite, spaceship, etc., around a celestial body, as the sun.

words.ex: Her smile has a special charm.
words.ex_cn: 她的微笑有一种特别的魅力。
words.en: If you say that someone has charm, you mean that they behave in a friendly and pleasant way that makes people like them. A charm is also a small ornament that is fixed to a bracelet or necklace.

words.ex: He rubbed his chest after the cough.
words.ex_cn: 他咳嗽后揉了揉胸部。
words.en: The front part of a person's body between the neck and the stomach, or a large strong box used for storing things.

words.ex: He made a mistake in haste.
words.ex_cn: 他匆忙中犯了一个错误。
words.en: Haste is the quality of doing something quickly, sometimes too quickly so that you are careless and make mistakes.

words.ex: He loves listening to music every night.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢每天晚上听音乐。
words.en: Music is the pattern of sounds produced by people singing or playing instruments.

words.tr:
n. 山；
v. 逐渐增加；
words.ex: He climbed the mount early in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 他一大早爬了那座山。
words.en: To mount something means to go up it or to get on it. It can also refer to the act of organizing and beginning something, such as an event or an exhibition.

words.ex: He sat on the bench in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在公园的长凳上。
words.en: A bench is a long seat for several people, typically made of wood or metal.

words.ex: He brushed his teeth every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上刷牙。
words.en: The hard, white objects in the mouth that are used for biting and chewing.

words.ex: There are heaps of books on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 地板上堆了大量的书。
words.en: A large quantity or number of things; a pile.

words.tr:
v. 夺取；费力取得；歪曲
n. 扭；拧
words.ex: He wrests the ball from his opponent.
words.ex_cn: 他从对手那里抢走球。
words.en: To wrest something from someone means to take it from them with a lot of effort, often because they do not want to give it to you.

words.ex: He felt deep grief after his dog died.
words.ex_cn: 他的狗去世后，他感到深深的悲痛。
words.en: Intense sorrow, especially caused by someone's death.

words.ex: He is the taker of the last cookie.
words.ex_cn: 他是那个拿走最后一块饼干的人。
words.en: A taker is someone who accepts or takes something that is offered to them.

words.tr: v. 驱使；驾驶；“drive”的过去式；
words.ex: Fear drove him to leave the city.
words.ex_cn: 恐惧驱使他离开了这座城市。
words.en: A drove is a large group of animals, especially cattle or sheep, moving together. As a verb, it is the past tense of drive, meaning to force animals or people to move in a particular direction.

words.tr: adj. 清醒的；严肃的；素淡的；
words.ex: He stayed sober after drinking only water.
words.ex_cn: 他只喝了水，保持清醒。
words.en: If you are sober, you are not drunk. If you are sober, you are serious and thoughtful.

words.tr: adj. 有……大小的；相比（size 的过去式和过去分词）；
words.ex: The box is sized to fit the toy inside.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子的大小刚好能装下里面的玩具。
words.en: Having a specified size or dimension.

words.tr: adj. 疲倦的；厌烦的； v. “tire”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He felt tired after running for an hour.
words.ex_cn: 他跑了一个小时后感到疲倦。
words.en: If you are tired, you feel that you want to rest or sleep.

words.ex: The boy will climb the tree to get the ball.
words.ex_cn: 男孩会爬树去拿球。
words.en: To climb means to go up something, such as a mountain or a ladder, usually with some effort.

words.ex: He finishes his tasks before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭前完成他的任务。
words.en: Activities or pieces of work that need to be completed, often as part of a job or project.

words.ex: The children collected rocks by the river.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在河边收集岩石。
words.en: Rocks are large pieces of stone that are found on the ground or in the sea. They can also refer to a type of music that is characterized by a strong beat and simple tunes.

words.ex: He lacks confidence when speaking in public.
words.ex_cn: 他在公众场合讲话时缺乏信心。
words.en: If something or someone lacks a particular quality or thing, they do not have any or enough of it.

words.ex: He plays soccer as his favorite sport.
words.ex_cn: 他把足球当作最喜欢的体育运动。
words.en: Sport is a physical activity that is governed by a set of rules or customs and often engaged in competitively.

words.ex: He wears ultra sunglasses to protect his eyes.
words.ex_cn: 他戴超深色太阳镜来保护眼睛。
words.en: An ultra is someone who has extreme political or religious views, or who takes an extreme position on a particular issue.

words.ex: The pirates found a big booty on the ship.
words.ex_cn: 海盗们在船上发现了一大笔战利品。
words.en: Booty refers to valuable goods or riches obtained, especially those taken in war or by piracy; it can also colloquially refer to the buttocks.

words.tr:
n. 小块；碎片；废金属；吵架
v. 废弃；取消
adj. 废弃的
words.ex: He picked up a scrap of paper from the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他从地上捡起一张纸片。
words.en: A scrap is a small piece or amount of something, especially one that is left over after the greater part has been used. It can also mean to discard or get rid of something as being no longer useful or necessary.

words.ex: They will marry next summer.
words.ex_cn: 他们将在明年夏天结婚。
words.en: To marry someone means to become their husband or wife in a legal or religious ceremony.

words.tr: n. 游牧民；流浪者；游牧生活；流浪生活
words.ex: The nomad walks with his sheep across the desert.
words.ex_cn: 游牧民带着他的羊群穿越沙漠。
words.en: A nomad is someone who has no permanent home and moves according to the seasons from place to place in search of food, water, and grazing land.

words.tr: n. [建]升降机，电梯；[建]升降机，电梯（lift 的复数）； v. 举起；
words.ex: The lifts in this building are very fast.
words.ex_cn: 这栋楼里的电梯非常快。
words.en: To lift something means to move it to a higher position. The noun lift can refer to the act of lifting or to a device that carries people or goods up and down in a building.

words.tr: n. [水运]港口；[电子][计]端口；[水运]港口，[电子][计]端口（port 的复数）；
words.ex: The ships dock at the ports at night.
words.ex_cn: 船只在夜晚停靠在港口。
words.en: A port is a town by the sea or on a river, which has a harbour, or the part of a town near the harbour where ships dock to load and unload.

words.tr:
v. 击；撞；
n. 撞击；敲击；
words.ex: He knock on the door.
words.ex_cn: 他敲了敲门。
words.en: To strike a surface noisily to attract attention, especially when waiting to be let in through a door.

words.tr: v. 喝；喝酒；“drink”的过去分词； adj. 喝醉的；
words.ex: He has drunk all the water.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了所有的水。
words.en: If someone is drunk, they have consumed so much alcohol that it has affected their ability to think and speak clearly.

words.ex: He earns money by washing cars.
words.ex_cn: 他通过洗车赚钱。
words.en: To earn means to receive money as payment for work that you do, or to get something that you deserve because of your qualities or actions.

words.tr: n. 莱茵河（欧洲的一条主要河流）
words.ex: The Rhine is one of the major rivers in Europe.
words.ex_cn: 莱茵河是欧洲的主要河流之一。
words.en: The Rhine is one of the major rivers of Europe, flowing from Switzerland through Germany and the Netherlands into the North Sea.

words.ex: The road has many signs for directions.
words.ex_cn: 这条路有很多方向标记。
words.en: A sign is a mark or shape that always has a particular meaning, for example in mathematics or music. Signs can also be gestures or movements that you make with your hands or head to give someone information, instructions, or a warning. In addition, a sign can be an event, fact, or situation that shows that something exists, is happening, or may happen in the future.

words.ex: She put the food on a clean plate.
words.ex_cn: 她把食物放在一个干净的盘子里。
words.en: A flat dish, typically circular and made of china, from which food is eaten or served.

words.ex: The workers put the money in the safes at night.
words.ex_cn: 工人们晚上把钱放进保险箱里。
words.en: A safe is a strong metal cabinet with special locks, used for storing valuable items or important documents.

words.ex: The two companies will merge next year.
words.ex_cn: 这两家公司明年将合并。
words.en: To combine or unite to form a single entity.

words.ex: The poets write beautiful poems at night.
words.ex_cn: 诗人们在晚上写美丽的诗。
words.en: A poet is a person who writes poems.

words.tr:
int. 对不起；抱歉；
adj. 抱歉的；遗憾的；
words.ex: Sorry, I broke your cup.
words.ex_cn: 对不起，我打碎了你的杯子。
words.en: feeling or expressing regret or sorrow or a sense of loss over something done or undone

words.ex: The army corps marched through the town.
words.ex_cn: 军队军团穿过城镇行进。
words.en: A corps is a military unit consisting of a large number of soldiers, typically organized for a specific purpose.

words.ex: He scratched his scalp because it was itchy.
words.ex_cn: 他挠头皮，因为那里发痒。
words.en: The skin covering the top of the human head, or a trophy taken by cutting off the scalp of an enemy.

words.tr:
n. 塔；塔楼；
v. 高耸；
words.ex: The tower stands tall in the center of the city.
words.ex_cn: 这座塔矗立在城市中心。
words.en: A tower is a tall, narrow building, either part of a larger building such as a church or castle, or standing alone.

words.ex: Please fill out this forme with your personal information.
words.ex_cn: 请用您的个人信息填写这张表格。
words.en: A forme is a particular way in which a thing exists or appears; a shape or structure.

words.ex: The aided machine works with minimal human help.
words.ex_cn: 这台半自动机器只需很少的人工帮助就能工作。
words.en: If someone or something aids a process, they make it easier or more likely to happen.

words.ex: The outer door is locked, but the inner one is open.
words.ex_cn: 外门锁着，但内门是开着的。
words.en: Outer is used to describe something that is on the outside of something else.

words.tr:
n. 斗篷；掩护物
v. 隐瞒；掩饰
words.ex: He wore a black cloak to hide his face.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着一件黑色斗篷来遮住脸。
words.en: A cloak is a long, loose outer garment which is worn over other clothes, especially in cold weather. It can also refer to something that hides or covers another thing.

words.tr: v. 结合；“fuse”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The two metals fused together when heated.
words.ex_cn: 当加热时，这两种金属结合在一起。
words.en: If something is fused, it has been joined or blended together, often by melting.

words.ex: Isaac loves to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 艾萨克喜欢解数学题。
words.en: A male given name of Hebrew origin, meaning 'laughter', famously borne by the son of Abraham and Sarah in the Bible.

words.tr:
n. 梦；梦想；
v. 梦想；做梦；
words.ex: I had a strange dream last night.
words.ex_cn: 我昨晚做了一个奇怪的梦。
words.en: A dream is a series of thoughts, images, and sensations occurring in a person's mind during sleep. It can also refer to a cherished aspiration, ambition, or ideal.

words.tr: n. 树干；大衣箱；象鼻子；
words.ex: The elephant held the branch with its trunk.
words.ex_cn: 大象用它的鼻子抓住树枝。
words.en: The main stem of a tree, below the branches, and above the ground; the main part of the body, excluding the head, arms, and legs; the long, flexible nose of an elephant; a large, strong box used for transporting or storing clothes and other personal possessions.

words.ex: The tutti orchestra played loudly.
words.ex_cn: 整个乐团大声演奏。
words.en: In music, 'tutti' is an Italian term that means all or everyone, used to indicate that all performers are to play or sing simultaneously.

words.ex: He is an actor in a famous movie.
words.ex_cn: 他是电影中的一名演员。
words.en: An actor is a person whose profession is acting on the stage, in films, or on television.

words.ex: He finished the work ahead of time.
words.ex_cn: 他提前完成了工作。
words.en: If someone is ahead in a competition or comparison, they are winning or doing better than the other people involved.

words.ex: Smoking damages your lungs.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟会损害你的肺。
words.en: The lungs are the organs in the chest that allow you to breathe.

words.tr: n. 剧痛；突然的剧痛；痛苦
words.ex: She felt pangs of guilt after lying to her friend.
words.ex_cn: 她对朋友撒谎后感到内疚的痛苦。
words.en: A pang is a sudden sharp feeling, especially of painful emotion.

words.ex: This cake has a finer taste than the other one.
words.ex_cn: 这个蛋糕的味道更好。
words.en: Of superior quality, more delicate, or more refined.

words.tr: n. 偶数；打赌中赌注与赢款相等的情况
words.ex: The teacher asked the students to list all the evens from 1 to 10.
words.ex_cn: 老师让学生列出1到10之间的所有偶数。
words.en: In betting, evens refers to a situation where the stake equals the winnings. It can also mean even numbers in mathematics.

words.ex: His speech was full of trite phrases.
words.ex_cn: 他的演讲充满了陈腐的表达。
words.en: If you say that something such as an idea, remark, or story is trite, you mean that it is dull and boring because it has been said or told too many times.

words.tr:
n. 住所；居住处
v. 逗留；“abide”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: His abode is a small house near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他的住所是一栋靠近湖边的小房子。
words.en: A place of residence; a home.

words.ex: He uses a lot of slang when talking with friends.
words.ex_cn: 他和朋友聊天时用很多俚语。
words.en: Slang refers to a type of language that consists of words and phrases that are regarded as very informal, are more common in speech than writing, and are typically restricted to a particular context or group of people.

words.tr:
v. 打架；战斗；
n. 打架；战斗；
words.ex: The two boys fight every day after school.
words.ex_cn: 这两个男孩每天放学后都打架。
words.en: To fight means to take part in a violent struggle involving the exchange of physical blows or the use of weapons. It can also refer to a determined effort to achieve or resist something.

words.ex: The mayor walks to work every morning.
words.ex_cn: 市长每天早上步行上班。
words.en: The mayor of a town or city is the person who has been elected to represent it for a fixed period of time, or, in some places, to run its government.

words.ex: He sat on the chair and read a book.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在椅子上读书。
words.en: A chair is a piece of furniture for one person to sit on, with a back and usually four legs.

words.tr: n. 跨度( span的名词复数 ); 持续时间; 一段时间; （五指张开时的）指距
words.ex: The bridges have long spans over the river.
words.ex_cn: 这些桥在河上有着很长的跨度。
words.en: If something spans a range of things, it covers that range.

words.tr:
adj. 不锋利的；耿直的
v. 使变钝
words.ex: The knife is blunt and cannot cut paper.
words.ex_cn: 这把刀不锋利，切不动纸。
words.en: If you are blunt, you say exactly what you think without trying to be polite.

words.tr: adj. 锋利的；骤变的；灵敏的；尖刻的；
words.ex: The knife is sharp enough to cut paper.
words.ex_cn: 这把刀足够锋利，可以切纸。
words.en: Having a thin edge or a fine point that is capable of cutting or piercing; keen.

words.tr:
v. 抓住；赶上；理解；得病；接住；
n. 接住；搭扣；
words.ex: He tried to catch the ball.
words.ex_cn: 他试图抓住球。
words.en: If you catch something or someone, you manage to get hold of them or stop them from moving, often after a chase or search.

words.ex: The miner works deep underground.
words.ex_cn: 矿工在地下深处工作。
words.en: A miner is a person who works in a mine, extracting coal, gold, or other minerals.

words.tr: v. 讨厌；憎恨；“hate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He hated waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 他讨厌早起。
words.en: If you hate someone or something, you have an extremely strong feeling of dislike for them.

words.tr:
n. 信任；信赖；
v. 信任；信赖；
words.ex: I have trust in my best friend.
words.ex_cn: 我信任我最好的朋友。
words.en: If you trust someone, you believe that they are honest and sincere and will not deliberately do anything to harm you.

words.ex: He touched his cheek gently.
words.ex_cn: 他轻轻摸了摸脸颊。
words.en: The soft part of a person's face below the eye and between the nose and ear.

words.ex: The needy family received food from the charity.
words.ex_cn: 这个贫穷的家庭从慈善机构收到了食物。
words.en: Needy people do not have enough food, medicine, or clothing, or adequate houses.

words.ex: The cut on his finger is bleeding.
words.ex_cn: 他手指上的伤口正在流血。
words.en: When you bleed, blood flows from your body, usually because you are injured.

words.ex: The book has a thick cover.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有厚厚的封面。
words.en: Having a large distance between the top and bottom or front and back surfaces; not thin.

words.ex: This house has a modern design.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子具有现代的设计。
words.en: Modern means relating to the present time, for example the present decade or present century.

words.ex: The hunter kills the deer for food.
words.ex_cn: 猎人杀死鹿作为食物。
words.en: To cause the death of a living thing; to put an end to something.

words.tr: v. 堆叠；堆起；放置；装入； adj. 堆起( pile的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The books were piled on the table.
words.ex_cn: 书被堆在桌子上。
words.en: To arrange or place in a pile.

words.ex: He is prone to colds in winter.
words.ex_cn: 他冬天容易感冒。
words.en: If you are prone to a particular problem or characteristic, you are likely to be affected by it or to have it.

words.ex: She binds the books with a strong thread.
words.ex_cn: 她用结实的线装订书籍。
words.en: To tie or fasten something tightly; to constrain or oblige someone to do something.

words.ex: He amass wealth by working hard.
words.ex_cn: 他通过努力工作积累财富。
words.en: If you amass something such as money or information, you gradually collect a large amount of it.

words.ex: He kneaded the dough for bread.
words.ex_cn: 他揉了做面包的生面团。
words.en: Dough is a thick, malleable mixture of flour and liquid, used for baking into bread or pastry. It can also informally refer to money.

words.ex: This bulb uses 60 watts.
words.ex_cn: 这个灯泡使用60瓦。
words.en: A watt is a unit of power in the International System of Units (SI), defined as one joule per second.

words.tr:
v. 笑；发笑；
n. 笑；笑声；
words.ex: He laugh when he saw the funny cat.
words.ex_cn: 他看到那只滑稽的猫时笑了。
words.en: To laugh means to make the spontaneous sounds and movements of the face and body that are the instinctive expressions of lively amusement and sometimes also of derision.

words.tr:
n. 味觉；味道；品味；喜好；
v. 品尝；有…味道；
words.ex: My taste can detect sweet and sour flavors.
words.ex_cn: 我的味觉能分辨甜味和酸味。
words.en: The sensation of flavor perceived in the mouth and throat on contact with a substance.

words.tr: adj. 心照不宣的；不作声的
words.ex: They have a tacit understanding about the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他们对规则有一种心照不宣的理解。
words.en: If you refer to someone's tacit agreement or approval, you mean they are agreeing to something or approving it without actually saying so, often because they are unwilling to admit to doing so.

words.ex: He has sixty apples in his basket.
words.ex_cn: 他的篮子里有六十个苹果。
words.en: The number 60.

words.ex: He shuts the door quietly.
words.ex_cn: 他轻轻地关上了门。
words.en: To close something, especially a door, window, or lid.

words.tr:
v. 追逐；
n. 追逐；
words.ex: The dog chases the cat every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗每天早上追逐猫。
words.en: To chase someone or something means to quickly follow them or it in order to catch them.

words.ex: The soldier fought against his enemy in the war.
words.ex_cn: 士兵在战争中与他的敌人作战。
words.en: An enemy is someone who opposes you, competes with you, or is hostile towards you.

words.ex: The ancient sites attract many tourists.
words.ex_cn: 这些古代场所吸引了许多游客。
words.en: A site is a piece of ground that is used for a particular purpose or where a particular thing happens.

words.tr:
n. 标签；
v. 用标签标明；
words.ex: The bottle has a label with the name of the drink.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子上有一个写着饮料名称的标签。
words.en: A label is a piece of paper, polymer, cloth, metal, or other material affixed to a container or article, on which is written or printed information or symbols about the product or item.

words.tr:
n. 震惊；冲击；电击；震动；
v. 使震惊；使震动；
words.ex: The news of his death was a shock to everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他去世的消息让所有人都感到震惊。
words.en: A shock is a sudden, unexpected event or piece of news that causes a strong emotional reaction.

words.ex: He ate a piece of Swiss cheese for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了一片瑞士奶酪。
words.en: Relating to Switzerland or its people or culture.

words.ex: He faces his fears every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天直面自己的恐惧。
words.en: Fears are strong, often unpleasant emotions caused by the anticipation or awareness of danger.

words.ex: The baron owns a large castle in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 男爵拥有一座位于乡村的大城堡。
words.en: A baron is a man who is a member of the lowest rank of the nobility, or a powerful businessman with great influence in a particular industry.

words.ex: She adds fresh herbs to the soup.
words.ex_cn: 她往汤里加新鲜香草。
words.en: Herbs are plants with leaves, seeds, or flowers used for flavoring food, in medicine, or as fragrances.

words.tr: n. 荷马（公元前9世纪前后的希腊盲诗人）；本垒打
words.ex: Homer wrote the Iliad and the Odyssey.
words.ex_cn: 荷马写了《伊利亚特》和《奥德赛》。
words.en: In baseball, a homer is a home run, which is a hit that allows the batter to make a complete circuit of the bases and score a run. In navigation, a homer is a device that guides a vehicle or vessel back to its starting point.

words.tr:
n. 幻灯片；滑梯；
v. （使）滑动；下滑；
words.ex: He showed a slide of his vacation photos.
words.ex_cn: 他展示了一张他度假照片的幻灯片。
words.en: To move smoothly along a surface while maintaining continuous contact with it; to pass or move quietly or smoothly; a structure with a smooth sloping surface for children to slide down; a decline from a higher to a lower level or status.

words.ex: The drummer changed the tempo of the song.
words.ex_cn: 鼓手改变了这首歌的拍子。
words.en: The speed at which a piece of music is played or the rate or speed of motion or activity.

words.ex: The theft of the bike was reported to the police.
words.ex_cn: 这起自行车被盗事件已向警方报告。
words.en: Theft is the act of stealing.

words.tr: v. 铺路；铺设；“pave”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The road was paved last summer.
words.ex_cn: 这条路去年夏天被铺好了。
words.en: Covered with a firm surface, especially of flat stones or bricks.

words.ex: He wears suits to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天上班都穿西装。
words.en: A suit is a set of clothes made from the same fabric, usually including a jacket and trousers or a skirt. As a verb, to suit means to be acceptable or right for someone or something.

words.tr: n. [电]干线；输电干线；[电]干线，输电干线（main 的复数）；
words.ex: The mains power went out during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风暴期间干线电力中断了。
words.en: The mains are the pipes or wires that supply water or electricity to a building.

words.ex: Parents often spoil their children with too many toys.
words.ex_cn: 父母经常用太多玩具宠坏孩子。
words.en: To spoil something means to reduce its quality or value, often by damaging it in some way. It can also mean to treat someone, especially a child, with too much kindness or indulgence, leading to their detriment.

words.ex: The knight held a sharp sword in his hand.
words.ex_cn: 骑士手里拿着一把锋利的剑。
words.en: A sword is a weapon with a long metal blade and a hilt with a handguard, used for thrusting or striking and now typically worn as part of ceremonial dress.

words.ex: The workers used a drill to make holes in the rock.
words.ex_cn: 工人们用钻机在岩石上打孔。
words.en: A drill is a tool or machine that you use for making holes, or a method of teaching people something by making them repeat it many times.

words.tr: v. 接着发生；因而产生
words.ex: The storm ended, and peace ensued.
words.ex_cn: 风暴结束后，和平随之而来。
words.en: If something ensues, it happens immediately after another event, usually as a result of it.

words.ex: The polar bear lives in the Arctic.
words.ex_cn: 北极熊生活在北极。
words.en: relating to the North or South Pole or to the region around it; having opposite extremes or characteristics.

words.tr: v. 用意志力驱使（某事发生）( will的第三人称单数 ); 将（财产等）遗赠某人; <旧>愿意，
words.ex: She wills herself to stay calm in the face of danger.
words.ex_cn: 她用意志力让自己在危险面前保持冷静。
words.en: The mental faculty by which one deliberately chooses or decides upon a course of action; a legal document declaring a person's wishes regarding the disposal of their property after death.

words.tr:
v. 滥用；误用；虐待
n. 滥用；误用；虐待
words.ex: He misuses his phone during class.
words.ex_cn: 他在上课时滥用手机。
words.en: The incorrect or improper use of something.

words.tr: n. 汽车；汽车公司证券；发动机（motor 的复数）；
words.ex: The motors are parked outside the house.
words.ex_cn: 汽车停在房子外面。
words.en: A motor is a machine that converts electrical energy into mechanical energy, used to power various devices or vehicles.

words.tr: v. 集总; 结成块( lump的过去式和过去分词 ); 把…归并在一起（考虑），将人[物]同等对待
words.ex: He lumped all the toys into one box.
words.ex_cn: 他把所有玩具都塞进了一个箱子里。
words.en: Combined or grouped together into a single mass or category.

words.ex: The two countries became allies during the war.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家在战争期间成为了盟友。
words.en: Countries or people who are allies are united in war or in a political or economic struggle against another country or group of countries.

words.ex: He pulled the keys from the drawer.
words.ex_cn: 他从抽屉里拿出钥匙。
words.en: A drawer is a sliding container that fits into a piece of furniture, such as a desk or chest, and is used for storing things.

words.ex: The payers of the tax are responsible for submitting their payments on time.
words.ex_cn: n. 纳税人负责按时缴纳税款。
words.en: Payers are individuals or entities that make payments, especially in the context of taxes, bills, or other financial obligations.

words.ex: He refuted the claim with clear evidence.
words.ex_cn: 他用清晰的证据驳斥了这一说法。
words.en: To prove a statement or theory to be wrong or false; to deny the truth or accuracy of something.

words.tr: v. 体现；使具体化；包含
words.ex: He embodies kindness and patience.
words.ex_cn: 他体现了善良和耐心。
words.en: To embody means to represent a quality or an idea exactly; to include or contain something.

words.ex: He is greedy and always wants more candy.
words.ex_cn: 他很贪婪，总是想要更多的糖果。
words.en: If you describe someone as greedy, you mean that they want to have more of something such as food or money than is necessary or fair.

words.tr: n. 马德拉斯棉布（一种薄棉布可做衬衫、窗帘等）；马德拉斯咖喱菜; n. （Madras）（美、印）...
words.ex: She sewed a dress from a Madras fabric.
words.ex_cn: 她用马德拉斯棉布缝制了一条裙子。
words.en: A lightweight cotton fabric with a plaid, striped, or checked pattern.

words.ex: He sings gospel music every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日唱福音音乐。
words.en: The teachings of Jesus and the apostles, especially as contained in the first four books of the New Testament, known as the Gospels.

words.ex: The solution lies herein.
words.ex_cn: 解决方法就在这里。
words.en: in this place or thing, or in this document

words.ex: The police caught the men who committed crimes.
words.ex_cn: 警察抓到了那些犯下罪行的人。
words.en: Crimes are illegal actions or activities for which a person can be punished by law.

words.tr: v. 兴旺；繁荣；茁壮成长；
words.ex: Plants thrive in sunny places.
words.ex_cn: 植物在阳光充足的地方茁壮成长。
words.en: To thrive means to grow or develop well or vigorously.

words.tr: v. 加入；连接；参加；连接( join的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He joined the club last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周加入了这个俱乐部。
words.en: If you join something, you become a member of it or start to take part in it. If two things join, they come together and are connected.

words.ex: The ladies are talking in the park.
words.ex_cn: 这些女士们正在公园里聊天。
words.en: Used as a polite or respectful way of addressing or referring to women.

words.ex: The door opens because the hinges are loose.
words.ex_cn: 门能打开是因为铰链松了。
words.en: A hinge is a piece of metal, wood, or plastic that is used to join two things together so that one of them can swing or move freely.

words.ex: He hurled the ball across the field.
words.ex_cn: 他用力把球扔过了田野。
words.en: To throw something with great force.

words.ex: She wrote a poetic letter to her friend.
words.ex_cn: 她给朋友写了一封诗意的信。
words.en: Something that is poetic is very beautiful and expresses emotions in a sensitive or moving way.

words.ex: The government has levied a new tax on luxury goods.
words.ex_cn: 政府对奢侈品征收了新税。
words.en: To impose or collect (a tax, fee, or fine).

words.tr:
n. 螺钉；“screw”的复数
v. 用螺钉固定；“screw”的第三人称单数
words.ex: He tightened the screws on the chair to make it more stable.
words.ex_cn: 他拧紧了椅子上的螺丝，使其更加稳固。
words.en: A screw is a metal fastener with a threaded shank that is inserted into materials to hold them together or to adjust their position.

words.ex: I hereby declare my agreement.
words.ex_cn: 我据此声明我的同意。
words.en: You use hereby when you are making an official statement or declaration, or when you are formally stating something.

words.ex: The rain will retard the construction of the road.
words.ex_cn: 雨水会延迟道路的建设。
words.en: To retard something means to delay it or make it happen more slowly than it would otherwise.

words.tr: n. 骑马；乘车； v. 骑；乘坐；“ride”的现在分词；
words.ex: He enjoys riding every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都喜欢骑马。
words.en: The activity or sport of riding horses.

words.ex: It was futile to try to fix the broken clock.
words.ex_cn: 试图修理坏掉的钟表是徒劳的。
words.en: If you say that something is futile, you mean there is no point in doing it, usually because it has no chance of succeeding.

words.ex: The government announced a major reform in education.
words.ex_cn: 政府宣布了教育方面的重大改革。
words.en: If someone reforms a system, they change or improve it.

words.tr: v. 错过；漏掉；想念；“miss”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He missed the bus this morning.
words.ex_cn: 他今天早上错过了公交车。
words.en: If you miss something, you fail to hit it, for example when you have thrown something at it or you have shot a bullet at it.

words.tr: adj. 命中注定的； v. 注定；“doom”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The doomed ship sank in the storm.
words.ex_cn: 那艘命中注定的船在风暴中沉没了。
words.en: If something is doomed, it is certain to fail or be destroyed.

words.ex: The museum gets many visits every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 这个博物馆每个周末都迎来许多参观者。
words.en: If you visit someone, you go to see them and spend time with them. If you visit a place, you go there for a short time.

words.tr: v. （使）负载；把……装入车船（或集装箱等）；有……的偏向；
words.ex: They loaded the boxes onto the truck.
words.ex_cn: 他们把箱子装上了卡车。
words.en: If something is loaded, it contains a lot of something, often in a way that is not obvious.

words.ex: The king sat on the throne.
words.ex_cn: 国王坐在王位上。
