words.en: The throne is the special chair used by a king, queen, or emperor during ceremonies, or the position of being a ruler.

words.ex: He found a weapon in the old box.
words.ex_cn: 他在旧箱子里发现了一件武器。
words.en: A weapon is an object that can be used to harm or kill someone, or to damage or destroy something.

words.tr:
n. 颜色；
v. 着色；
words.ex: The sky has a blue colour.
words.ex_cn: 天空有一种蓝色。
words.en: Colour is the appearance that things have that results from the way in which they reflect light. Red, blue, and green are colours.

words.ex: The fish swim in the depths of the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在海洋的深处游动。
words.en: The depths refer to the distance from the top or surface to the bottom of something, or the quality of being deep; it can also refer to the most intense or extreme part of a state or condition.

words.ex: His deceit made his friends lose trust in him.
words.ex_cn: 他的欺骗让朋友们失去了对他的信任。
words.en: Deceit is behaviour that is intended to make someone believe something that is not true.

words.ex: He bought a gallon of milk from the store.
words.ex_cn: 他从商店买了一加仑牛奶。
words.en: A gallon is a unit of measurement for liquids that is equal to eight pints. In Britain, it is equal to about 4.546 litres. In America, it is equal to about 3.785 litres.

words.ex: The baby is crying for milk.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿在哭着要奶。
words.en: The act of shedding tears, often as an expression of distress, pain, or sorrow.

words.tr: n. 资产；财产；有价值的人或物；“asset”的复数；
words.ex: The company sold its assets to pay debts.
words.ex_cn: 公司出售了其资产来偿还债务。
words.en: Assets are items of value owned by a person or company, regarded as having value and available to meet debts, commitments, or legacies.

words.ex: The artist used different moulds to create the sculptures.
words.ex_cn: 艺术家使用不同的模具来制作雕塑。
words.en: Moulds are hollow containers used to give shape to molten or liquid material when it cools and hardens. They can also refer to a type of fungus that grows on organic matter in damp conditions.

words.tr: adj. 最确定的；最可靠的
words.ex: This is the surest way to achieve success.
words.ex_cn: 这是取得成功的最可靠方法。
words.en: Superlative form of 'sure', meaning most certain or reliable.

words.ex: The company agreed to defray the travel expenses.
words.ex_cn: 公司同意支付差旅费。
words.en: If you defray someone's costs or expenses, you give them money which represents the amount that they have spent, for example while they have been doing something for you or acting on your behalf.

words.ex: The crafty fox stole the chicken at night.
words.ex_cn: 那只狡猾的狐狸在夜里偷了鸡。
words.en: If you describe someone as crafty, you mean they are clever at achieving their aims by indirect or deceitful methods.

words.ex: He gave her a red heart on Valentine's Day.
words.ex_cn: 他在情人节送给她一颗红心。
words.en: The heart is the organ in your chest that pumps blood around your body. It is also used to refer to the central or most important part of something, or to the feelings and emotions of a person.

words.ex: He read a quarto book last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚读了一本四开本的书。
words.en: A book or pamphlet made up of one or more full sheets of paper on which 8 pages of text were printed, which were then folded three times to produce leaves one eighth the size of the original sheet.

words.ex: The bank is the issuer of this credit card.
words.ex_cn: 银行是这张信用卡的发行方。
words.en: An issuer is a legal entity that develops, registers, and sells securities to finance its operations.

words.ex: The youths gathered in the park to play basketball.
words.ex_cn: 年轻人在公园里聚集打篮球。
words.en: Young people considered as a group; the period between childhood and adult age.

words.tr: n. [解剖]神经；神经紧张；胆量（nerve 的复数）；
words.ex: The nerves in his hand sent pain signals to his brain.
words.ex_cn: 他手里的神经向大脑传递了疼痛信号。
words.en: Nerves are the fibers that carry messages between your brain and other parts of your body, allowing you to move and feel things. They can also refer to feelings of worry or anxiety about something that is going to happen.

words.tr:
n. 淀粉；淀粉浆
v. 给（布）上浆
words.ex: The potato contains a lot of starch.
words.ex_cn: 土豆含有大量淀粉。
words.en: A carbohydrate that is the chief form of stored energy in plants, especially in seeds and tubers. It is also used in cooking and as a stiffening agent in textiles.

words.ex: I assure you that everything will be fine.
words.ex_cn: 我向你保证一切都会好起来的。
words.en: If you assure someone that something is true or will happen, you tell them that it is definitely true or will definitely happen, often in order to make them less worried.

words.ex: He pawned his watch to get some quick cash.
words.ex_cn: v. 他典当了他的手表以快速获得一些现金。
words.en: To leave an item with a pawnbroker as security for money lent.

words.tr:
adj. 中途的；中间的
adv. 中途地；中间地
n. 娱乐场；游乐场
words.ex: He stopped midway to rest.
words.ex_cn: 他中途停下来休息。
words.en: Midway is used to describe something that is in the middle of a place or a period of time.

words.ex: He was spared from punishment.
words.ex_cn: 他被免于惩罚。
words.en: To spare means to refrain from harming or destroying something or someone, or to use something in a limited or careful way.

words.ex: The teacher will assign homework today.
words.ex_cn: 老师今天会布置作业。
words.en: To give someone a particular job or task; to allocate a resource or responsibility to a particular person or purpose.

words.ex: The femmes in the group were all very talented.
words.ex_cn: 这个小组中的女性都非常有才华。
words.en: Women, especially in the context of their social roles and identities.

words.tr: v. 倒；喷涌；（雨）倾盆而下；“pour”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He poured water into the glass.
words.ex_cn: 他把水倒进了玻璃杯里。
words.en: If you pour a liquid or other substance, you make it flow steadily out of a container by holding the container at an angle.

words.tr:
adj. 附近的；
adv. 在附近；
words.ex: There is a park nearby my house.
words.ex_cn: 我家附近有一个公园。
words.en: If something is nearby, it is only a short distance away.

words.ex: The countries formed a peace league.
words.ex_cn: 这些国家组成了一个和平联盟。
words.en: A league is a group of people, countries, or organizations that have joined together for a particular purpose, or because they share a common interest.

words.ex: He strives to finish his homework every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天努力完成作业。
words.en: If you strive to do something or strive for something, you make a great effort to do it or get it.

words.ex: Scientists seek truths about the natural world.
words.ex_cn: 科学家探求自然界的真理。
words.en: Facts or beliefs that are accepted as true.

words.tr: v. 坚决主张；提出理由证明；争吵，辩论；
words.ex: He argues that everyone should have free education.
words.ex_cn: 他坚决主张每个人都应享有免费教育。
words.en: If one person argues with another, they speak angrily to each other about something that they disagree about. You can also say that two people argue.

words.ex: The old temple has four stone pillars.
words.ex_cn: 这座古老的寺庙有四根石柱。
words.en: A pillar is a tall solid structure, which is usually used to support part of a building.

words.ex: He grabbed the tiller to steer the boat.
words.ex_cn: 他抓住舵柄来操控船的方向。
words.en: A tiller is a handle used to turn the rudder of a boat from side to side, steering the boat. It can also refer to a person who tills land, a farmer, or a machine used in farming to prepare the soil for planting.

words.tr: v. 抽；喷涌出；“pump”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The pump pumped water from the well.
words.ex_cn: 水泵从井里抽水。
words.en: If someone is pumped, they are very excited or enthusiastic about something.

words.ex: She avoids eating junk food to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 她避免吃垃圾食品以保持健康。
words.en: To avoid means to keep away from or stop oneself from doing something.

words.ex: The child behaves well in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子在课堂上表现得很好。
words.en: To behave means to act in a particular way, especially in a way that is good or correct.

words.tr: v. 论证；争论；显示出，表明（argue 的过去式和过去分词）；
words.ex: He argued that exercise improves health.
words.ex_cn: 他论证说锻炼能改善健康。
words.en: If you argue with someone about something, you discuss it with them, with each of you giving your own opinions and trying to persuade the other.

words.ex: The movie had a sequel that came out last year.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影有一部去年上映的续集。
words.en: A sequel is a book, film, or play that continues the story of a previous one.

words.ex: They went on a long voyage across the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 他们进行了一次横跨海洋的长途航行。
words.en: A voyage is a long journey, especially by sea or in space.

words.ex: This painting is unique because no other like it exists.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画是独特的，因为没有其他类似的。
words.en: Something that is unique is the only one of its kind.

words.ex: Jeremy is a common English name.
words.ex_cn: 杰里米是一个常见的英文名字。
words.en: jeremy

words.tr: v. 为…提供床位( sleep的第三人称单数 )
words.ex: She sleeps soundly every night.
words.ex_cn: 她每晚都睡得很香。
words.en: Sleeps: (verb) Rests with eyes closed and body inactive.

words.ex: The bagmen were caught red-handed by the police.
words.ex_cn: n. 收贿者被警察当场抓获。
words.en: A bagman is a person who collects or distributes bribes, often on behalf of others.

words.tr: n. 混杂物；集锦；集成曲
words.ex: The band played a medley of old songs.
words.ex_cn: 乐队演奏了一串老歌的混合曲。
words.en: A medley is a mixture of things, especially a mixture of tunes or songs played one after the other.

words.ex: He wore a ragged coat in winter.
words.ex_cn: 他冬天穿着一件破旧的外套。
words.en: Clothes that are ragged are old and torn.

words.ex: He passed the test, albeit with a low score.
words.ex_cn: 他通过了考试，尽管分数很低。
words.en: You use albeit to introduce a fact or comment which reduces the force or significance of what you have just said.

words.ex: The room was devoid of any furniture.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间里全无家具。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is devoid of a quality or thing, you are emphasizing that they have none of it.

words.tr: n. 用法; 惯例; 习惯; 使用( usage的名词复数 )
words.ex: The usages of this word have changed over time.
words.ex_cn: 这个词的用法随着时间发生了变化。
words.en: The way in which a word, phrase, or concept is used in a language or by a particular person or group.

words.ex: The cook wiped off the grease from the pan.
words.ex_cn: 厨师把锅上的油脂擦掉了。
words.en: Grease is a thick, oily substance which is put on the moving parts of cars and other machines in order to make them work smoothly.

words.ex: He filled out the sheets with his name and address.
words.ex_cn: 他在这几张表格上填上了自己的姓名和地址。
words.en: Sheets refer to large pieces of thin material used especially on beds or as a covering for something.

words.ex: He felt guilty for lying to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他因为对朋友撒谎而感到有罪。
words.en: If you feel guilty, you feel unhappy because you believe that you have done something wrong or have failed to do something which you should have done.

words.tr:
adj. 连续的；连环的
n. 连续剧；连载小说
words.ex: He watched the serial episodes every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上观看连续的剧集。
words.en: A serial is a story or play that is broadcast on television or radio in several parts at fixed times, or a story that is published in a magazine or newspaper in several parts.

words.tr: adj. 令人作呕的；多病的；不健壮的；憔悴的
words.ex: The sickly sweet smell of the flowers made her nauseous.
words.ex_cn: 花儿那甜得令人作呕的气味让她感到恶心。
words.en: If you describe someone as sickly, you mean that they are often ill or they look as if they are often ill.

words.ex: The kettle produces vapour when the water boils.
words.ex_cn: 水烧开时，水壶会产生水汽。
words.en: Vapour is a substance in the gas phase at a temperature lower than its critical temperature, which means that the vapour can be condensed to a liquid by increasing its pressure without reducing the temperature.

words.ex: People gather in the square for the festival.
words.ex_cn: 人们在广场上聚集庆祝节日。
words.en: If people gather somewhere, or if someone gathers people somewhere, they come together in a group.

words.tr: n. 切割者；切割机；裁切器；小汽艇
words.ex: The cutter sliced the bread with a sharp knife.
words.ex_cn: 切割者用锋利的刀切开了面包。
words.en: A cutter is someone or something that cuts, especially a tool or machine used for cutting materials.

words.tr: n. (印度教、佛教中的)法，达摩
words.ex: He follows his dharma every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都遵循自己的正道。
words.en: In Indian religions, dharma signifies the cosmic law and order, as well as the individual's duty or righteousness.

words.tr: v. 忘记；遗忘；“forget”的过去式；
words.ex: I forgot my keys at home.
words.ex_cn: 我把钥匙忘在家里了。
words.en: If you forget something, you do not remember it.

words.ex: The construction workers are piling the wood for the foundation.
words.ex_cn: 建筑工人正在为地基堆放木材。
words.en: Long, heavy pieces of wood, metal, or concrete that are pushed into the ground to support a building or other structure.

words.ex: She dwells in a small village in the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 她居住在山里的一个小村庄。
words.en: To live in a particular place; to think or talk a lot about something, especially something unpleasant.

words.ex: The juries were unable to reach a unanimous decision.
words.ex_cn: 陪审团无法达成一致的决定。
words.en: A jury is a group of people in a court of law who listen to the facts of a case and decide whether the accused person is guilty or not.

words.ex: A bird emerged from the trees.
words.ex_cn: 一只鸟从树中浮现出来。
words.en: If something or someone emerges, they come out of or move out of something and become visible.

words.ex: He washed his mouth after eating.
words.ex_cn: 他吃完饭后洗了嘴。
words.en: The opening in the lower part of the human face, surrounded by the lips, through which food is taken in and sound is uttered.

words.tr: n. 再来一个；重演的节目
words.ex: The crowd shouted for an encore after the concert.
words.ex_cn: 音乐会结束后，观众大声要求再演一场。
words.en: An encore is a short extra performance given by musicians or actors after the main performance has ended, usually in response to the audience's applause.

words.tr: n. 沼泽（地）( swamp的名词复数 )
words.ex: Birds live in the swamps near the river.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类生活在河边的沼泽里。
words.en: Wet, low-lying areas of land that are saturated with water, often supporting a unique ecosystem.

words.ex: He unfolded the map on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他把地图在桌子上展开。
words.en: To open or spread out something that is folded; to develop or be revealed.

words.tr: n. 精梳 v. 梳理( comb的过去式和过去分词 ); 在…搜寻，彻底搜查
words.ex: She combed her hair before the interview.
words.ex_cn: 她在面试前梳理了头发。
words.en: To comb means to untangle or arrange hair, wool, or other fibers with a comb, or to search thoroughly.

words.ex: He built a successful career in medicine.
words.ex_cn: 他在医学领域建立了成功的事业。
words.en: A career is the job or series of jobs that you do during your working life, especially if you continue to get better jobs and earn more money.

words.ex: He can deduce the answer from the clues.
words.ex_cn: 他能从线索中推断出答案。
words.en: If you deduce something or deduce that something is true, you reach that conclusion because of other things that you know to be true.

words.ex: This is the finest coffee I have ever tasted.
words.ex_cn: 这是我喝过最优质的咖啡。
words.en: The word 'finest' is used to describe something that is of the highest quality or the most excellent among a group of things. It can refer to the best in terms of physical appearance, performance, or any other measurable quality.

words.ex: Crowds gather in the square every evening.
words.ex_cn: 每天晚上，人群都会聚集在广场上。
words.en: A crowd is a large group of people who have gathered together, for example, to watch or listen to something interesting, or to protest about something.

words.tr: n. [建]踏板（tread 的复数）; v. 踩（tread 的单数第三人称）
words.ex: The car's treads are worn out.
words.ex_cn: 汽车的履带已经磨坏了。
words.en: The word 'treads' can refer to the patterns on the surface of a tire that touch the ground, providing traction, or it can mean to step or walk on or over something.

words.tr: v. 预订；预约；预订( book的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: I booked a hotel room for next week.
words.ex_cn: 我预订了下周的酒店房间。
words.en: If something is booked, it has been reserved or arranged in advance.

words.ex: The tocsin rang out across the village, warning of the approaching storm.
words.ex_cn: 警钟在村庄上空响起，警告即将到来的风暴。
words.en: A tocsin is a bell used to sound an alarm or warning, especially in times of danger or emergency.

words.ex: He works as a tanner in a small town.
words.ex_cn: 他在一个小镇上做皮革工。
words.en: A tanner is a person whose job is to tan animal hides to make leather.

words.ex: The stormy sea crashed against the rocks.
words.ex_cn: 暴风雨的海浪拍打着岩石。
words.en: Characterized by strong winds and usually rain, thunder, lightning, or snow.

words.ex: He affirm that the plan will work.
words.ex_cn: 他断言这个计划会成功。
words.en: If you affirm that something is true or that something exists, you state firmly and publicly that it is true or that it exists.

words.ex: He lives in penury after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后生活贫困。
words.en: Penury is the state of being extremely poor.

words.ex: She bought some beautiful cloths to make curtains.
words.ex_cn: 她买了一些漂亮的布料来做窗帘。
words.en: Cloths are pieces of material that are used for making clothes, curtains, or for cleaning.

words.ex: Vivian was known for her kindness and generosity.
words.ex_cn: 薇薇安以她的善良和慷慨而闻名。
words.en: A female given name, often associated with qualities of life and vitality.

words.ex: He was born under the zodiac sign Leo.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在狮子座。
words.en: The zodiac is an imaginary belt in the heavens extending about 8° on either side of the apparent path of the sun and including the paths of the moon and the principal planets, divided into twelve equal parts or signs, each named for a constellation.

words.ex: The rains caused floods in the village.
words.ex_cn: 雨水引发了村庄的洪水。
words.en: A flood is an overflow of water that submerges land which is usually dry. In the sense of 'flowing water', the word may also be applied to the inflow of the tide. Flooding may occur as an overflow of water from water bodies, such as a river or lake, in which the water overtops or breaks levees, resulting in some of that water escaping its usual boundaries, or it may occur due to an accumulation of rainwater on saturated ground in an areal flood.

words.ex: The child blew a bubble with gum.
words.ex_cn: 孩子用口香糖吹了一个气泡。
words.en: A bubble is a small ball of air or gas in a liquid, or a ball of air inside a solid substance such as glass.

words.ex: He studied sastra to understand ancient Indian philosophy.
words.ex_cn: 他学习梵语文学以理解古印度哲学。
words.en: Sastra refers to the body of sacred literature or scriptures in Sanskrit, often encompassing various fields of knowledge such as philosophy, science, and arts.

words.ex: The parity of the numbers is important in this game.
words.ex_cn: 这些数字的奇偶性在这个游戏中很重要。
words.en: If there is parity between two things, they are equal to each other.

words.ex: The sounds of birds wake me up every morning.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿的声音每天早上把我叫醒。
words.en: Sounds can refer to vibrations that travel through the air or another medium and can be heard when they reach a person's or animal's ear. It can also mean to convey a specified impression when heard.

words.tr: adj. 根深蒂固的；生根的； v. 生根；“root”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: His beliefs are rooted in tradition.
words.ex_cn: 他的信念根深蒂固于传统。
words.en: If something is rooted in a particular emotion, belief, or idea, it is strongly influenced by it or developed from it.

words.ex: His recipe for success is hard work and patience.
words.ex_cn: 他成功的秘诀是努力工作和耐心。
words.en: A recipe is a list of ingredients and a set of instructions that tell you how to cook something.

words.tr:
adj. 三部分的；三方的；三倍的
n. 三倍；最高音部；高音
v. 成为三倍；使增至三倍
words.ex: The pie has a treble layer of chocolate.
words.ex_cn: 这个派有三层巧克力。
words.en: Treble can be used as an adjective to describe something that is three times as much or as many, as a noun to refer to the highest range of musical notes, or as a verb to mean to make or become three times as much or as many.

words.ex: The barber cuts hair every day.
words.ex_cn: 理发师每天剪头发。
words.en: A barber is a person whose job is cutting men's hair and sometimes shaving their beards.

words.ex: Please excuse me for being late.
words.ex_cn: 请原谅我迟到了。
words.en: To excuse someone means to forgive them for something they have done wrong or to allow them not to do something that they should do.

words.ex: His decision to drive drunk was pure idiocy.
words.ex_cn: 他酒后驾车的决定简直是白痴行为。
words.en: If you refer to a particular action or situation as idiocy, you mean that it is very stupid or foolish.

words.ex: The docile dog followed its owner quietly.
words.ex_cn: 这只温顺的狗安静地跟着主人。
words.en: A docile person or animal is quiet, not aggressive, and easily controlled.

words.ex: The fierce lion chased the deer.
words.ex_cn: 那只凶猛的狮子追赶着鹿。
words.en: A fierce animal or person is very aggressive or angry.

words.ex: The marine birds fly over the sea.
words.ex_cn: 这些海鸟在海面上飞翔。
words.en: Marine is used to describe things relating to the sea or to the ships and boats which sail on it.

words.ex: After work, she found repose in her garden.
words.ex_cn: 下班后，她在花园里休息。
words.en: A state of rest, sleep, or tranquility. To lie or be placed in a particular position or manner.

words.ex: The police arrested the thief last night.
words.ex_cn: 警察昨晚逮捕了那个小偷。
words.en: If the police arrest you, they take charge of you and take you to a police station, because they believe you may have committed a crime.

words.ex: She lamented the death of her dog.
words.ex_cn: 她哀悼她狗的去世。
words.en: If you lament something, you express your sadness, regret, or disappointment about it.

words.tr: v. 收缩；退缩；“shrink”的过去式；
words.ex: The sweater shrank in the wash.
words.ex_cn: 这件毛衣在洗涤后缩水了。
words.en: Shrank is the past tense of shrink, which means to become or make smaller in size or amount.

words.tr: adj. 有角的；有角状物的
words.ex: The horned sheep stood near the fence.
words.ex_cn: 那只有角的羊站在围栏附近。
words.en: Having horns or hornlike projections.

words.tr:
n. 螺旋形；陡升或骤降；
v. 螺旋式上升（或下降）；
adj. 螺旋形的；
words.ex: The snail moved along a spiral path.
words.ex_cn: 蜗牛沿着一个螺旋形的路径爬行。
words.en: A spiral is a shape which winds round and round, with each curve above or outside the previous one.

words.ex: The study found a causal link between smoking and lung cancer.
words.ex_cn: 这项研究发现了吸烟与肺癌之间的因果关系。
words.en: A causal factor or event is one that causes or leads to something else.

words.tr: n. 复制品；副本；“copy”的复数； v. 复制；拷贝；
words.ex: He bought two copies of the book.
words.ex_cn: 他买了两本这本书的复制品。
words.en: Copies are duplicates of an original document, artwork, or other items made by various methods such as photocopying, printing, or digital replication.

words.ex: The workers dug a trench to lay the pipe.
words.ex_cn: 工人们挖了一条沟来铺设管道。
words.en: A trench is a long, narrow ditch. In warfare, trenches are dug by troops to provide shelter from enemy fire.

words.ex: He is a leader who helps his team succeed.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位帮助团队取得成功的领袖。
words.en: A leader is the person in charge of a group, organization, or country, who makes decisions and ensures that things are done effectively.

words.tr: v. 结盟；“ally”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: Two countries allied to fight the common enemy.
words.ex_cn: 两个国家结盟以对抗共同的敌人。
words.en: Allied means joined by or relating to members of an alliance.

words.ex: The fire produced small sparks.
words.ex_cn: 火焰产生了小小的闪光。
words.en: Sparks are small fiery particles thrown off from a fire, or a flash of light produced by an electrical discharge. It can also mean to ignite or cause something to start.

words.tr: adj. 随意的；非正式的；偶然的；
words.ex: He wore casual clothes to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了随意的衣服去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe someone's attitude or behavior as casual, you mean they are not very concerned about what they are doing or what is happening around them, or they are not taking it seriously.

words.ex: He speaks Chinese as his mother tongue.
words.ex_cn: 他把汉语作为母语。
words.en: The tongue is the flexible muscular organ in the mouth that is used for tasting, licking, swallowing, and (in humans) articulating speech.

words.tr: v. 投掷；猛冲；短暂的风流韵事
words.ex: He flings the ball across the field.
words.ex_cn: 他把球扔过了田野。
words.en: To throw or hurl something with force; to move or act quickly and energetically; a brief, casual sexual relationship.

words.ex: His memory is very good; he remembers everything.
words.ex_cn: 他的记忆力很好；他什么都记得。
words.en: Memory is the faculty by which the mind stores and remembers information.

words.ex: The saltus in the data indicates a significant change.
words.ex_cn: 数据中的突变表明了一个显著的变化。
words.en: A sudden leap or jump; a sudden transition or change.

words.tr: n. 差额；边缘；净利润；余地；
words.ex: The profit margin is five dollars.
words.ex_cn: 利润差额是五美元。
words.en: The margin is the edge or border of something, or the difference between two amounts, especially the difference between the cost of producing something and the price it is sold for.

words.ex: The sailor fixed the rope on the boat.
words.ex_cn: 水手修理了船上的绳子。
words.en: A sailor is a person who works on a ship as a member of its crew.

words.tr:
adj. 黄色的；
n. 黄色；
words.ex: The banana is yellow.
words.ex_cn: 香蕉是黄色的。
words.en: Yellow is the color of lemons, butter, or the middle part of an egg. It is one of the three primary colors.

words.tr: n. 朝圣者；手持棕榈叶的人
words.ex: The palmer traveled to the holy site with great devotion.
words.ex_cn: 这位朝圣者怀着极大的虔诚前往圣地。
words.en: A palmer is a pilgrim, especially one who has returned from the Holy Land with a palm branch as a token of having undertaken the pilgrimage.

words.ex: The chemical compound contains a propyl group.
words.ex_cn: 这种化合物含有一个丙基基团。
words.en: A propyl group is a three-carbon alkyl substituent with the chemical formula -C3H7, derived from propane.

words.ex: He is frugal with his money.
words.ex_cn: 他花钱很节俭。
words.en: If you describe someone as frugal, you mean that they are careful about spending money and use things only when they need to.

words.ex: The new software vastly improves speed.
words.ex_cn: 新软件极大地提高了速度。
words.en: To a very great extent or degree.

words.ex: He inserts a coin into the machine.
words.ex_cn: 他把一枚硬币放进机器里。
words.en: To put or introduce something into something else.

words.tr: n. 钱币，钞票( money的名词复数 ); 款项，钱款
words.ex: He spends moneys on games and snacks.
words.ex_cn: 他把钱花在游戏和零食上。
words.en: Money (plural form, often used in informal or legal contexts).

words.ex: He adheres to his principles even when it's hard.
words.ex_cn: 即使很难，他仍然坚持自己的原则。
words.en: If you adhere to a rule or agreement, you act in the way that it says you should.

words.ex: Typhus is a serious infectious disease caused by bacteria.
words.ex_cn: 斑疹伤寒是一种由细菌引起的严重传染病。
words.en: Typhus is a group of infectious diseases that are caused by rickettsial bacteria and are transmitted by arthropods such as fleas, lice, and ticks.

words.ex: The answer is nought.
words.ex_cn: 答案是零。
words.en: Nought is used to refer to the number 0, or to nothing or the absence of something.

words.ex: We visited a museum last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末参观了一个博物馆。
words.en: A museum is a building where a large number of interesting and valuable objects, such as works of art or historical items, are kept, studied, and displayed to the public.

words.ex: The cold weather put the animal into torpor.
words.ex_cn: 寒冷的天气让动物陷入麻木状态。
words.en: a state of physical or mental inactivity; lethargy.

words.ex: A spider is crawling on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 一只蜘蛛正在墙上爬。
words.en: A spider is a small creature with eight legs and a body divided into two parts, which spins webs to catch insects for food.

words.tr: n. 法学家；法律学专家
words.ex: The jurist provided a detailed analysis of the legal case.
words.ex_cn: 法学家对这起法律案件进行了详细的分析。
words.en: A jurist is someone who is an expert in law, especially one who gives advice on legal matters or writes about law.

words.tr: n. 海盗行为；侵犯版权；
words.ex: The ship was attacked because of piracy near the coast.
words.ex_cn: 船在海岸附近因海盗行为遭到袭击。
words.en: The act of illegally copying and selling someone else's work, especially books, videos, or computer programs, or the act of attacking and stealing from ships at sea.

words.ex: The resale of used books is popular online.
words.ex_cn: 二手书的转售在网上很流行。
words.en: The sale of something previously bought, typically at a higher price than the original purchase.

words.ex: The hospital recorded a high number of births last month.
words.ex_cn: n. 医院上个月记录了大量的出生。
words.en: The act or process of being born; the beginning of life.

words.ex: Lye is a strong alkali used in cleaning.
words.ex_cn: 氢氧化钠是一种用于清洁的强碱。
words.en: An alkali is a chemical compound that neutralizes acids to form salts and turns red litmus paper blue.

words.tr:
n. 液体；
adj. 液态的；
words.ex: Water is a common liquid.
words.ex_cn: 水是一种常见的液体。
words.en: A liquid is a substance which is not solid but which flows and can be poured, for example water.

words.ex: The mowers are working in the park to keep the grass short.
words.ex_cn: 割草机正在公园里工作，以保持草短。
words.en: Mowers are machines or people that cut grass or other plants.

words.tr: v. 梳理（羊毛、棉等）；用卡片记录
words.ex: She carded the wool before spinning it into yarn.
words.ex_cn: 她在纺纱前梳理了羊毛。
words.en: To comb or brush fibers, especially wool or cotton, to prepare them for spinning. Also, to record information on a card.

words.ex: The company was involved in several frauds.
words.ex_cn: 该公司涉及多起欺诈行为。
words.en: Frauds are acts of deceiving or cheating someone, often for financial gain.

words.tr: v. 举起，抬起( lift的过去式和过去分词 )；提高；解除（封锁、包围等）；
words.ex: He lifted the box easily.
words.ex_cn: 他轻松地举起了箱子。
words.en: To move something or someone upwards or to a higher position.

words.ex: He eats cheese every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃奶酪。
words.en: Cheese is a food made from the pressed curds of milk, often with added flavorings and sometimes with a hard or soft texture.

words.tr: adj. 虚弱的；衰弱的；无力的；
words.ex: The old man gave a feeble smile.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人露出虚弱的微笑。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as feeble, you mean that they are weak.

words.ex: She cleaned the room nicely.
words.ex_cn: 她把房间打扫得很好。
words.en: In a pleasant or agreeable manner.

words.ex: She wore a dress with paisley patterns.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条有佩斯利图案的裙子。
words.en: A paisley is a distinctive, intricate pattern of curved, feather-shaped figures, originally from Persia, and now used in fabrics, wallpapers, etc.

words.ex: This is the easiest math problem.
words.ex_cn: 这是最容易的数学题。
words.en: The superlative form of 'easy', meaning the least difficult or requiring the least effort.

words.tr:
adj. 总的；全面的；总体的；
adv. 总计；大致上；
words.ex: The overall cost is too high.
words.ex_cn: 总成本太高了。
words.en: You use overall to indicate that you are talking about a situation in general or about the whole of something.

words.tr:
n. 召唤；传票；召见令
v. 召唤；召集；鼓起（勇气）；“summon”的第三人称单数
words.ex: The court sent him a summons.
words.ex_cn: 法院给他发了一张传票。
words.en: A summons is an order to come and see someone.

words.tr:
v. 摔跤；扭斗；奋力对付
n. 摔跤；角力；扭斗
words.ex: He tries to wrestle the dog away from the trash.
words.ex_cn: 他试图把狗从垃圾桶旁拉开。
words.en: To engage in a physical contest, typically involving grappling and trying to throw or immobilize the opponent, or to struggle with a difficult problem or decision.

words.ex: A handful of students stayed after class to ask questions.
words.ex_cn: 少数学生课后留下来提问。
words.en: A handful of something is a small amount of it, especially when it is not enough or when it is difficult to manage.

words.ex: The team celebrated their triumph after winning the match.
words.ex_cn: 球队在赢得比赛后庆祝了他们的胜利。
words.en: A triumph is a great success or achievement, often one that has been gained with a lot of skill or effort.

words.tr: n. 芜青( turnip的名词复数 ); 芜菁块根; 芜菁甘蓝块根; <俚>怀表
words.ex: He eats turnips for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐吃萝卜。
words.en: A round, white root vegetable with a slightly sweet, earthy flavor when cooked.

words.ex: He bought a fresh herring at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了一条新鲜的青鱼。
words.en: A herring is a long silver-colored fish. Herring live in large groups in the sea.

words.ex: He sold apples at the wayside.
words.ex_cn: 他在路边卖苹果。
words.en: The land adjacent to a road or path.

words.tr: n. 往返移动之物；航天飞机；
words.ex: The bus is a shuttle between the hotel and the airport.
words.ex_cn: 这辆巴士是酒店和机场之间的往返交通工具。
words.en: A shuttle is a vehicle that travels frequently between two places. In weaving, a shuttle is a device used to carry the weft thread back and forth across the loom.

words.ex: The law ordains that all citizens must pay taxes.
words.ex_cn: 法律规定所有公民必须纳税。
words.en: To ordain means to officially establish or order something, often in a formal or religious context.

words.ex: The leaders of the team made a good decision.
words.ex_cn: 团队的领袖做出了一个正确的决定。
words.en: Leaders are people who guide or direct others, often in a political, business, or organizational context. They are responsible for making decisions, setting goals, and motivating others to achieve those goals.

words.ex: The colorful show engages children.
words.ex_cn: 这个五彩缤纷的表演吸引了孩子们。
words.en: If you engage in an activity, you do it or are actively involved with it. Also, if something engages you, it keeps your interest or attention.

words.tr: n. 窗户；窗口；电脑窗口；“window”的复数；
words.ex: The children are looking out of the windows.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正从窗户往外看。
words.en: Windows is an operating system developed by Microsoft, which allows users to manage files and run applications on their computers.

words.ex: The estate included both real estate and chattels.
words.ex_cn: 该地产包括了房地产和动产。
words.en: A chattel is a personal possession, as opposed to real estate, or a slave.

words.tr: v. 帮助；“help”的现在分词； n. 帮助；支持；
words.ex: She is helping her brother with his homework.
words.ex_cn: 她正在帮她的弟弟做作业。
words.en: A helping is an amount of food that is given to one person at a meal.

words.ex: He gave up worldly pleasures to live a simple life.
words.ex_cn: 他放弃了世俗的享乐，过着简朴的生活。
words.en: Worldly means relating to the world and the practical matters of life, rather than to spiritual or religious matters.

words.ex: The printer has three rollers to move the paper.
words.ex_cn: 打印机有三个滚筒来传送纸张。
words.en: Rollers are cylindrical objects that rotate around an axis and are used for various purposes such as moving heavy objects, applying paint, or creating curls in hair.

words.ex: I caught a glimpse of the cat before it ran away.
words.ex_cn: 我在它跑掉之前瞥了一眼那只猫。
words.en: A glimpse is a brief, quick look at something or someone.

words.ex: He emptied the bottle.
words.ex_cn: 他把瓶子倒空了。
words.en: To make or become empty; to remove the contents of something.

words.ex: He mouthed the words silently.
words.ex_cn: 他默默地说了那些话。
words.en: Having a mouth of a specified kind; spoken or uttered.

words.tr: adj. 愤世嫉俗的；悲观的；
words.ex: He gave a cynical smile when they talked about honesty.
words.ex_cn: 当他们谈到诚实时，他露出了愤世嫉俗的微笑。
words.en: If you describe someone as cynical, you mean they believe that people always act selfishly.

words.ex: The vampire drinks blood at night.
words.ex_cn: 吸血鬼在夜里喝血。
words.en: A vampire is a mythical creature that subsists by feeding on the vital essence (generally in the form of blood) of the living.

words.ex: He told me a proverb: 'Slow and steady wins the race.'
words.ex_cn: 他告诉我一句谚语：‘慢而稳，胜千里。’
words.en: A proverb is a short, commonly known saying that expresses a truth or piece of advice.

words.tr: adv. 向那方；到那边; adj. 对岸的；那边的
words.ex: She pointed thither, indicating the direction we should go.
words.ex_cn: 她指向那边，指示我们应该去的方向。
words.en: To or toward that place; in that direction.

words.ex: He gave her a sincere apology.
words.ex_cn: 他向她真诚地道歉了。
words.en: An apology is something that you say or write in order to tell someone that you are sorry that you have hurt them or caused trouble for them.

words.ex: She reposes on the sofa after a long day at work.
words.ex_cn: v. 她在工作了一整天后躺在沙发上休息。
words.en: To rest or lie down in a relaxed manner; to place or lay something down; to trust or rely on someone or something.

words.ex: The combers crashed against the rocks with a thunderous roar.
words.ex_cn: 卷浪以雷鸣般的轰鸣声撞击着岩石。
words.en: Combers are large waves that roll onto the shore, or machines used for combing fibers.

words.tr:
adj. 非洲的；非洲人的；
n. 非洲人；
words.ex: He loves African music and dance.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢非洲的音乐和舞蹈。
words.en: Relating to Africa or its people, culture, or languages.

words.ex: The experts say the weather will be fine tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 专家们说明天天气会很好。
words.en: An expert is a person who is very skilled at doing something or who knows a lot about a particular subject.

words.tr: n. 产量；产量( output的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The factory increased its outputs last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂上个月提高了产量。
words.en: The amount of something produced by a person, machine, or industry.

words.tr: n. 纺锤；女性的一方；adj. 女性的
words.ex: She inherited the distaff side of the family business.
words.ex_cn: 她继承了家族企业中女性的一方。
words.en: A distaff is a stick or spindle onto which wool or flax is wound for spinning. It can also refer to the female side of a family.

words.tr: adj. 明显的； v. “glare”的现在分词；
words.ex: The mistake was glaring to everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个错误对每个人来说都很明显。
words.en: If you describe something bad as glaring, you are emphasizing that it is very obvious and easily seen.

words.ex: The doctor prescribed opiates to manage the patient's severe pain.
words.ex_cn: 医生开了鸦片制剂来管理病人的剧烈疼痛。
words.en: Opiates are drugs derived from opium, used to relieve pain or induce sleep, but they are also highly addictive.

words.tr: v. 刷油漆；用颜料画；“paint”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 着了色的；油漆了的；
words.ex: He painted the wall blue yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天把墙刷成了蓝色。
words.en: Covered or decorated with paint.

words.tr: n. 边界；边疆；“border”的复数； v. 和…毗邻；与…接壤；
words.ex: The two countries agreed on their borders.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家同意了它们的边界。
words.en: The limits or edges of an area, especially the political dividing line between two countries or regions.

words.tr: n. 危险的根源；危险；危险( hazard的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The factory workers faced many hazards every day.
words.ex_cn: 工厂工人每天面临许多危险的根源。
words.en: A hazard is something which could be dangerous to you, your health or safety, or your plans or reputation.

words.ex: He intends to go to school tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他打算明天去上学。
words.en: If you intend to do something, you have decided or planned to do it.

words.ex: The mercers in the market were busy selling their fabrics.
words.ex_cn: 市场上的绸布商正忙着卖他们的布料。
words.en: Mercers are merchants who deal in textiles, especially silks and other fine fabrics.

words.tr:
adj. 崇高的；壮丽的；极端的；过分的
v. 变高尚；升华
n. 庄严；崇高；顶点
words.ex: The view from the mountain is sublime.
words.ex_cn: 从山上看到的景色是壮丽的。
words.en: If you describe something as sublime, you mean that it has a wonderful quality that affects you deeply.

words.ex: He faced a dilemma: stay home or go to work.
words.ex_cn: 他面临一个困境：是待在家里还是去上班。
words.en: A situation in which a difficult choice has to be made between two or more alternatives, especially equally undesirable ones.

words.tr: adj. 世俗的；非宗教的；长期的
words.ex: He lives a secular life without religion.
words.ex_cn: 他过着没有宗教的世俗生活。
words.en: Secular activities, attitudes, or things have no connection with religion.

words.ex: The drunken man stumbled down the street.
words.ex_cn: 那个醉汉摇摇晃晃地走在街上。
words.en: Someone who is drunken is drunk or frequently gets drunk.

words.tr: n. 简单的事物；容易理解的事物
words.ex: The concept is quite simples and easy to grasp.
words.ex_cn: 这个概念非常简单，容易理解。
words.en: Simples refers to something that is easy to understand or do, often used to describe concepts or processes that are straightforward and uncomplicated.

words.ex: The living room has soft carpets.
words.ex_cn: 客厅里有柔软的地毯。
words.en: Carpets are thick woven materials for covering floors.

words.ex: The company plans to enlarge its office space.
words.ex_cn: 公司计划扩大其办公空间。
words.en: To make something bigger or more extensive.

words.ex: The jacket is proofed against water.
words.ex_cn: 这件夹克是防水的。
words.en: Having been tested or treated to be resistant to something, such as water or errors.

words.tr:
int. 欢迎；
v. 欢迎；
adj. 受欢迎的；
n. 欢迎；
words.ex: Welcome to our school!
words.ex_cn: 欢迎来到我们的学校！
words.en: If you welcome someone, you greet them in a friendly way when they arrive somewhere.

words.tr:
adj. 空想的；虚构的
v. 想象；想要；“fancy”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: He fancied a piece of cake after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后想吃一块蛋糕。
words.en: Imagined or believed to be true or real, often without evidence.

words.ex: The sailors sailed the boat across the sea.
words.ex_cn: 水手们把船驶过了大海。
words.en: Sailors are people who work on ships, especially those who assist in the operation of the vessel.

words.tr: adj. 被原谅的；被免除的
words.ex: He was excused from the meeting because of his illness.
words.ex_cn: 他因为生病被免除了参加会议。
words.en: If someone is excused from a duty or responsibility, they are officially allowed not to do it.

words.ex: His silence suggested he was unhappy.
words.ex_cn: 他的沉默暗示他并不开心。
words.en: If you suggest something, you put forward a plan or idea for someone to think about.

words.ex: She lit the candles for a cozy dinner.
words.ex_cn: 她点燃了蜡烛，营造温馨的晚餐氛围。
words.en: A candle is a stick of wax with a string through the middle which you burn to give light.

words.ex: The recipe calls for a mixture of flour and water.
words.ex_cn: 这个食谱需要一种面粉和水的混合物。
words.en: A mixture is a substance made by combining other substances together.

words.ex: He is tracing the origin of the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他正在追溯问题的根源。
words.en: The act of following or marking the course or position of something, especially with one's finger, a pen, or a cursor.

words.tr: v. 杀死；“kill”的现在分词； n. 杀人； adj. 致命的；
words.ex: The lion was killing a deer.
words.ex_cn: 那只狮子正在杀死一只鹿。
words.en: The act of causing death, especially deliberately; or something that causes death or is very difficult to endure.

words.ex: He moved to the countryside in his fifties.
words.ex_cn: 他在五十多岁时搬到了乡村。
words.en: The decade from 50 to 59 in a particular century, especially the 20th century; or the ages from 50 to 59.

words.tr: n. 设置者；安装者；排字工人
words.ex: The setters of the new policy were praised for their innovative approach.
words.ex_cn: 新政策的制定者因其创新方法而受到赞扬。
words.en: A person or thing that sets something, especially a person who sets type in printing or a person who installs or adjusts equipment.

words.ex: It's a paradox that he is rich but unhappy.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个悖论，他很富有却不快乐。
words.en: A paradox is a statement that seems to contradict itself but may nonetheless be true, or a situation that defies intuition.

words.ex: He works in a foundry that makes metal parts.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家制造金属零件的铸造厂工作。
words.en: A foundry is a place where metal or glass is melted and poured into molds to make objects.

words.tr: adj. 备有存货的；储备充足的；
words.ex: The store is stocked with snacks and drinks.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店备有各种零食和饮料。
words.en: Having a supply of goods or materials available for use or sale.

words.ex: Wallace is a common first name in Scotland.
words.ex_cn: 华莱士是苏格兰常见的名字。
words.en: Wallace is a male given name of Scottish origin, meaning 'foreigner' or 'stranger'.

words.ex: The gallant soldier saved his comrades in battle.
words.ex_cn: 这位英勇的士兵在战斗中救了他的战友们。
words.en: If someone is gallant, they behave bravely and honorably in a dangerous or difficult situation. It can also describe someone who is very polite and kind towards women.

words.tr: adj. 深红的；绯红的；猩红的；
words.ex: The scarlet leaves fell in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 深红色的叶子在秋天飘落。
words.en: A brilliant red color.

words.ex: Her favours go to the quiet students.
words.ex_cn: 她更喜爱安静的学生。
words.en: If you regard something or someone with favour, you like or support them. It can also mean a kind or helpful act that you do for someone.

words.ex: It is illegal to drive without a license.
words.ex_cn: 无证驾驶是非法的。
words.en: If something is illegal, the law says that it is not allowed.

words.ex: This is the longest river in the country.
words.ex_cn: 这是这个国家最长的河流。
words.en: Superlative form of long: having the greatest length.

words.tr: adj. 沉重的；重要的；重大的；
words.ex: The box is weighty and hard to carry.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子很重，很难搬。
words.en: Something that is weighty is important and serious, or seems to be so.

words.tr: v. 坐；“sit”的现在分词； n. 坐着活动的一段时间；一次用餐时间；
words.ex: He is sitting on a chair.
words.ex_cn: 他正坐在椅子上。
words.en: The act of being in a seated position.

words.ex: The duchess walks in the garden every morning.
words.ex_cn: 公爵夫人每天早上都在花园里散步。
words.en: A duchess is the wife or widow of a duke, or a woman who holds the rank of duke in her own right.

words.ex: The authors wrote a book about history.
words.ex_cn: 这些作者写了一本关于历史的书。
words.en: A person who writes books, articles, etc., especially as a job.

words.tr: adv. 僵硬地；严格地；固执地
words.ex: He follows the rules rigidly.
words.ex_cn: 他严格遵守规则。
words.en: In a strict or inflexible manner.

words.ex: She dresses like a goddess on Halloween.
words.ex_cn: 她在万圣节打扮得像一位女神。
words.en: A goddess is a female deity. In many cultures, goddesses are associated with Earth, motherhood, love, and the household.

words.ex: He made three entries in the contest.
words.ex_cn: 他参加了三项比赛。
words.en: Entries refer to the act of entering or the right to enter a place, or an item written or printed in a diary, list, account book, etc.

words.tr:
n. 灰泥；
v. 涂以灰泥；敷以膏药；
words.ex: The wall was covered with white plaster.
words.ex_cn: 墙壁上覆盖着白色灰泥。
words.en: A substance applied to walls or ceilings to smooth or decorate them, or a medical dressing used to cover wounds.

words.tr: n. 异常事物；反常现象；
words.ex: The strange weather this month is an anomaly.
words.ex_cn: 这个月奇怪的天气是一个异常现象。
words.en: Something that deviates from what is standard, normal, or expected.

words.tr: n. 播种机；种植园主；花盆；种植园经营者
words.ex: The farmer used a planter to sow seeds in the field.
words.ex_cn: 农夫使用播种机在田里播种。
words.en: A planter is someone who plants crops or a machine used for planting seeds. It can also refer to a decorative container for plants.

words.tr: adj. 匆匆的；粗略的；仓促的
words.ex: He gave the report a cursory look.
words.ex_cn: 他粗略地看了看这份报告。
words.en: A cursory glance or examination is a quick one that is not very thorough.

words.ex: He felt so sad that he thought about suicide.
words.ex_cn: 他感到非常难过，以至于想到了自杀。
words.en: Suicide is the act of deliberately killing oneself.

words.tr: adj. 更远的；更遥远的；更疏远的
words.ex: The remoter regions of the country are difficult to access.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家更偏远的地区很难到达。
words.en: Comparative form of 'remote', meaning more distant in space or time, or less closely related.

words.ex: He decided to discard his old habits.
words.ex_cn: 他决定抛开旧习惯。
words.en: To discard something means to get rid of it because you no longer want it or need it.

words.tr: v. 说话；交谈；“talk”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is talking to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他正在和朋友说话。
words.en: The act of speaking or discussing something with someone.

words.tr: v. 使高兴；使满意；取悦
words.ex: The performance pleases the audience.
words.ex_cn: v. 表演使观众感到高兴。
words.en: To give someone a feeling of happiness or satisfaction.

words.ex: The committee gave the proposal several reviews.
words.ex_cn: 委员会对这个提案进行了多次复审。
words.en: A review is a report in which someone gives their opinion of something such as a new book or film. If you review a situation or system, you consider it carefully to see what is wrong with it or how it could be improved.

words.tr: n. 年金；养老金；年金保险
words.ex: He receives an annuity every month.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月领取一笔年金。
words.en: An annuity is a fixed sum of money paid to someone each year, typically for the rest of their life.

words.tr: n. 必要的事物; 钱
words.ex: She used the money to buy all the needful things for the trip.
words.ex_cn: 她用这笔钱买了旅行所需的所有东西。
words.en: Necessary; required.

words.ex: Bernard is known for his exceptional leadership skills.
words.ex_cn: 伯纳德以其卓越的领导才能而闻名。
words.en: Bernard is a male given name of Old German origin, meaning 'strong, brave as a bear'.

words.tr: v. 点燃；照亮；“light”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: The lamp was lighted by the child.
words.ex_cn: 灯被孩子点亮了。
words.en: To make something start burning; to provide light for a place.

words.ex: She doubted his sincerity.
words.ex_cn: 她怀疑他的诚意。
words.en: To feel uncertain about something or to consider something unlikely.

words.tr: n. 警示； v. 警告；“warn”的现在分词；
words.ex: The sign gave a warning about the slippery road.
words.ex_cn: 标志提醒了道路湿滑的警示。
words.en: A warning is something which is said or written to tell people of a possible danger, problem, or other unpleasant thing that might happen.

words.tr: adj. 兴奋的； v. 使兴奋；使激动；“excite”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The children were excited about the party.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们对派对感到兴奋。
words.en: If you are excited, you are so happy that you cannot relax, usually because you are thinking about something pleasant that you are going to do or experience.

words.tr: v. 鞭打；严厉批评；努力推销
words.ex: He was flogged for breaking the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他因违反规则而被鞭打。
words.en: To beat someone severely with a whip or stick as a punishment or to make them work harder.

words.ex: The nascent industry is growing quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这个新生的产业正在迅速发展。
words.en: Nascent things or processes are just beginning, and are expected to become stronger or to grow bigger.

words.ex: He finally realize his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他终于意识到自己的错误。
words.en: If you realize that something is true, you become aware of that fact or understand it.

words.tr: v. 压碎； adj. 压碎的；捣碎的；v. 压碎（crush的过去分词）；
words.ex: He crushed the can with his foot.
words.ex_cn: 他用脚把罐子压碎了。
words.en: If something is crushed, it is pressed or squeezed with force so that it is damaged or its shape is destroyed.

words.tr:
v. 伸展；延伸；持续；
n. 一段；伸展；
words.ex: He stretches his arms every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上伸展手臂。
words.en: To stretch is to extend your body or a part of your body to its full length, or to extend something else to its full length or beyond its normal limits.

words.tr: v. 花费；“cost”的现在分词； n. 成本计算；成本核算；
words.ex: The new phone is costing me $800.
words.ex_cn: 这部新手机花了我800美元。
words.en: Costing is the process of determining the cost of something, especially in business and manufacturing contexts. It involves calculating the expenses involved in producing a product or providing a service.

words.tr: n. 待缝补的衣服 v. 修理，修补( mend的现在分词 ); 改[纠]正; 改善[进]; 恢复
words.ex: He is mending his broken shoe.
words.ex_cn: 他正在修补他破掉的鞋子。
words.en: The act of repairing something that is broken or damaged.

words.tr: n. 四十多岁；四十年代
words.ex: She is in her forties and has a successful career.
words.ex_cn: 她四十多岁，事业有成。
words.en: The forties refers to the decade from 1940 to 1949 or the age range from 40 to 49.

words.ex: The cavalry charged quickly across the field.
words.ex_cn: 骑兵迅速冲过田野。
words.en: The cavalry refers to the part of an army that originally fought on horseback, now typically used in modern armies to refer to units that are mobile and intended for rapid deployment.

words.ex: He used a compass to find north.
words.ex_cn: 他用指南针找北方。
words.en: A compass is an instrument that you use for finding directions. It has a dial and a magnetic needle that always points to the north.

words.ex: The lodgers were asked to keep the noise down after 10 PM.
words.ex_cn: 房客被要求在晚上10点后保持安静。
words.en: A lodger is a person who rents a room in someone else's house.

words.tr: n. 城市居民；市民；公民
words.ex: The burgher voted in the town meeting.
words.ex_cn: 市民在城镇会议上投票了。
words.en: A burgher is a citizen of a town or city, especially a member of the middle class.

words.tr: adj. 肮脏的；污秽的；卑劣的
words.ex: The squalid apartment had dirty floors and broken windows.
words.ex_cn: 这间肮脏的公寓地板很脏，窗户也破了。
words.en: If you describe a place as squalid, you mean that it is dirty, untidy, and in bad condition.

words.ex: She is thrifty and saves money every week.
words.ex_cn: 她很节约，每周都存钱。
words.en: If you say that someone is thrifty, you are praising them for saving money and not spending it on unnecessary things.

words.ex: The artist created a cubical sculpture that perfectly fits in the small garden.
words.ex_cn: 这位艺术家创作了一个完美适合小花园的立方体雕塑。
words.en: Relating to or in the form of a cube.

words.ex: He likes to study physics in school.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在学校学习物理。
words.en: Physics is the scientific study of matter, energy, force, and motion, and how they relate to each other.

words.ex: The teacher helps students with math.
words.ex_cn: 老师帮助学生学习数学。
words.en: A teacher is a person whose job is to teach in a school or college.

words.tr: v. 戒绝；弃权；自我克制
words.ex: He abstains from eating sugar.
words.ex_cn: 他戒食糖。
words.en: If you abstain from something, you deliberately do not do it or have it, especially something you like or enjoy which might be considered bad for you.

words.tr: n. 甲酸盐；v. 使形成甲酸盐
words.ex: The chemist added sodium formate to the solution.
words.ex_cn: 化学家将甲酸钠加入溶液中。
words.en: A salt or ester of formic acid.

words.tr: v. 确保( ensure的第三人称单数 ); 担保获得[避免]; 使（某人）获得; 使安全
words.ex: The lock ensures your bike is safe.
words.ex_cn: 这把锁确保你的自行车安全。
words.en: If you ensure that something happens, you make certain that it happens.

words.tr: adv. 以某种方式；不知何故；
words.ex: Somehow, he finished the race despite the injury.
words.ex_cn: 不知怎么的，他尽管受伤了还是完成了比赛。
words.en: You use somehow to say that you do not know or cannot say how something was done or will be done.

words.ex: The mother won custody of her child.
words.ex_cn: 母亲获得了孩子的监护权。
words.en: Custody is the legal right or duty to care for someone or something, especially a child after its parents have separated or died.

words.tr: v. （使）联合，合并，统一；（使）联合，合并，统一( unite的现在分词 )；
words.ex: The two teams are uniting to win the game.
words.ex_cn: 这两个团队正联合起来赢得比赛。
words.en: The act of joining together or the state of being joined together, especially for a common purpose or in agreement.

words.tr: v. 出现；出现( emerge的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: A bird emerged from the trees.
words.ex_cn: 一只鸟从树中出现了。
words.en: If something emerges, it comes out from somewhere or comes into view.

words.ex: Wayland is a common name in some English-speaking countries.
words.ex_cn: 韦兰是一些英语国家中常见的名字。
words.en: Wayland is a male given name of Old English origin, meaning 'land by the road'.

words.tr: v. 操作； adj. 有把手的，有把柄的 v. 操作( handle的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He handled the machine carefully.
words.ex_cn: 他小心地操作这台机器。
words.en: To deal with or control a situation or problem.

words.tr: v. 指导；指引；“guide”的现在分词； adj. 指导的；导向的；
words.ex: He is guiding the new student with patience.
words.ex_cn: 他耐心地指导这位新生。
words.en: Providing direction or leadership.

words.ex: His intents were clear: to help and not to harm.
words.ex_cn: 他的意图很明确：要帮助，而不是伤害。
words.en: If you are intent on doing something, you are determined to do it.

words.ex: He wants to publish a book next year.
words.ex_cn: 他想明年出版一本书。
words.en: To produce and issue printed material for public distribution or sale; to make information or work available to the public.

words.ex: The wine is stored in the cellars to keep it cool.
words.ex_cn: 葡萄酒储存在地窖里以保持凉爽。
words.en: A cellar is a room below ground level in a house, often used for storing wine or other goods.

words.tr: n. 吹风，排泄，鼓风 v. 吹气( blow的现在分词 ); 刮风; 吹响; 炸开
words.ex: The blowing wind made it difficult to hear.
words.ex_cn: 刮风使得很难听到声音。
words.en: The act of moving air or wind; the act of expelling air from the mouth.

words.ex: The horses live in the stables near the farm.
words.ex_cn: 马住在农场附近的马厩里。
words.en: A building in which horses are kept.

words.tr: adj. 最卑鄙的；最吝啬的；最恶毒的
words.ex: He is the meanest person I have ever met.
words.ex_cn: 他是我见过的最卑鄙的人。
words.en: Superlative form of 'mean', indicating the most unkind, stingy, or malicious.

words.tr:
n. 风箱（复数名词）
v. 怒吼；吼叫；咆哮；“bellow”的第三人称单数
n. 咆哮；怒号；“bellow”的复数
words.ex: The blacksmith pulled the bellows to make the fire hotter.
words.ex_cn: 铁匠拉风箱让火更旺。
words.en: A bellows is a device for producing a strong current of air, used especially for blowing a fire.

words.ex: We watched a play at the theatre last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚在剧场看了一场戏。
words.en: A theatre is a building with a stage in it, on which plays, shows, and other performances take place.

words.tr: n. （影片、广播电视节目的）剪辑员；编辑( editor的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The editors cut the scenes to make the movie shorter.
words.ex_cn: 剪辑员剪掉了部分镜头，使电影更短。
words.en: Editors are people who are in charge of a newspaper or magazine, or part of one, and who decide what should be included in it.

words.ex: He is tilling the soil before planting seeds.
words.ex_cn: 他在播种前翻土。
words.en: The act of preparing and cultivating land for crops.

words.ex: The children play at Nursery 796.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在796号托儿所玩耍。
words.en: A nursery is a place where young children are cared for during the day while their parents are at work.

words.ex: The government raised tariffs on imported cars.
words.ex_cn: 政府提高了进口汽车的税率。
words.en: A tariff is a tax or duty to be paid on a particular class of imports or exports.

words.tr: v. 禁止；不准；“forbid”的过去式
words.ex: He forbade his son to go out at night.
words.ex_cn: 他禁止儿子晚上外出。
words.en: If someone forbids you to do something, or forbids you from doing it, they order you not to do it.

words.ex: The public condemned the corrupt politician.
words.ex_cn: 公众谴责了这位腐败的政客。
words.en: If you condemn something, you say that it is very bad and unacceptable.

words.tr: v. 报价; 引述; 引用，援引( quote的现在分词 ); 为（股票、黄金或外汇）报价
words.ex: The analyst was quoting the latest market prices.
words.ex_cn: 分析师正在引用最新的市场价格。
words.en: The act of repeating or copying out words from a text or speech, typically with an indication that one is not the original author or speaker.

words.tr:
n. 报复；报仇
v. 报复
words.ex: He wanted revenge for his brother's death.
words.ex_cn: 他想为他兄弟的死报仇。
words.en: Revenge involves hurting or punishing someone who has hurt or harmed you.

words.ex: He is solving a math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他正在解决一个数学问题。
words.en: To find an answer to a problem or to deal with a difficult situation.

words.tr:
n. 发酵；酵素；动乱
v. （使）发酵；动乱
words.ex: The ferment of yeast makes bread rise.
words.ex_cn: 酵母的发酵使面包膨胀。
words.en: If a substance ferments or if it is fermented, it changes chemically because of the action of yeast or bacteria, often producing alcohol.

words.tr: v. 缺乏；“lack”的现在分词； adj. 缺乏的；
words.ex: He is lacking confidence in speaking English.
words.ex_cn: 他在说英语时缺乏信心。
words.en: If something is lacking, there is not enough of it or it does not exist at all.

words.ex: The classroom is orderly and clean.
words.ex_cn: 教室整洁有序。
words.en: If something is done in an orderly fashion or manner, it is done in a well-organized and controlled way.

words.tr: v. 劝告； adj. 深思熟虑的 v. 劝告，提建议( advise的过去式和；
words.ex: He advised me to eat more vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 他劝我多吃蔬菜。
words.en: If you say that something is advised, you mean that it is the right or sensible thing to do, often because it has been thought about carefully.

words.ex: He tries to mediate between the two friends.
words.ex_cn: 他试图在两个朋友之间调解。
words.en: To intervene between people or parties in order to bring about an agreement or reconciliation.

words.tr:
adj. 成长受妨碍的；矮小的
v. 阻碍成长；表演特技；“stunt”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: The plant is stunted because of lack of water.
words.ex_cn: 由于缺水，这株植物生长受阻。
words.en: If something is stunted, its growth or development is prevented from reaching its full potential.

words.tr: adj. 想做…的；希望做的； v. 诱惑；引诱；怂恿；劝诱；“tempt”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: I was tempted to eat the cake.
words.ex_cn: 我真想吃那块蛋糕。
words.en: If you are tempted to do something, you want to do it, although you know it might not be right or sensible.

words.tr: v. 制定（法律）；扮演（角色）
words.ex: The government enacted a new law to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 政府制定了一项新法律来保护环境。
words.en: To enact means to make a proposal into a law or to perform a story or play.

words.tr: v. 吸；吮； adj. 尚未断奶的 v. 吸，吮( suck的现在分词 )；
words.ex: The baby is sucking the bottle.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿正在吸奶瓶。
words.en: The act of drawing something into the mouth by creating a partial vacuum with the lips and tongue.

words.ex: The postage for this letter is one dollar.
words.ex_cn: 这封信的邮资是一美元。
words.en: The cost of sending a letter or package by post.

words.tr: vt. 重新发行; 再版，再印，重新发行 n. 重新发行; 再版物; 改版; 重印邮票 vi. 重发
words.ex: The company will reissue the old ticket.
words.ex_cn: 公司将会重新发行这张旧票。
words.en: To publish or produce something again, especially after it has not been available for a period of time.

words.ex: He believed his destiny was to become a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他相信自己的命运是成为一名医生。
words.en: Destiny is the force which some people believe controls the things that happen to you in your life.

words.ex: The tyrants of ancient history are often remembered for their cruelty.
words.ex_cn: 古代历史上的暴君常常因他们的残忍而被记住。
words.en: A tyrant is a ruler who has complete power and uses it in a cruel and unfair way.

words.ex: He propose to go to the park after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他提议午饭后去公园。
words.en: If you propose something, you suggest it as a plan or course of action.

words.tr: n. 谣言；谣传；传闻；传闻( rumour的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The rumours about the closure spread quickly.
words.ex_cn: 关于关闭的谣言迅速传播开来。
words.en: A rumour is a story or piece of information that may or may not be true, but that people are talking about.

words.ex: The buffalo walks slowly across the grassland.
words.ex_cn: 水牛缓慢地走过草原。
words.en: A buffalo is a large animal of the cattle family, with long, curved horns. In North America, the buffalo is also called the bison.

words.ex: He is jobbing as a painter during the summer.
words.ex_cn: 他夏天做临时油漆工。
words.en: The act of doing casual or occasional work.

words.tr: n. 愿望 v. 祝愿; <正>希望，想要，但愿( wish的现在分词 ); 盼望，企求，想要
words.ex: I am wishing for a sunny day tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我希望能有一个晴天明天。
words.en: If you wish for something, you express the desire for that thing silently to yourself or to someone else.

words.ex: The table is made of granite.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是花岗岩做的。
words.en: Granite is a very hard rock that is often used in building.

words.tr: adv. 粗糙地；粗鲁地；天然地
words.ex: The tools were crudely fashioned from stone.
words.ex_cn: 这些工具是用石头粗糙地制成的。
words.en: In a crude manner; roughly or unskillfully.

words.tr: v. 梳理（头发）；精梳（羊毛、棉花等）以供加工；精梳（织物）（comb 的现在分词）；
words.ex: She is combing her long hair before school.
words.ex_cn: 她正在上学前梳理她的长头发。
words.en: The act of running a comb through hair to untangle or arrange it, or the act of searching thoroughly.

words.ex: He devotes his time to helping children.
words.ex_cn: 他致力于帮助孩子。
words.en: If you devote yourself, your time, or your energy to something, you spend most of your time or energy on it.

words.tr: adv. 天真烂漫地，无邪地
words.ex: He naively trusted the stranger.
words.ex_cn: 他天真地相信了那个陌生人。
words.en: If you describe someone's actions or beliefs as naive, you think they show a lack of experience, wisdom, or judgment.

words.ex: The cruel king starves his prisoners.
words.ex_cn: v. 残忍的国王让他的囚犯挨饿。
words.en: To suffer or die from lack of food.

words.ex: The company plans to recruit new staff next month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司计划下个月招聘新员工。
words.en: To recruit means to enlist someone in the armed forces or to persuade someone to join a company, organization, or group.

words.ex: The colonel gave orders to the soldiers.
words.ex_cn: 上校向士兵下达了命令。
words.en: A colonel is a senior officer in the army, air force, or marines, ranking above a lieutenant colonel and below a brigadier or brigadier general.

words.tr: adj. 谨慎的；慎重的；精明的
words.ex: He is prudent with his money.
words.ex_cn: 他在花钱时很谨慎。
words.en: If you are prudent, you are careful and avoid taking unnecessary risks.

words.ex: In the story, Lucifer was cast out of heaven.
words.ex_cn: 在这个故事中，撒旦被逐出天堂。
words.en: Lucifer is a name often associated with the devil or Satan in Christian theology, and it also refers to the morning star, the planet Venus.

words.ex: Water is a common solvent for salt.
words.ex_cn: 水是盐的常见溶剂。
words.en: A solvent is a substance that can dissolve other substances, or a person or company that has enough money to pay their debts.

words.ex: The student reads a book every day.
words.ex_cn: 这个学生每天读书。
words.en: A student is a person who is studying at a university or college.

words.tr: v. 兑现；将...兑换成现金
words.ex: He is cashing his paycheck at the bank.
words.ex_cn: 他正在银行兑现他的工资支票。
words.en: To exchange a check or other financial instrument for cash.

words.tr: adj. 根据事实的；真实的；
words.ex: His report is factual and accurate.
words.ex_cn: 他的报告是基于事实且准确的。
words.en: If something is factual, it is based on facts or concerns facts.

words.ex: The army invades the enemy territory at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 军队在黎明时分侵入敌方领土。
words.en: To enter a place, situation, or sphere of activity in large numbers, especially with intrusive effect.

words.tr: v. 使弯曲；使变形；使有偏见
words.ex: The heat is warping the wooden door.
words.ex_cn: 热量正在使木门变形。
words.en: To warp something means to bend or twist it out of its natural shape, often because of heat or dampness. It can also mean to influence someone's ideas or judgment so that they are no longer based on truth or reality.

words.ex: He threw the rubbish into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 他把垃圾扔进了垃圾桶。
words.en: Waste material; refuse or litter.

words.tr: v. 提出（请求、控诉等）( prefer的第三人称单数 ); 提升; 建议; 选择某事物（而不选择
words.ex: She prefers tea over coffee.
words.ex_cn: 她更喜欢茶而不是咖啡。
words.en: If you prefer someone or something, you like that person or thing better than another, and so you are more likely to choose them if there is a choice.

words.ex: The car gained momenta as it rolled down the hill.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在下坡时获得了动量。
words.en: The quantity of motion of a moving body, measured as a product of its mass and velocity.

words.ex: The night sky was filled with myriads of stars.
words.ex_cn: 夜空中布满了无数的星星。
words.en: A very large number of something.

words.ex: He is a carrier of the flu virus.
words.ex_cn: 他是流感病毒的携带者。
words.en: A carrier is a person or thing that carries, holds, or conveys something.

words.ex: He made new schemes to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他制定了新的计划来省钱。
words.en: A scheme is a plan or arrangement, especially one produced by a government or other organization, or a secret and dishonest plan.

words.ex: The children play in the gardens after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在花园里玩耍。
words.en: An area of land, often near a house, used for growing flowers, fruit, or vegetables, and often containing an area of grass.

words.tr: v. 挥舞；使用；行使（权力等）
words.ex: He wielded a hammer to fix the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他用锤子修理墙壁。
words.en: To hold and use a weapon or tool; to have and be able to use power or influence.

words.ex: The medication induces sleep quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这种药物能迅速引起睡意。
words.en: To induce means to bring about or give rise to something, often through persuasion or influence.

words.tr: adj. 紧张不安的；神经系统的；
words.ex: He felt nervous before the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试前感到紧张不安。
words.en: If someone is nervous, they are frightened or worried about something that is happening or might happen, and show this in their behavior.

words.tr: n. 转换开关装置；改变者
words.ex: He uses a coin changer at the parking lot.
words.ex_cn: 他在停车场使用硬币兑换机。
words.en: A changer is someone or something that changes or is used to change something.

words.tr: v. （使）漂浮；（使）浮动( float的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The leaf floated on the water.
words.ex_cn: 树叶漂浮在水面上。
words.en: If something floats or if you float it, it stays on the surface of a liquid and does not sink.

words.ex: The squires were responsible for the management of the estate.
words.ex_cn: 乡绅们负责管理庄园。
words.en: A squire is a young nobleman acting as an attendant to a knight before becoming a knight himself, or a country gentleman, especially the chief landowner in a district.

words.ex: He travels to Spain every summer.
words.ex_cn: 他每年夏天都去西班牙旅行。
words.en: Travels can refer to the act of moving from one place to another, especially over a long distance, or the journeys someone makes to different places, often for pleasure or business. It can also refer to the written accounts of such journeys.

words.ex: The dictionary defines the word clearly.
words.ex_cn: 词典精确地解释了这个词。
words.en: Specifies or describes the essential qualities or characteristics of something.

words.ex: Wait a seconde, I need to tie my shoe.
words.ex_cn: 等一下，我需要系鞋带。
words.en: A unit of time equal to one sixtieth of a minute.

words.tr: v. 快行；加速；“speed”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: The car speeded up as it approached the highway.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在接近高速公路时加速了。
words.en: Moved or acted at high speed; past tense of 'speed'.

words.tr: v. 推；逼迫；按；“push”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is pushing the cart down the street.
words.ex_cn: 他正在把购物车推下街道。
words.en: Pushing is used to describe someone who is determined to get what they want, often in a way that other people find annoying.

words.tr: adj. 更朴素的；“plain”的比较级；
words.ex: She wore a plainer dress than her sister.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件比她妹妹更朴素的裙子。
words.en: Comparative of plain; more plain.

words.tr: adj. 文雅的；有教养的；上流社会的；装绅士派头的
words.ex: She spoke in a genteel way at the dinner party.
words.ex_cn: 她在晚宴上说话很文雅。
words.en: Someone who is genteel behaves in a polite and refined way, often in a manner that is considered typical of someone from a high social class.

words.ex: The cows graze on the prairie.
words.ex_cn: 牛在草原上吃草。
words.en: A prairie is a large area of flat, grassy land, especially in North America.

words.tr: v. 肯定（affirm 的第三人称单数）；申明
words.ex: She affirms her commitment to the project.
words.ex_cn: 她肯定了她对项目的承诺。
words.en: If you affirm something, you state firmly and publicly that it is true or that it exists.

words.tr:
n. 粗斜条棉布；夸大的话 
adj. 粗斜条棉布的；夸大的
words.ex: His fustian speech made no sense.
words.ex_cn: 他那浮夸的演讲毫无意义。
words.en: Fustian is a type of thick, hard-wearing cloth made from cotton and flax. It can also refer to pompous or pretentious speech or writing.

words.tr:
n. 崇拜；崇敬；礼拜；
v. 崇拜；尊崇；做礼拜；
words.ex: The ancient people showed worship to the sun.
words.ex_cn: 古人对太阳进行崇拜。
words.en: The feeling or expression of reverence and adoration for a deity.

words.tr: n. 萨福克（英国英格兰东部的一个郡）
words.ex: Suffolk is known for its beautiful countryside.
words.ex_cn: 萨福克以其美丽的乡村而闻名。
words.en: Suffolk is a county in East Anglia, England, known for its rural landscapes and historic towns.

words.ex: The barber knows his clients well.
words.ex_cn: 这位理发师很了解他的客户。
words.en: A client is someone who receives services from a professional person or organization in return for payment.

words.ex: He has the calibre to lead the team.
words.ex_cn: 他有领导团队的能力。
words.en: The quality of someone's character or the level of their ability; the diameter of the inside of a tube, especially of a gun barrel.

words.ex: The painting depicts a quiet village at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画描绘了一个黄昏时宁静的村庄。
words.en: To depict something means to represent it in a picture or story.

words.ex: He eats cereals for breakfast every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃谷物当早餐。
words.en: Cereals are plants such as wheat, corn, or rice that produce grain. The grain from these plants is used for food.

words.tr:
n. 垂饰；悬挂物
adj. 吊着的；悬垂的；悬而未决的
words.ex: She wears a silver pendant around her neck.
words.ex_cn: 她戴着一条银色吊坠在脖子上。
words.en: A pendant is a piece of jewelry that hangs from a chain worn around the neck.

words.tr: v. 准备( prepare的第三人称单数 ); 预备（饭菜）; 配备; 使（自己）有准备
words.ex: He prepares his homework every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上准备作业。
words.en: Makes something ready for use or action.

words.ex: The bondsmen were responsible for ensuring the debtor's appearance in court.
words.ex_cn: 保证人负责确保债务人出庭。
words.en: A bondsman is a person who provides a bond or surety for another, especially in legal or financial contexts, or historically, a person in a state of servitude.

words.ex: He relapses into bad habits when he is stressed.
words.ex_cn: 当他感到压力时，他会重新陷入坏习惯。
words.en: If someone relapses into a previous state or way of behaving, they return to it.

words.tr:
adj. 挥霍的；丰富的；慷慨的；不吝惜的
n. 浪子
words.ex: The prodigal son returned home after years.
words.ex_cn: 那个浪子多年后回到了家。
words.en: A prodigal person spends money or resources in a way that is not careful and is too generous.

words.tr: n. 二十几岁；一生中20至29岁的十年；
words.ex: He traveled across Europe in his twenties.
words.ex_cn: 他在二十几岁时游历了欧洲。
words.en: The period of life between 20 and 29 years of age; the years from 1920 to 1929.

words.ex: The assembly of the car took three days.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的装配花了三天时间。
words.en: An assembly is a group of people gathered together for a particular purpose, such as a meeting or a legislative session. It can also refer to the process of fitting together the component parts of a machine or other object.

words.ex: He wore absurdly big shoes to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着极其大的鞋子去参加派对。
words.en: In a manner that is so unreasonable as to be laughable or ridiculous.

words.ex: He called urgently for help.
words.ex_cn: 他紧急地呼救。
words.en: If something is urgent, it needs to be dealt with immediately.

words.ex: The park is in the vicinity of my house.
words.ex_cn: 公园在我家附近。
words.en: The area or region near or about a place; the surrounding district.

words.ex: The tribunal decided the case quickly.
words.ex_cn: 法庭迅速作出了裁决。
words.en: A tribunal is a special court or committee that is officially chosen to examine a particular problem or situation.

words.tr: adj. 胀大的； v. “inflate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The balloon became inflated after he blew air into it.
words.ex_cn: 他往气球里吹气后，气球就胀大了。
words.en: If you describe prices, estimates, or claims as inflated, you mean that they are too high or too great.

words.ex: The king's greed led to his downfall.
words.ex_cn: 国王的贪婪导致了他的没落。
words.en: The collapse of a person or organization's power, status, or success.

words.tr: n. 细节；细枝末节；琐事；“minutia”的复数
words.ex: The detective focused on the minutiae of the crime scene.
words.ex_cn: 侦探专注于犯罪现场的微小细节。
words.en: The small, precise, or trivial details of something.

words.ex: The beauties of the sunset amazed everyone.
words.ex_cn: 日落的美景让每个人都惊叹。
words.en: Beauties are things or people that are beautiful.

words.ex: Water flows through the conduits to the farm.
words.ex_cn: 水通过管道流到农场。
words.en: A conduit is a channel or pipe for conveying water or other fluid, or a means of transmitting or distributing something such as information or electricity.

words.tr:
adj. 有教养的；文雅的；人工培养或养殖的
v. 培养；“culture”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: He is a cultured man who loves art and music.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个有教养的人，喜欢艺术和音乐。
words.en: If you describe someone as cultured, you mean that they have good manners, are well educated, and know a lot about the arts.

words.tr: adj. 不动摇的；坚决的；泰然自若的
words.ex: He remained unshaken after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他依然坚定不移。
words.en: If you describe someone's belief or attitude as unshaken, you mean that it is strong and firm and not likely to be weakened.

words.ex: The sun reappeared after the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风暴过后，太阳重新出现了。
words.en: If someone or something reappears, they appear again after they have been away or out of sight for some time.

words.tr: adj. 抛光的；磨光的；擦亮的； v. 擦亮；磨光；“polish”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The polished table reflected the light.
words.ex_cn: 抛光的桌子反射着光线。
words.en: If something is polished, it has been made smooth and shiny by rubbing it with a cloth or a special substance.

words.tr: v. 归入，包括( subsume的过去式和过去分词 )
words.ex: The old rule was subsumed by the new one.
words.ex_cn: 旧规则被新规则所包含。
words.en: If something is subsumed within a larger group or class, it is included within it, rather than being considered as something separate.

words.tr: n. 珠宝商；钟表匠；宝石匠；珠宝店
words.ex: The jeweller fixed her broken necklace.
words.ex_cn: 珠宝商修好了她断裂的项链。
words.en: A jeweller is a person who makes, sells, or repairs jewellery and watches.

words.ex: He secretly ate the last cookie.
words.ex_cn: 他偷偷吃了最后一块饼干。
words.en: In a way that is kept hidden from knowledge or view; not openly.

words.ex: He dominates the conversation.
words.ex_cn: 他主宰了谈话。
words.en: To dominate means to control or govern someone or something, or to be the most important or noticeable feature of something.

words.ex: He is a logician who solves puzzles every day.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位每天解谜题的逻辑学家。
words.en: A logician is someone who studies or is an expert in logic.

words.ex: He divested his shares last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年卖掉了自己的股份。
words.en: To divest means to deprive someone of power, rights, or possessions, or to rid oneself of something.

words.ex: He is an artistic boy who loves to draw.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个喜欢画画的艺术型男孩。
words.en: Someone who is artistic is good at drawing or painting, or arranging things in a beautiful way.

words.ex: There is friction between the two neighbors over the fence.
words.ex_cn: 两个邻居因为篱笆问题产生了不和。
words.en: The resistance that one surface or object encounters when moving over another.

words.ex: He has troubles with math homework.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学作业上有困难。
words.en: Problems or difficulties that cause worry or inconvenience.

words.tr: n. 伊特鲁里亚人；伊特鲁里亚语 adj. 伊特鲁里亚的
words.ex: The Etruscan pottery is very old.
words.ex_cn: 伊特鲁里亚陶器非常古老。
words.en: Relating to ancient Etruria, its people, or their language.

words.tr: adj. 东方的（尤指中国和日本）
words.ex: He bought an oriental rug at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了一张东方地毯。
words.en: Oriental is used to describe things that come from or are associated with eastern Asia, especially China and Japan.

words.ex: The law restricts driving after drinking.
words.ex_cn: 法律限制酒后驾驶。
words.en: to limit the movements or actions of someone, or to limit something and reduce its size or prevent it from increasing

words.tr:
adj. 一味攫取的；贪婪的；贪心的
v. 抓紧； 领会；“grasp”的现在分词
words.ex: He was a grasping businessman who always looked for more profit.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个贪婪的商人，总是寻求更多的利润。
words.en: If you describe someone as grasping, you are criticizing them for wanting to get and keep as much money as possible, and for being unwilling to spend it.

words.ex: Chemists work in labs to find new medicines.
words.ex_cn: 化学家在实验室里寻找新药物。
words.en: A chemist is a scientist who specializes in chemistry, the study of the composition, structure, properties, and reactions of matter, especially of atomic and molecular systems.

words.tr: adj. 痛苦的；严重的；剧烈的
words.ex: The injury caused him grievous pain.
words.ex_cn: 这次受伤给他带来了巨大的痛苦。
words.en: If you describe something such as a loss or injury as grievous, you mean that it is extremely serious or worrying in its effects.

words.tr: v. 引起（注意、想像、兴趣）；俘获；夺取；俘获( capture的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The bright colors captured the children's attention.
words.ex_cn: 鲜艳的色彩吸引了孩子们的注意。
words.en: If you capture someone or something, you catch them and keep them somewhere so that they cannot leave.

words.tr: v.考试; 审查; 诊察; 仔细检查
words.ex: The doctor examines the patient thoroughly.
words.ex_cn: 医生对病人进行了彻底的检查。
words.en: To inspect or scrutinize carefully; to test the knowledge or ability of someone by questioning them.

words.ex: The doctors care for many patients every day.
words.ex_cn: 医生每天照顾许多病人。
words.en: People who are receiving medical treatment or care, especially in a hospital.

words.ex: The bondsman paid the money so the man could leave jail.
words.ex_cn: 保释官支付了钱，所以那个人可以离开监狱。
words.en: A bondsman is someone who is legally responsible for ensuring that another person fulfills their obligations, especially in court, or a man who is in bondage; a slave.

words.ex: The kitchen is hygienic and clean.
words.ex_cn: 厨房卫生且干净。
words.en: Something that is hygienic is clean and unlikely to cause illness.

words.ex: I am enclosing the documents herewith.
words.ex_cn: 我随信附上文件。
words.en: used in formal writing to introduce a document or to say that something is included with a letter

words.ex: She arranges her books on the shelf every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 她每周末都把书整理在架子上。
words.en: If you arrange an event or meeting, you make plans and preparations so that it can happen.

words.ex: The team gained momentum after scoring the first goal.
words.ex_cn: 球队在进第一个球后获得了势头。
words.en: Momentum is the ability of something to keep increasing, developing, or being more successful.

words.ex: He had the audacity to lie to his boss.
words.ex_cn: 他竟敢对老板撒谎。
words.en: Audacity is the willingness to take bold risks, often in a way that shocks or surprises people.

words.tr: n. 洪水泛滥； v. 淹没；“flood”的现在分词；
words.ex: The heavy rain caused flooding in the city.
words.ex_cn: 大雨导致了城市洪水泛滥。
words.en: Flooding refers to the overflow of water onto land that is normally dry, often caused by heavy rainfall, melting snow, or the failure of dams or levees.

words.ex: The evidence is doubtful.
words.ex_cn: 这些证据是可疑的。
words.en: If you are doubtful about something, you are uncertain about it or not sure that it is true or possible.
